lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Fear not, little flock, from the
cross to the
throne,
From death into life He went
for His own;
All power in earth, all power
above,
Is given to Him for the flock of
His love.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Only believe, only believe,
All things are possible, only
believe;
Only believe, only believe,
All things are possible, only
believe.
(Lord, I believe...)
(Lord, I receive...)
(Jesus is here....)

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Fear not, little flock, He goeth
ahead,
Your Shepherd selecteth the
path you must
tread;
The waters of Marah He'll
sweeten for thee,
He drank all the bitter in
Gethsemane.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Fear not, little flock, whatever
your lot,
He enters all rooms, "the
doors being shut;"
He never forsakes, He never
is gone,
So count on His presence in
darkness and
dawn.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Amazing grace! How sweet
the sound,
That saved a wretch like me!
I once was lost, but now am
found,
Was blind, but now I see.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
'Twas grace that taught my
heart to fear,
And grace my fears relieved;
How precious did that grace
appear
The hour I first believed!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Through many dangers, toils
and snares,
I have already come;
'Tis grace hath brought me
safe thus far,
And grace will lead me home.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
When we've been there ten
thousand years,
Bright shining as the sun;
We've no less days to sing
God's praise
Than when we first begun.

title: THEY COME FROM THE EAST AND WEST

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
They come from the East and
West,
They come from the lands
afar,
To feast with the King,
To dine as His guests;
How blessed these pilgrims
are!
Beholding His hallowed face
Aglow with light divine;
Blest partakers of His grace,
As gems in His crown to shine.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Since Jesus has set me free,
I'm happy as heart can be;
No longer I bear the burden of
care,
His yoke is so sweet to me.
My soul was as black as night,
But darkness has taken flight;
Now I shout the victory,
For Jesus has set me free.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
I look on the great white
throne,
Before it the ransom'd stand;
No longer are tears, no sorrow
is known,
Nor death in that goodly land.
My Saviour has gone before,
Preparing the way for me;
Soon we'll meet to part no
more,
Through time or eternity.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
The gates of that holy place
Stand open by night and day;
O look to the Lord who "giveth
more grace,"
Whose love has prepared the
way.
A home in those mansions
fair,
His hand hath reserved for all.
For the wedding feast prepare,
Obeying the gracious call.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
O, Jesus is coming soon,
Our trials will then be o'er.
What if our Lord this moment
should come
For those who are free from
sin?
Then would it bring you joy,
Or sorrow and deep despair?
When our Lord in glory comes,
We'll meet Him up in the air.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Gone from my heart the world
and all its
charms,
Now through the blood, I'm
saved from all
alarms;
Down at the cross my heart is
bending low,
The precious blood of Jesus
cleanses white as
snow.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
I love Him, I love Him,
Because He first loved me,
And purchased my salvation
On Calvary's tree.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Once I was bound, but now I
am set free;
Once I was blind, but now the
light I see;
Once I was dead, but now in
Christ I live,
To tell the world around the
peace that He
doth give.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Sweet hour of prayer, sweet
hour of prayer,
That calls me from a world of
care,
And bids me at my Father's
throne,
Make all my wants and wishes
known;
In seasons of distress and
grief,
My soul has often found relief,
And oft escaped the tempter's
snare,
By thy return, sweet hour of
prayer.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Sweet hour of prayer, sweet
hour of prayer,
The joy I feel, the bliss I share,
Of those whose anxious spirits
burn
With strong desires for thy
return!
With such I hasten to the
place,
Where God, my Saviour,
shows His face,
And gladly take my station
there,
And wait for thee, sweet hour
of prayer.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Sweet hour of prayer, sweet
hour of prayer;
Thy wings shall my petition
bear
To Him whose truth and
faithfulness
Engage the waiting soul to
bless;
And since He bids me seek
His face,
Believe His word and trust His
grace,
I'll cast on Him my every care,
And wait for thee, sweet hour
of prayer.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
There is a name I love to hear,
I love to sing its worth;
It sounds like music in mine
ear,
The sweetest name on earth.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
O, how I love Jesus,
O, how I love Jesus,
O, how I love Jesus,
Because He first loved me.
(I will never forsake Him...)

lyrics.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
lyrics.content:
It tells me what my Father hath
In store for everyday,
And though I tread a
darksome path,
Yields sunshine all the way.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
It tells of One whose loving
heart
Can feel my deepest woe,
Who in each sorrow bears a
part
That none can bear below.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I am thinking of the rapture in
our blessed homeA
on high,
When the redeemed are
gathering in;
How we'll raise the heavenly
anthem in that
city in the sky,
When the redeemed are
gathering in.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
When the redeemed are
gathering in,
Washed like the snow, and
free from all sin;
How we will shout, and how
we will sing,
When the redeemed are
gathering in.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
There will be a great
procession over on the
street of gold,
When the redeemed are
gathering in;
O what music, O what singing,
o'er the city will
be rolled,
When the redeemed are
gathering in.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Saints will sing redemption's
story with their
voices clear and strong,
When the redeemed are
gathering in;
Then the angels all will listen,
for they cannot
join that song,
When the redeemed are
gathering in.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Then the Saviour will give
orders to prepare
the banquet board,
When the redeemed are
gathering in;
And we'll hear His invitation,
"Come, ye
blessed of the Lord,"
When the redeemed are
gathering in.

title: O, I WANT TO SEE HIM

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
As I journey through the land,
singing as I
go,
Pointing souls to Calvary, to
the crimson
flow,
Many arrows pierce my soul
from without,
within;
But my Lord leads me on,
through Him I
must win.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
O, I want to see Him, look
upon His face.
There to sing forever of His
saving grace;
On the street of glory let me lift
my voice;
Cares all past, home at last,
ever to rejoice.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
When in service for my Lord
dark may be the
night,
But I'll cling more close to Him,
He will give
me light;
Satan's snares may vex my
soul, turn my
thoughts aside;
But my Lord goes ahead,
leads whate'er
betide.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
When in valleys low I look
toward the
mountain height,
And behold my Saviour there,
leading in the
fight,
With a tender hand
outstretched toward the
valley low;
Guiding me, I can see, as I
onward go.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
When before me billows rise
from the mighty
deep,
Then my Lord directs my
barque, He doth
safely keep,
And He leads me gently on
through this
world below;
He's a real Friend to me, O I
love Him so.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Feeling so much better talking
about this
good old way,
Feeling so much better talking
about the
Lord;
Let's go on, let's go on talking
about this
good old way,
Let's go on, let's go on talking
about the
Lord.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
The Devil he don't like it,
talking about this
good old way,
The Devil he don't like it,
talking about the
Lord;
So, let's go on, let's go on
talking about this
good old way,
Let's go on, let's go on talking
about the
Lord.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Teach me, Lord, to wait down
on my knees,
Till in Your own good time You
answer my
pleas;
Teach me not to rely on what
others do,
But to wait in prayer for an
answer from You.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
They that wait upon the Lord
shall renew
their strength,
They shall mount up with
wings as an eagle,
They shall run and not be
weary, they shall
walk and not faint;
Teach me, Lord, teach me,
Lord, to wait.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Teach me, Lord, to wait while
hearts are
aflame,
Help me humble my pride and
call on Your
name;
Keep my faith renewed, keep
my eyes on
Thee,
Help me be on this earth what
You want me
to be.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
In the resurrection morning,
When the trump of God shall
sound,
We shall rise, (Hallelujah!) we
shall rise!
Then the saints will come
rejoicing
And no tears will e'er be
found,
We shall rise, (Hallelujah!) we
shall rise.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
We shall rise! (Hallelujah!)
We shall rise! (Amen!)
We shall rise! (Hallelujah!)
In the resurrection morning,
When death's prison bars are
broken,
We shall rise,(Hallelujah!) we
shall rise.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
In the resurrection morning,
What a meeting it will be,
We shall rise, (Hallelujah!) we
shall rise!
When our fathers and our
mothers,
And our loved ones we shall
see,
We shall rise, (Hallelujah!) we
shall rise.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
In the resurrection morning,
Blessed thought it is to me,
We shall rise, (Hallelujah!) we
shall rise!
I shall see my blessed Saviour
Who so freely died for me,
We shall rise, (Hallelujah!) we
shall rise.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
In the resurrection morning,
We shall meet Him in the air,
We shall rise, (Hallelujah!) we
shall rise!
And be carried up to glory,
To our home so bright and fair,
We shall rise, (Hallelujah!) we
shall rise.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Am I a soldier of the cross,
A follower of the Lamb,
And shall I fear to own His
cause,
Or blush to speak His name?

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
And when the battle's over, we
shall wear a
crown!
Yes, we shall wear a crown!
Yes, we shall
wear a crown!
And when the battle's over, we
shall wear a
crown
In the New Jerusalem.
Wear a crown, wear a crown,
Wear a bright and shining
crown;
And when the battle's over, we
shall wear a
crown
In the New Jerusalem.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Must I be carried to the skies
On flowery beds of ease,
While others fought to win the
prize,
And sailed through bloody
seas?

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Are there no foes for me to
face?
Must I not stem the flood?
Is this vile world a friend to
grace
To help me unto God?

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Sure I must fight if I would
reign,
Increase my courage Lord;
I'll bear the toil, endure the
pain,
Supported by Thy Word.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Marvellous grace of our loving
Lord,
Grace that exceeds our sin
and our guilt;
Yonder on Calvary's mount
outpoured,
There where the blood of the
Lamb was spilt.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Grace, grace, God's grace,
Grace that will pardon and
cleanse within;
Grace, grace, God's grace,
Grace that is greater than all
our sin.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Sin and despair like the sea
waves cold,
Threaten the soul with infinite
loss:
Grace that is greater, yes,
grace untold,
Points to the refuge,-the
mighty cross.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Dark is the stain that we
cannot hide,
What can avail to wash it
away?
Look, there is flowing a
crimson tide;
Whiter than snow you may be
today.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Marvellous, infinite, matchless
grace
Freely bestowed on all who
believe;
You that are longing to see His
face,
Will you this moment His
grace receive?

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
There waits for me a glad
tomorrow,
Where gates of pearl swing
open wide,
And when I've passed this
vale of sorrow,
I'll camp upon the other side.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Someday beyond the reach of
mortal ken,
Someday, God only knows
just where and
when,
The wheels of mortal life shall
all stand still,
And I shall go to dwell on
Zion's hill.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Someday I'll hear the angels
singing,
Beyond the shadows of the
tomb;
And all the bells of Heaven
ringing,
While saints are singing,
"Home, sweet
home."

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Someday my labours will be
ended,
And all my wanderings will be
o'er,
And all earth's broken ties be
mended,
And I shall sigh and weep no
more.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Someday the dark clouds will
be lifted,
And all the night of gloom be
past;
And all life's burdens will be
lifted,
The day of rest shall dawn at
last.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Come, we that love the Lord,
And let our joys be known,
Join in a song with sweet
accord,
Join in a song with sweet
accord,
And thus surround the throne,
And thus surround the throne.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
We're marching to Zion,
Beautiful, beautiful Zion;
We're marching upward to
Zion,
The beautiful city of God.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Let those refuse to sing,
Who never knew our God;
But children of the heavenly
King,
But children of the heavenly
King,
May speak their joys abroad,
May speak their joys abroad.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
The hill of Zion yields
A thousand sacred sweets
Before we reach the heavenly
fields!
Before we reach the heavenly
fields!
Or walk the golden street,
Or walk the golden street.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Then let our songs abound,
And every tear be dry;
We're marching through
Emmanuel's ground,
We're marching through
Emmanuel's ground,
To fairer worlds on high,
To fairer worlds on high.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 3
Verse 4
lyrics.content:
O, Holy Ghost, revival comes
from Thee;
Send a revival, start the work
in me;
Thy Word declares, "Thou wilt
supply our
need;"
For blessing now, O Lord, I
humbly plead.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
My sheep know My voice,
And the path that I take,
They follow wherever I go;
My sheep know My voice
And come at My call,
But a stranger's voice do they
not know.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
My sheep know My voice,
And day by day,
They abide in the fold,
And go not astray;
They love Me because
I have made them My choice,
And they follow My call,
For My sheep know My voice.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
My sheep know My voice,
And the pastures of green,
Where I lead them so often to
feed;
My sheep know My voice,
And the cool sparkling stream,
Where beside its still waters I
lead.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
My sheep know My voice,
And the valley of death,
Through which I shall lead
them some day;
But no danger nor harm
Can touch one of them,
For I will be with them always.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Onward, christian-soldiers!
Marching as to war,
With the cross of Jesus
Going on before;
Christ the royal Master
Leads against the foe;
Forward into battle,
See, His banners go!

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Onward, christian-soldiers!
Marching as to war,
With the cross of Jesus
Going on before.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
Verse 4
lyrics.content:
At the sign of triumph,
Satan's host doth flee;
O, then, christian-soldiers,
On to victory!
Hell's foundations quiver-
At the shout of praise;
Brothers, lift your voices,
Loud your anthems raise.

lyrics.label: Verse 5

title: IT'S NOT BY WORKS OF RIGHTEOUSNESS

lyrics.label: Verse 1
CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Complete, complete, complete
in Him,
We are complete in Him;
Complete, complete, complete
in Him,
We are complete in Him.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
Verse 1
lyrics.content:
When upon the clouds of
heaven,
Christ shall come to earth
again,
Will the world be glad to see
Him,
When our Lord shall come
again?

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
There'll be singing, there'll be
shouting,
There'll be sorrow, there'll be
pain,
There'll be weeping, there'll be
praying,
When our Lord shall come
again.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Will His coming bring
rejoicing?
Or will it bring tears and pain?
Are you ready to receive Him,
When our Lord shall come
again?

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Will you join in lamentation?
Or the angels' glad refrain?
Will you help His people crown
Him,
When our Lord shall come
again?

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Work and pray till Jesus calls
you,
Help to gather-in the grain;
Then with joy you'll meet the
Saviour,
When our Lord shall come
again.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
The fight is on, the trumpet
sound is ringing out,
The cry "To arms" is heard
afar and near;
The Lord of hosts is marching
on to victory,
The triumph of the right will
soon appear.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
The fight is on, O
christian-soldiers,
And face to face in stern array,
With armour gleaming, and
colours
streaming,
The right and wrong engage
today;
The fight is on, but be not
weary,
Be strong and in His might
hold fast;
If God be for us, His banner
o'er us,
We'll sing the victor's song at
last.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
The fight is on, arouse ye
soldiers brave and
true,
Jehovah leads, and victory will
assure;
Go buckle on the armour God
has given you,
And in His strength unto the
end endure.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
The Lord is leading on to
certain victory,
The bow of promise spans the
eastern sky;
His glorious name in every
land shall
honoured be,
The morn will break, the dawn
of peace is nigh.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I heard an old, old story,
How a Saviour came from
glory,
How He gave His life on
Calvary
To save a wretch like me:
I heard about His groaning,
Of His precious blood's
atoning,
Then I repented of my sins
And won the victory.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
O victory in Jesus,
My Saviour forever;
He sought me and bought me
With His redeeming blood;
He loved me ere I knew Him
And all my love is due Him,
He plunged me to victory
Beneath the cleansing flood.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
I heard about His healing,
Of His cleansing power
revealing,
How He made the lame to
walk again
And caused the blind to see;
And then I cried, "Dear Jesus,
Come and heal my broken
spirit,"
And somehow Jesus came
and brought
To me the victory.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
I heard about a mansion
He has built for me in glory,
And I heard about the street of
gold
Beyond the crystal sea;
About the angels singing,
And the old redemption story,
And some sweet day I'll sing
up there
The song of victory.

title: MY FAITH LOOKS UP TO THEE

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
My faith looks up to Thee,
Thou Lamb of Calvary,
Saviour divine;
Now hear me while I pray,
Take all my sin away,
O let me from this day
Be wholly Thine!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
May Thy rich grace impart
Strength to my fainting heart,
My zeal inspire;
As Thou hast died for me,
O may my love to Thee,
Pure, warm, and changeless
be,
A living fire!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
While life's dark maze I tread,
And griefs around me spread,
Be Thou my Guide;
Bid darkness turn to day,
Wipe sorrow's tears away,
Nor let me ever stray
From Thee aside.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I care not today what the
morrow may bring,
If shadow or sunshine or rain;
The Lord I know ruleth over
everything,
And all of my worry is vain.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Living by faith, in Jesus above,
Trusting, confiding in His great
love;
From all harm safe in His
sheltering arm,
I'm living by faith, and feel no
alarm.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Though tempest may blow
and the storm-
clouds arise,
Obscuring the brightness of
life,
I'm never alarmed at the
overcast skies,
The Master looks on at the
strife.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
I know that He safely will carry
me through,
No matter what evils betide;
Why should I then care,
though the tempest
may blow,
If Jesus walks close to my
side.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Our Lord will return to this
earth some sweet
day,
Our troubles will then all be
o'er;
The Master so gently will lead
us away,
Beyond that blest heavenly
shore.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
All to Jesus I surrender,
All to Him I freely give;
I will ever love and trust Him,
In His presence daily live.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
I surrender all,
I surrender all,
All to Thee, my blessed
Saviour,
I surrender all.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
All to Jesus I surrender,
Humbly at His feet I bow,
Worldly pleasures all forsaken,
Take me, Jesus, take me now.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
All to Jesus I surrender,
Make me, Saviour, wholly
Thine;
Let me feel the Holy Spirit,
Truly know that Thou art mine.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
All to Jesus I surrender,
Lord, I give myself to Thee;
Fill me with Thy love and
power,
Let Thy blessing fall on me.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
All to Jesus I surrender,
Now I feel the sacred flame;
O, the joy of full salvation!
Glory, glory to His name!

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
On the top of Mount Zion is a
city
And the earth with glory it doth
fill;
I shall look on its beauty in the
morning
When I reach that city on the
hill.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
O, that city on Mount Zion,
Though a pilgrim, yet I love
thee still;
I'll not leave thee, through the
ages,
When I reach that city on the
hill.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
I'm invited to come home to
that city,
For the Word says,
"Whosoever will,"
And I'll find there a mansion
for me waiting
When I reach that city on the
hill.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Death will never molest me in
that city,
Never leave me lying cold and
chill;
And I'll enter to live up there
forever
When I reach that city on the
hill.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
So I'll stay here until my
Saviour calls me,
Trying daily to perform His will;
Then He'll say unto me, "Well
done," up
yonder
When I reach that city on the
hill.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Tempted and tried, we're oft
made to
wonder,
Why it should be thus all the
day long,
While there are others living
about us,
Never molested, though in the
wrong.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Farther along we'll know all
about it,
Farther along we'll understand
why;
Cheer up, my brother, live in
the sunshine,
We'll understand it all by and
by.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
When death has come and
taken our loved
ones,
It leaves our home so lonely
and drear;
Then do we wonder why
others prosper,
Living so wicked year after
year.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
"Faithful till death" said our
loving Master,
A few more days to labour and
wait;
Toils of the road will then
seem as nothing,
As we sweep through the
beautiful gate.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
When we see Jesus coming in
glory,
When He comes from His
home in the sky,
Then we shall meet Him in
that bright
mansion,
We'll understand it all by and
by.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Let me walk, blessed Lord, in
the way Thou
hast gone,
Leading straight to the land
above;
Giving cheer everywhere to
the sad and the
lone,
Fill my way everyday with
love.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Fill my way everyday with
love,
As I walk with the heavenly
dove;
Let me go all the while, with a
song and a
smile,
Fill my way everyday with
love.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Keep me close to the side of
my Saviour and
Guide,
Let me never in darkness
rove;
Keep my path free from wrath,
and my soul
satisfied,
Fill my way every day with
love.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Soon the race will be o'er, and
I'll travel no
more,
But abide in my home above;
Let me sing, blessed King, all
the way to the
shore,
Fill my way everyday with
love.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I am resolved no longer to
linger,
Charmed by the world's
delight;
Things that are higher, things
that are nobler,
These have allured my sight.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
I will hasten to Him,
Hasten so glad and free,
Jesus, greatest, highest,
I will come to Thee.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
I am resolved to go to the
Saviour,
Leaving my sin and strife;
He is the true One, He is the
just One,
He hath the words of life.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
I am resolved to follow the
Saviour,
Faithful and true each day;
Heed what He sayeth, do what
He willeth,
He is the living way.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
I am resolved to enter the
kingdom,
Leaving the paths of sin;
Friends may oppose me, foes
may beset me,
Still will I enter in.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
I am resolved, and who will go
with me?
Come, friends, without delay,
Taught by the Bible, led by the
Spirit,
We'll walk the heavenly way.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I'm pressing on the upward
way,
New heights I'm gaining
everyday;
Still praying as I'm onward
bound,
"Lord, plant my feet on higher
ground."

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Lord, lift me up and let me
stand,
By faith, on Heaven's table
land,
A higher plane than I have
found;
Lord, plant my feet on higher
ground.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
My heart has no desire to stay
Where doubts arise and fears
dismay;
Though some may dwell
where these abound,
My prayer, my aim, is higher
ground.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
I want to scale the utmost
height,
And catch a gleam of glory
bright;
But still I'll pray till Heav'n I've
found,
Lord, lead me on to higher
ground

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Beyond the mist I fain would
rise,
To rest beneath unclouded
skies,
Above earth's turmoil peace is
found,
By those who dwell on higher
ground.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Standing on the promises of
Christ my King,
Through eternal ages let His
praises ring;
Glory in the highest I will shout
and sing,
Standing on the promises of
God.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Standing, standing,
Standing on the promises of
God my Saviour;
Standing, standing,
I am standing on the promises
of God.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Standing on the promises that
cannot fail,
When the howling storms of
doubt and fear
assail,
By the living word of God I
shall prevail,
Standing on the promises of
God.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Standing on the promises I
now can see
Perfect, present cleansing in
the blood for me;
Standing in the liberty where
Christ makes free,
Standing on the promises of
God.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Standing on the promises of
Christ the Lord,
Bound to Him eternally by
love's strong cord,
Overcoming daily with the
Spirit's sword,
Standing on the promises of
God.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Standing on the promises I
cannot fall,
Listening every moment to the
Spirit's call,
Resting in my Saviour, as my
all-in-all,
Standing on the promises of
God.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
We are often tossed and
driven on the restless
sea of time,
Sombre skies and howling
tempests oft
succeed a bright sunshine;
In that land of perfect day,
when the mists
have rolled away,
We will understand it better by
and by.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
By and by when the morning
comes,
When all the saints of God are
gathered
home,
We will tell the story how we
overcome,
For we'll understand it better
by and by.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
We are often destitute of the
things that life
demands,
Want of food and want of
shelter, thirsty hills
and barren lands;
But we're trusting in the Lord,
and according
to His word,
We will understand it better by
and by.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Trials dark on every hand, and
we cannot
understand,
All the way that God would
lead us to that
blessed promised land;
But He guides us with His eye
and we'll
follow till we die,
For we'll understand it better
by and by.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Temptations' hidden snares
often take us
unawares,
And our hearts are made to
bleed for many a
thoughtless word or deed,
And we wonder why the tests
when we try to
do our best,
But we'll understand it better
by and by.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Rock of ages, cleft for me,
Let me hide myself in Thee;
Let the water and the blood,
From Thy wounded side which
flowed
Be of sin the double cure,
Save from wrath and make me
pure.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Could my tears forever flow,
Could my zeal no languor
know,
These for sin could not atone;
Thou must save, and Thou
alone:
In my hand no price I bring,
Simply to Thy cross I cling.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
While I draw this fleeting
breathe,
When my eyes shall close in
death,
When I rise to worlds
unknown,
And behold Thee on Thy
throne,
Rock of Ages, cleft for me,
Let me hide myself in Thee.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Christ our Redeemer died on
the cross,
Died for the sinner, paid all his
due;
Sprinkle your soul with the
blood of the Lamb,
And I will pass, will pass over
you.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
When I see the blood,
When I see the blood,
When I see the blood,
I will pass, I will pass over you.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Judgment is coming, all will be
there,
Each one receiving justly his
due;
Hide in the saving,
sin-cleansing blood,
And I will pass, will pass over
you.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
O, great compassion! O
boundless love!
O loving kindness, faithful and
true!
Find peace and shelter under
the blood,
And I will pass, will pass over
you.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I was sinking deep in sin,
Far from the peaceful shore,
Very deeply stained within,
Sinking to rise no more;
But the Master of the sea
Heard my despairing cry,
From the waters lifted me,
Now save am I.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Love lifted me! Love lifted me!
When nothing else could help,
love lifted me,
Love lifted me! Love lifted me!
When nothing else could help,
love lifted me.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
All my heart to Him I give,
Ever to Him I'll cling,
In His blessed presence live,
Ever His praises sing.
Love so mighty and so true
Merits my soul's best songs.
Faithful, loving service, too,
To Him belong.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
Verse 1
lyrics.content:
"There shall be showers of
blessing"
This is the promise of love;
There shall be seasons
refreshing,
Sent from the Saviour above:

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Showers of blessing,
Showers of blessing we need;
Mercydrops round us are
falling,
But for the showers we plead.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
"There shall be showers of
blessing"
Precious reviving again;
Over the hills and the valleys,
Sound of abundance of rain:

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
"There shall be showers of
blessing"
Send them upon us, O Lord;
Grant to us now a refreshing,
Come, and now honour Thy
word:

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
"There shall be showers of
blessing"
O, that today they might fall,
Now as to God we're
confessing,
Now as on Jesus we call!

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Have Thine own way, Lord!
Have Thine own way!
Thou art the Potter;
I am the clay.
Mould me and make me
After Thine will,
While I am waiting,
Yielded and still.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Have Thine own way, Lord!
Have Thine own way!
Search me and try me,
Master, today!
Whiter than snow, Lord,
Wash me just now,
As in Thy presence
Humbly I bow.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Have Thine own way, Lord!
Have Thine own way!
Wounded and weary,
Help me, I pray!
Power, all power,
Surely is Thine.
Touch me and heal me,
Saviour divine!

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Have Thine own way, Lord!
Have Thine own way!
Hold o'er my being
Absolute sway!
Fill with Thy Spirit
Till all shall see,
Christ only, always,
Living in me!

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I am Thine, O Lord, I have
heard Thy voice,
And it told Thy love to me;
But I long to rise in the arms of
faith,
And be closer drawn to Thee.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Draw me nearer, nearer,
blessed Lord,
To the cross where Thou hast
died;
Draw me nearer, nearer,
nearer, blessed Lord,
To Thy precious bleeding side.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Consecrate me now to Thy
service, Lord,
By the power of grace divine;
Let my soul look up with a
steadfast hope,
And my will be lost in Thine.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
O, the pure delight of a single
hour
That before Thy throne I
spend,
When I kneel in prayer, and
with Thee, my
Lord,
I commune as friend with
friend!

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
There are depths of love that I
cannot know,
Till I cross the narrow sea,
There are heights of joy that I
may not reach,
Till I rest in peace with Thee.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I have lost my reputation since
I turned my
back on sin,
And a lot of friends went from
me, since I let
my Saviour in,
Now they pass me by
unknown, when they
once passed with a smile;
Now they say I'm very foolish,
and they say
I'm out of style.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
I am marked, marked, marked,
I am marked now wherever I
go;
I am marked, marked, marked,
Just what I am everyone
seems to know.
I am sealed, sealed, sealed,
I am sealed by His Spirit
Divine;
O glory to God! Hallelujah!
Amen!
I am His, and I know He is
mine.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Well, they say my life is
ruined, and my
talent thrown away,
And they cannot understand it,
for I had such
plans one day;
But I know what I surrendered
when I
promised I'd go through;
And I gained far more glory
since God made
me ever new.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
When with the Saviour we
enter the
gloryland,
Won't it be wonderful there?
Ended the troubles and cares
of the storyland,
Won't it be wonderful there?

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Won't it be wonderful there,
Having no burdens to bear?
Joyously singing with
heart-bells all ringing,
O, won't it be wonderful there?

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Walking and talking with
Christ, the
Supernal One,
Won't it be wonderful there?
Praising, adoring the
matchless Eternal One,
Won't it be wonderful there?

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
There where the tempest will
never be
sweeping us,
Won't it be wonderful there?
Sure that forever the Lord will
be keeping us,
Won't it be wonderful there?

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Noah had drifted
On the floods many days,
He searched for land
In various ways;
Troubles he had some,
But not from above,
God gave him His sign
On the wings of a dove.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
On the wings of a snow-white
dove,
God sends down His pure,
sweet love,
A sign from above;
On the wings of a dove.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Jesus, our Saviour
Came to earth one day;
He was born in a stable,
In a manger of hay;
Though here rejected,
But not from above,
God gave us His sign
On the wings of a dove.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Though I have suffered
In many a way,
I cried for healing
Both night and day;
Faith wasn't forgotten
By the Father above,
He gave me His sign
On the wings of a dove.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
My heavenly home is bright
and fair,
I feel like travelling on;
No pain, nor death can enter
there,
I feel like travelling on.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Yes, I feel like travelling on,
I feel like travelling on;
My heavenly home is bright
and fair
I feel like travelling on.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Its glittering towers the sun
outshine,
I feel like travelling on;
That heavenly mansion shall
be mine,
I feel like travelling on.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Let others seek a home below,
I feel like travelling on;
Which flames devour, or
waves o'erflow
I feel like travelling on.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
The Lord has been so good to
me,
I feel like travelling on;
Until that blessed home I see,
I feel like travelling on.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Jesus has a table spread
where the saints of
God are fed,
He invites His chosen people,
"Come and
dine;"
With His Manna He doth feed
and supplies
our every need;
O, 'tis sweet to sup with Jesus
all the time!

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
"Come and dine," the Master
calleth, "Come
and dine,"
You may feast at Jesus' table
all the time;
He who fed the multitude,
turned the water
into wine,
To the hungry calleth now,
"Come and dine."

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
The disciples came to land,
thus obeying
Christ's command,
For the Master called to them,
"Come and
dine;"
There they found their hearts'
desire, bread
and fish upon the fire;
Thus He satisfies the hungry
every time.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Soon the Lamb will take His
bride to be ever
at His side,
All the host of Heaven will
assembled be;
O, 'twill be a glorious sight, all
the saints in
spotless white;
And with Jesus they will feast
eternally.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
In shady,green pastures, so
rich and so sweet,
God leads His dear children
along;
Where the water's cool flow
bathes the weary
one's feet,
God leads His dear children
along.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Some through the waters,
some through the
flood,
Some through the fire, but all
through the
blood;
Some through great sorrow,
but God gives a
song
In the night season and all the
daylong.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Sometimes on the mount
where the sun
shines so bright,
God leads His dear children
along;
Sometimes in the valley in the
darkest of
night,
God leads His dear children
along.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Though sorrows befall us, and
Satan oppose,
God leads His dear children
along;
Through grace we can
conquer, defeat all our
foes,
God leads His dear children
along.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Away from the mire, and away
from the clay,
God leads His dear children
along;
Away up in glory, eternity's
day,
God leads His dear children
along.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
What a fellowship, what a joy
divine,
Leaning on the everlasting
arms;
What a blessedness, what a
peace is mine,
Leaning on the everlasting
arms.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Leaning, leaning,
Safe and secure from all
alarms;
Leaning, leaning,
Leaning on the everlasting
arms.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
O, how sweet to walk in this
pilgrim way,
Leaning on the everlasting
arms;
O, how bright the path grows
from day to day,
Leaning on the everlasting
arms.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
What have I to dread, what
have I to fear,
Leaning on the everlasting
arms;
I have blessed peace with my
Lord so near,
Leaning on the everlasting
arms.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I wandered in the shades of
night
Till Jesus came to me,
And with the sunlight of His
love
Bid all my darkness flee.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Sunlight, sunlight in my soul
today,
Sunlight, sunlight all along the
way;
Since the Saviour found me,
took away my sin,
I have had the sunlight of His
love within.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Though clouds may gather in
the sky
And billows round me roll;
However dark the world may
be,
I've sunlight in my soul.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
While walking in the light of
God,
I sweet communion find;
I press with holy vigour on
And leave the world behind.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
I cross the wide extended
fields,
I journey o'er the plains,
And in the sunlight of His love
I reap the golden grain.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Soon I shall see Him as He is
--
The Light that came to me;
Behold the brightness of His
face,
Throughout eternity.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I know not why God's
wondrous grace
To me He hath made known;
Nor why, unworthy, Christ in
love
Redeemed me for His own.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
But "I know whom I have
believed
And I'm persuaded that He is
able
To keep that which I've
committed
Unto Him against that day."

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
I know not how this saving
faith
To me He did impart;
Nor how believing in His Word
Wrought peace within my
heart.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
I know not how the Spirit
moves,
Convicting men of sin;
Revealing Jesus through the
Word,
Creating faith in him.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
I know not what of good or ill
May be reserved for me;
Of weary ways or golden days
Before His face I see.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
I know not when my Lord may
come,
At night or noonday fair,
Nor if I'll walk the vale with
Him,
Or "meet Him in the air."

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Sowing in the morning, sowing
seeds of
kindness,
Sowing in the noontide and
the dewy eve;
Waiting for the harvest and the
time of
reaping,
We shall come rejoicing,
bringing in the
sheaves.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Bringing in the sheaves,
bringing in the
sheaves,
We shall come rejoicing,
bringing in the
sheaves;
Bringing in the sheaves,
bringing in the
sheaves,
We shall come rejoicing,
bringing in the
sheaves.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Sowing in the sunshine,
sowing in the
shadows,
Fearing neither clouds nor
winter's chilling
breeze;
By and by the harvest and the
labour ended,
We shall come rejoicing,
bringing in the
sheaves.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Going forth with weeping,
sowing for the
Master,
Though the loss sustained,
our spirit often
grieves;
When our weeping's over, He
will bid us
welcome,
We shall come rejoicing,
bringing in the
sheaves.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Some glorious morning sorrow
will cease,
Some glorious morning all will
be peace;
Heartaches all ended,
schooldays all done,
Heaven will open, Jesus will
come.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Some golden daybreak, Jesus
will come;
Some golden daybreak,
battles all won,
He'll shout the victory, break
through the
blue,
Some golden daybreak, for
me, for you.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Sad hearts will gladden, all
shall be bright,
Good-bye forever to earth's
dark night;
Changed in a moment, like
Him to be,
O glorious daybreak, Jesus I'll
see.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
O, what a meeting there in the
skies!
No tears nor crying shall dim
our eyes;
Loved ones united eternally,
O, what a daybreak that morn
will be.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Shall we gather at the river,
Where bright angel feet have
trod,
With its crystal tide forever,
Flowing by the throne of God?

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Yes, we'll gather at the river,
The beautiful, the beautiful
river;
Gather with the saints at the
river
That flows by the throne of
God.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
On the bosom of the river,
Where the Saviour-King we
own,
We shall meet and sorrow
never,
'Neath the glory of the throne.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
On the margin of the river,
Washing up its silver spray,
We will walk and worship ever,
All the happy, golden day.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Ere we reach the shining river,
Lay we every burden down;
Grace our spirits will deliver
And provide a robe and crown.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
At the shining of the river,
Mirror of the Saviour's face,
Saints whom death will never
sever
Lift their songs of saving
grace.

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lyrics.content:
Soon we'll reach the shining
river,
Soon our pilgrimage will
cease;
Soon our happy hearts will
quiver
With the melody of peace.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Down at the cross where my
Saviour died,
Down where for cleansing
from sin I cried;
There to my heart was the
blood applied;
Glory to His name!

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Glory to His name!
Glory to His name!
There to my heart was the
blood applied;
Glory to His name!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
I am so wondrously saved
from sin,
Jesus so sweetly abides
within,
There at the cross where He
took me in;
Glory to His name!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
O, precious fountain that
saves from sin!
I am so glad I have entered in;
There Jesus saves me and
keeps me clean,
Glory to His name!

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Come to this fountain so rich
and sweet,
Cast thy poor soul at the
Saviour's feet;
Plunge in today and be made
complete;
Glory to His name!

title: HE BROUGHT ME OUT OF THE MIRY CLAY

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
My heart was distressed
'neath Jehovah's
dread frown,
And low in the pit where my
sins dragged me
down;
I cried to the Lord from the
deep miry clay,
Who tenderly brought me out
to golden day.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
He brought me out of the miry
clay,
He set my feet on the rock to
stay;
He puts a song in my soul
today,
A song of praise, hallelujah!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
He placed me upon the strong
rock by His
side,
My steps were established,
and here I'll
abide;
No danger of falling while here
I remain,
But stand by His grace until
the crown I gain.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
He gave me a song, 'twas a
new song of
praise,
By day and by night its sweet
notes I will
raise;
My heart's overflowing, --I am
happy and
free,
I'll praise my Redeemer who
has rescued me.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
I'll sing of His wonderful mercy
to me,
I'll praise Him till all men His
goodness shall
see;
I'll sing of salvation at home
and abroad,
Till many shall hear the truth
and trust in
God.

title: IN THE SWEET BY AND BY

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
There's a land that is fairer
than day,
And by faith we can see it afar;
For the Father waits over the
way,
To prepare us a dwelling place
there.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
In the sweet by and by,
We shall meet on that
beautiful shore;
In the sweet by and by,
We shall meet on that
beautiful shore.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
We shall sing on that beautiful
shore,
The melodious songs of the
blest,
And our spirits shall sorrow no
more,
Not a sigh for the blessing of
rest.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
To our bountiful Father above,
We will offer our tribute of
praise,
For the glorious gift of His
love,
And the blessings that hallow
our days.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
There is a fountain filled with
blood,
Drawn from Emmanuel's
veins,
And sinners plunged beneath
that flood,
Lose all their guilty stains.
Lose all their guilty satins,
Lose all their guilty stains;
And sinners plunged beneath
that flood,
Lose all their guilty stains.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
The dying thief rejoiced to see
That fountain in his day;
And there may I, though vile
as he,
Wash all my sins away.
Wash all my sins away,
Wash all my sins away;
And there may I, though vile
as he,
Wash all my sins away.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Thou dying Lamb, Thy
precious blood
Shall never lose its power,
Till all the ransomed church of
God
Be saved, to sin no more.
Be saved, to sin no more,
Be saved, to sin no more;
Till all the ransomed church of
God
Be saved, to sin no more.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
E'er since by faith I saw the
stream
Thy flowing wounds supply,
Redeeming love has been my
theme,
And shall be till I die.
And shall be till I die,
And shall be till I die;
Redeeming love has been my
theme,
And shall be till I die.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Then in a nobler, sweeter
song,
I'll sing Thy power to save,
When this poor lisping,
stammering tongue
Lies silent in the grave.
Lies silent in the grave,
Lies silent in the grave;
When this poor lisping,
stammering tongue
Lies silent in the grave.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Face to face with Christ, my
Saviour,
Face to face, what will it be,
When with rapture I behold
Him,
Jesus Christ who died for me?

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Face to face I shall behold
Him,
Far beyond the starry sky;
Face to face in all His glory,
I shall see Him by and by!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Only faintly now I see Him,
With the darkened veil
between,
But a blessed day is coming
When His glory shall be seen.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
What rejoicing in His
presence,
When are banished grief and
pain;
When the crooked ways are
straightened,
And the dark things shall be
plain.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Face to face,O, blissful
moment!
Face to face, to see and know;
Face to face with my
Redeemer,
Jesus Christ who loves me so.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
They bound the hands of
Jesus in the garden
where He prayed,
They led Him through the
streets in shame;
They spat upon the Saviour,
so pure and free
from sin,
They said, "Crucify him: he's
to blame."

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
He could have called ten
thousand angels
To destroy the world and set
Him free;
He could have called ten
thousand angels,
But He died alone for you and
me.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Upon His precious head they
placed a crown
of thorns,
They laughed and said,
"Behold the king."
They struck Him and they
cursed Him, and
mocked His holy name,
All alone He suffered
everything.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
When they nailed Him to the
cross, His
mother stood nearby;
He said, "Woman, behold thy
son"
He cried, "I thirst for water,"
but they gave
Him none to drink,
Then the sinful work of man
was done.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
To the howling mob He
yielded, He did not
for mercy cry,
The cross of shame He took
alone;
And when he cried, "It's
finished," He gave
Himself to die,
Salvation's wondrous plan was
done.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Glory! Glory, hallelujah!
Glory! Glory, hallelujah!
Glory! Glory, hallelujah!
His truth is marching on.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
I have seen Him in the
watchfires of a
hundred circling camps
They have builded Him an
altar in the
evening dews and damps;
I can read His righteous
sentence by the dim
and flaring lamps;
His day is marching on.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
He has sounded forth the
trumpet that shall
never sound retreat;
He is sifting out the hearts of
men before His
judgment seat;
O, be swift my soul to answer
Him! Be
jubilant my feet!
Our God is marching on.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
In the beauty of the lilies Christ
was born
across the sea,
With a glory in His bosom that
transfigures
you and me:
As He died to make men holy,
let us die to
make men free;
While God is marching on.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
He is coming like the glory of
the morning on
the wave,
He is wisdom to the mighty,
He is honour to
the brave;
So the world shall be His
footstool, and the
soul of wrong His slain,
Our God is marching on.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Amen! Amen! Amen! Amen!
Amen!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Are you going to love Him?
Amen!
Are you going to praise Him?
Amen!
Are you going to worship Him?
Amen! Amen! Amen!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Do you love Him?
Amen!
Will you serve Him?
Amen!
Do you believe Him?
Amen! Amen! Amen!

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
The Bible is true.
Amen!
I believe it.
Amen!
It is the Word of God.
Amen! Amen! Amen!

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
We believe You're coming.
Amen!
We're ready to meet You.
Amen!
Come, Lord Jesus.
Amen! Amen! Amen!

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
The circuit-rider preacher went
riding
through the land,
With a riffle on his shoulder
and a Bible in
his hand;
He told the prairie people of a
blessed
promised land,
As he went riding, singing
along.
Leaning, leaning,
Leaning on the everlasting
arm;
Leaning, leaning,
Leaning on the everlasting
arm.
He preached the coming
judgment of fire and
brimstone;
And a glorious, endless
Heaven of the
justified alone;
As he rode across the
mountains you could
hear him sing this song,
As He went riding on.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Leaning, leaning,
Leaning on the everlasting
arm;
Leaning, leaning,
Leaning on the everlasting
arm.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
He preached the coming
judgment of fire and
brimstone;
And a glorious, endless
Heaven of the
justified alone;
As he rode across the
mountains you could
hear him sing this song,
As He went riding on.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
There is power, power,
wonder-working
power,
In the blood of the Lamb;
There is power, power,
wonder-working
power,
In the precious blood of the
Lamb.
His riffle's old and rusty, and
it's hanging on
the wall;
His Bible's worn and dusty,
and it's seldom
touched at all;
But his message from this
Bible will meet us
at Judgment Day,
For God's truth keeps
marching on.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
His riffle's old and rusty, and
it's hanging on
the wall;
His Bible's worn and dusty,
and it's seldom
touched at all;
But his message from this
Bible will meet us
at Judgment Day,
For God's truth keeps
marching on.

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lyrics.content:
Glory! Glory, hallelujah!
Glory! Glory, hallelujah!
Glory! Glory, hallelujah!
His truth is marching on.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I'm following Jesus
One step at a time:
I live for the moment
In His love divine.
Why think of tomorrow,
Just live for today;
I'm following Jesus,
Each step of the way.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
The pathway is narrow,
But He leads me on;
I walk in His shadow,
My fears are all gone.
My spirit grows stronger,
Each moment, each day,
For Jesus is leading
Each step of the way.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Jesus is my Saviour, I shall
not be moved;
In His love and favour, I shall
not be moved;
Just like a tree that's planted
by the waters,
I shall not be moved.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
I shall not be, I shall not be
moved,
I shall not be, I shall not be
moved;
Just like a tree that's planted
by the waters,
I shall not be moved.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
In my Christ-abiding, I shall
not be moved;
In His love I'm hiding, I shall
not be moved;
Just like a tree that's planted
by the waters,
I shall not be moved.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
If I trust Him ever, I shall not
be moved;
He will fail me never, I shall
not be moved;
Just like a tree that's planted
by the waters,
I shall not be moved.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
On His Word I'm feeding, I
shall not be
moved;
He's the One that's leading, I
shall not be
moved;
Just like a tree that's planted
by the waters,
I shall not be moved.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Glory hallelujah! I shall not be
moved;
Anchored in Jehovah, -I shall
not be moved;
Just like a tree that's planted
by the waters,
I shall not be moved.

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lyrics.content:
In His love abiding, I shall not
be moved;
And in Him confiding, I shall
not be moved;
Just like a tree that's planted
by the waters,
I shall not be moved.

lyrics.label: Verse 7
lyrics.content:
Though all hell assail me, I
shall not be
moved;
Jesus will not fail me, I shall
not be moved;
Just like a tree that's planted
by the waters,
I shall not be moved.

lyrics.label: Verse 8
lyrics.content:
Though the tempest rages, I
shall not be
moved;
On the Rock of Ages, I shall
not be moved;
Just like a tree that's planted
by the waters,
I shall not be moved.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
O, how sweet the glorious
message,
Simple faith may claim;
Yesterday, today, forever,
Jesus is the same.
Still He loves to save the
sinful,
Heal the sick and lame;
Cheer the mourner, still the
tempest;
Glory to His name!

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Yesterday, today, forever,
Jesus is the same;
All may change, but Jesus
never!
Glory to His name.
Glory to his name,
Glory to His name;
All may change, but Jesus
never!
Glory to His name.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
He who was the Friend of
sinners,
Seeks thee, lost one, now;
Sinner, come, and at His
footstool
Penitently bow.
He who said, "I'll not condemn
thee,
Go and sin no more;"
Speaks to thee that word of
pardon,
As in days of yore.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Oft on earth He healed the
sufferer
By His mighty hand;
Still our sicknesses and
sorrows
Go at His command.
He who gave His healing
virtue,
To a woman's touch;
To the faith that claims His
fullness,
Still will give as much.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
He who pardoned erring
Peter,
Never need'st thou fear;
He that came to faithless
Thomas,
All thy doubt will clear.
He who let the loved disciple
On His bosom rest,
Bids thee still, with love as
tender,
Lean upon His breast.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
He who 'mid the raging
billows,
Walked upon the sea;
Still can hush our wildest
tempest,
As on Galilee.
He who wept and prayed in
anguish,
In Gethsemane,
Drinks with us each cup of
trembling,
In our agony.

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lyrics.content:
As of old He walked to
Emmaus,
With them to abide;
So through all life's way He
walketh,
Ever near our side.
Soon again we shall behold
Him,
Hasten, Lord, the day!
But 'twill still be "this same
Jesus,"
As He went away.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
It's the old-time Holy Spirit,
And the Devil won't go near It.
That's the reason people fear
It,
But It's good enough for me.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Give me that old-time religion,
Give me that old-time religion,
Give me that old-time religion,
It's good enough for me.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
lyrics.content:
It's so good I want no other,
For It makes me love my
brother;
And It brings things from
under cover,
And It's good enough for me.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
(It was good in the fiery
furnace...).
(It was good for Paul and
Silas...)
(It was good for our fathers...)
It was good for Brother
Branham...)
(Makes me love everybody...)
(It will do when lam dying...)
(It will take us all to Heaven...)

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
It's the old ship of Zion,
It's the old ship of Zion,
It's the old ship of Zion,
Get on board, get on board!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
It has landed my old father,
It has landed my old father,
It has landed my old father,
Get on board, get on board!

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I've got a Father over yonder,
I've got a Father over yonder,
I've got a Father over yonder,
On the other shore.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Some bright day I'll go and
see Him,
Some bright day I'll go and
see Him,
Some bright day I'll go and
see Him,
On the other shore.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Won't that be a happy
meeting?
Won't that be a happy
meeting?
Won't that be a happy
meeting?
On the other shore.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
That bright day may be
tomorrow,
That bright day may be
tomorrow,
That bright day may be
tomorrow,
On the other shore.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Shine on me, Lord, shine on
me,
Let the light from the
lighthouse shine on me;
Shine on me, Lord, shine on
me,
Let the light from the
lighthouse shine on me.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
From Bethlehem's manger
came forth a
Stranger,
On earth I long to be like Him,
My faithful Saviour, how rich
His favour!
On earth I long to be like Him.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
To be like Jesus, to be like
Jesus,
On earth I long to be like Him;
All through life's journey from
earth to glory,
I only ask to be like Him.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
Verse 1
lyrics.content:
"Great is Thy faithfulness," O
God my
Father,
There is no shadow of turning
with Thee;
Thou changest not, Thy
compassions they
fail not,
As Thou hast been Thou
forever wilt be.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
"Great is Thy faithfulness!
Great is Thy
faithfulness!"
Morning by morning new
mercies I see;
All I have needed Thy hand
hath provided:
"Great is Thy faithfulness,"
Lord, unto me!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Summer and winter, and
springtime and
harvest,
Sun, moon and stars in their
courses above,
Join with all nature in manifold
witness
To Thy great faithfulness,
mercy and love.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Pardon for sin and a peace
that endureth,
Thy own dear presence to
cheer and to guide;
Strength for today and bright
hope for
tomorrow,
Blessings all mine, with ten
thousand beside!

title: OPEN MY EYES, THAT I SEE

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Open my eyes, that I may see
Glimpses of Truth Thou hast
for me;
Place in my hands the
wonderful key
That shall unclasp, and set me
free.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Silently now I wait for Thee,
Ready, my God, Thy will to
see;
Open my eyes, illumine me,
Spirit Divine!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Open my ears, that I may hear
Voices of Truth Thou sendest
clear;
And while the wave-notes fall
on my ears,
Everything false will
disappear.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Open my mouth, and let me
bear
Gladly the warm Truth
everywhere;
Open my heart, and let me
prepare,
Love with Thy children thus to
share.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
He's everything, He's
everything to me;
He's everything, He's
everything to me;
For He's my Father, my
Mother, my Sister
and my Brother,
He's everything to me.

title: I KNOW IT WAS THE BLOOD

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I know it was the blood, I know
it was the
blood,
I know it was the blood for me;
One day when I was lost,
Jesus died upon the
cross,
I know it was the blood for me.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
O, won't you watch with Me
one hour,
While I go yonder, while I go
yonder?
O, won't you watch with Me
one hour,
While I go yonder and pray?

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I'm overcoming, I'm
overcoming;
I'm overcoming, I'm
overcoming;
For I love Jesus, He's my
Saviour,
And He smiles and He loves
me too.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Spirit of the living God, fall
afresh on me;
Spirit of the living God, fall
afresh on me;
Break me! Melt me! Mould me!
Fill me!
Spirit of the living God, fall
afresh on me.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Let the beauty of Jesus be
seen in me.
All His wonderful passion and
purity;
O Thou Spirit divine, all my
nature refine,
Till the beauty of Jesus is seen
in me.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Shut in with God in the secret
place,
There in the Spirit beholding
His face,
Gaining new power to run in
the race,
I love to be shut in with God.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
O soul, are you weary and
troubled,
No light in the darkness you
see?
There's light for a look at the
Saviour,
And life more abundant and
free!

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Turn your eyes upon Jesus,
Look full in His wonderful face,
And the things of earth will
grow strangely
dim
In the light of His glory and
grace.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Through death into life
everlasting
He passed, and we follow Him
there;
Over us sin no more hath
dominion,
For more than conquerors we
are!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
His word shall not fail you, He
promised;
Believe Him, and all will be
well;
Then go to a world that is
dying,
His perfect salvation to tell!

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
We'll give the glory to Jesus,
And tell of His love, and tell of
His love;
We'll give the glory to Jesus,
And tell of His wonderful love.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Sweep over my soul, sweep
over my soul,
Sweet Spirit, sweep over my
soul;
My rest is complete while I sit
at Your feet;
Sweet Spirit, sweep over my
soul.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
A friend of Jesus, O what
bliss,
That one so vile as I
Should ever have a Friend like
this
To lead me to the sky.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Friendship with Jesus,
Fellowship divine;
O, what blessed sweet
communion,s
Jesus is a Friend of mine.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
A Friend when other
friendships cease,
A Friend when others fail,
A Friend who gives me joy and
peace,
A Friend when foes assail.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
A Friend when sickness lays
me low,
A Friend when death draws
near;
A Friend as through the vale I
go,
A Friend to help and cheer.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
A Friend when life's short race
is o'er,
A Friend when earth is past,
A Friend to meet on Heaven's
shore,
A Friend when home at last.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
When the day is dark before
you,
And the clouds are hanging
low,
There is One who watches
o'er you,
Everywhere that you may go.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Jesus is the One, yes, He's
the only One,
Let Him have His way until the
day is done;
When He speaks, you know
the clouds will
have to go,
Just because He loves you so.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
O if you are sad and lonely,
Life is but an empty tomb,
Breathe a prayer to Jesus
only,
He will drive away the gloom.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
When you come to cross the
river,
He will be your Friend and
Guide;
You can live with Him forever,
Over on the other side.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Would you be numbered as
one of His fold?
Would you be numbered as
one of His fold?
Be spotless within, be
watching and waiting
that sight to behold;
He's coming again.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I've found a friend in Jesus,
--He's everything
to me;
He's the "Fairest of Ten
Thousand" to my soul!
The "Lily of the Valley" in Him
alone I see
All I need to cleanse and make
me fully whole.
In sorrow He's my comfort, in
trouble He's my
stay;
He tells me every care on Him
to roll.
Hallelujah!
He's the "Lily of the Valley,"
the "Bright and
Morning Star!"
He's the "Fairest of Ten
Thousand" to my soul!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
He all my griefs has taken,
and all my sorrows
borne;
In temptation, He's my strong
and mighty
tower;
I have all for Him forsaken,
and all my idols
torn
From my heart, --and now He
keeps me by His
power.
Though all the world forsake
me, and Satan
tempt me sore,
Through Jesus I shall safely
reach the goal.
Hallelujah!
He's the "Lily of the Valley,"
the "Bright and
Morning Star!"
He's the "Fairest of Ten
Thousand" to my soul!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
He'll never, never leave me,
nor yet forsake me
here,
While I live by faith and do His
blessed will;
A wall of fire about me, I've
nothing now to
fear;
With His Manna, He my
hungry soul shall fill.
Then sweeping up to glory,
we'll see His
blessed face
Where rivers of delight shall
ever roll.
Hallelujah!
He's the "Lily of the Valley,"
the "Bright and
Morning Star!"
He's the "Fairest of Ten
Thousand" to my soul!

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
He careth for you,
He careth for you;
Through sunshine or shadow,
He careth for you.

title: WHEN I GET TO THE END

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
The sands have been washed
in the footprints
Of the Stranger on Galilee's
shore;
And the voice that subdued
the rough billows
Will be heard in Judea no
more.
But the path of that Lone
Galilean
With joy I will follow today.
And the toils of the road will
seem nothing,
When I get to the end of the
way;
And the toils of the road will
seem nothing,
When I get to the end of the
way.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
There are so many hills to
climb upward,
I, often, am longing for rest,
But He who appoints me my
pathway
Knows just what is needful
and best.
I know in His word He hath
promised
That my strength, "it shall be
as my day."
And the toils of the road will
seem nothing,
When I get to the end of the
way;
And the toils of the road will
seem nothing,
When I get to the end of the
way.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
He loves me too well to
forsake me
Or give me one trial too much.
All His people have been
dearly purchased,
And Satan can never claim
such.
By and by I shall see Him and
praise Him
In the city of unending day.
And the toils of the road will
seem nothing,
When I get to the end of the
way;
And the toils of the road will
seem nothing,
When I get to the end of the
way.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
When the last feeble step has
been taken,
And the gates of that city
appear,
And the beautiful songs of the
angels
Float out on my listening ear.
When all that now seem so
mysterious
Will be bright and as clear as
the day.
Then the toils of the road will
seem nothing,
When I get to the end of the
way;
Then the toils of the road will
seem nothing,
When I get to the end of the
way.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
The cross upon which Jesus
died
Is a shelter in which we can
hide,
And its grace so free is
sufficient for me,
And deep is its fountain; as
wide as the sea.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
There's room at the cross for
you,
There's room at the cross for
you,
Though millions have come,
there's still
room for one,
Yes, there's room at the cross
for you.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Though millions have found
Him a Friend
And have turned from the sins
they have
sinned,
The Saviour still waits to open
the gates,
And welcome a sinner before
it's too late.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
The hand of my Saviour is
strong
And the love of my Saviour is
long,
Through sunshine or rain,
through loss or in
gain,
The blood flows from Calvary
to cleanse
every stain.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
When the trumpet of the Lord
shall sound,
and time shall be no more,
And the morning breaks
eternal, bright and
fair;
When the saved of earth shall
gather over on
the other shore,
And the roll is called, up
yonder, I'll be there.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
When the roll is called, up
yonder,
When the roll is called, up
yonder,
When the roll is called, up
yonder,
When the roll is called, up
yonder, I'll be there.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
On that bright and cloudless
morning when
the dead in Christ shall rise,
And the glory of His
resurrection share;
When His chosen ones shall
gather to their
home beyond the skies,
And the roll is called, up
yonder, I'll be there.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Let us labour for the Master
from the dawn
till setting sun,
Let us talk of all His wondrous
love and care;
Then when all of life is over,
and our work
on earth is done,
And the roll is called, up
yonder, I'll be there.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
My soul in sad exile was out
on life's sea,
So burdened with sin and
distressed,
Till I heard a sweet voice
saying, "Make Me
your choice;"
And I entered the "Haven of
Rest!"

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
I've anchored my soul in the
Haven of Rest,
I'll sail the wild seas no more;
The tempest may sweep o'er
the wild, stormy
deep,
In Jesus I'm safe evermore.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
I yielded myself to His tender
embrace,
And faith taking hold of the
Word,
My fetters fell off, and I
anchored my soul,
The Haven of Rest is my Lord.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
The song of my soul, since the
Lord made me
whole,
Has been the old story, so
blest,
Of Jesus, who'll save
whosoever will have
A home in the Haven of Rest!

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
How precious the thought that
we all may
recline,
Like John, the beloved and
blest,
On Jesus' strong arm, where
no tempest can
harm,
Secure in the 'Haven of Rest!'

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
O come to the Saviour; He
patiently waits
To save by His power divine;
Come, anchor your soul in the
Haven of Rest,
And say, "My Beloved is
mine."

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Must Jesus bear the cross
alone,
And all the world go free?
No, there's a cross for
everyone,
And there is a cross for me.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
The consecrated cross I'll
bear,
Till death shall set me free;
And then go home my crown
to wear,
For, there's a crown for me.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Upon the crystal pavement,
down
At Jesus' pierced feet,
With joy I'll cast my golden
crown,
And His dear name repeat.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
O precious cross! O glorious
crown!
O resurrection day!
Ye angels from the stars come
down
And bear my soul away.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
All praise to Him who reigns
above,
In majesty supreme;
Who gave His Son for man to
die,
That He might man redeem.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Blessed be the name, blessed
be the name,
Blessed be the name of the
Lord;
Blessed be the name, blessed
be the name,
Blessed be the name of the
Lord.
(Jesus is the name...)
(Magnify His name...)

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
His name above all names,
shall stand
Exalted more and more;
At God the Father's own right
hand
Where angel hosts adore.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Redeemer, Saviour, Friend of
men
Once ruined by the fall;
Thou hast devised salvation's
plan,
For, Thou hast died for all.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
His name shall be the
Counsellor,
The mighty Prince of Peace
Of all earth's kingdoms,
Conqueror,
Whose reign shall never
cease.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Lord, I have started to walk in
the light,
Shining upon me from Heaven
so bright;
I bade the world and its follies
adieu;
I've started in Jesus and I'm
going through.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
I'm going through, yes, I'm
going through,
I'll pay the price whatever
others do,
I'll take the way with the Lord's
despised
few,
I'm going through, Jesus, I'm
going through.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
O there are many who start in
the race,
But with the light refused to
keep pace;
Others accept it because it is
new,
But not very many expect to
go through.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
I'd rather walk with Jesus
alone,
Have for a pillow, like Jacob, a
stone;
Living each moment with His
face in view,
Than shrink from my pathway
and fail to go
through.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
O brother, now will you take
up the cross?
Give up the world and count it
as dross;
Sell all thou hast and give to
the poor,
Then go through with Jesus
and those who
endure.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Hear the Lord of harvest
sweetly calling;
"Who will go and work for Me
today?
Who will bring to Me the lost
and dying?
Who will point them to the
narrow way?"

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Speak, my Lord, speak, my
Lord,
Speak, and I'll be quick to
answer Thee;
Speak, my Lord, speak, my
Lord,
Speak, and I will answer,
"Lord, send me."

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
When the coal of fire touched
the prophet,
Making him as pure as pure
can be,
When the voice of God said,
"Who'll go for
us?"
Then he answered, "Here I
am, send me."

lyrics.label: Verse 3
Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Soon the time for reaping will
be over;
Soon we'll gather for harvest
home;
May the Lord of harvest smile
upon us,
May we hear His blessed,
"Child, well done."

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
The love of God is greater far
Than tongue or pen can ever
tell;
It goes beyond the highest
star,
And reaches to the lowest hell.
The guilty pair, bowed down
with care,
God gave His Son to win;
His erring child He reconciled,
And pardoned from his sin.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
O love of God, how rich and
pure!
How measureless and strong!
It shall forever more endure,
The saints' and angels' song.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
When hoary time shall pass
away,
And earthly thrones and
kingdoms fall;
When men who here refused
to pray,
On rocks and hills and
mountains call;
God's love, so sure, shall still
endure
All measureless and strong;
Redeeming grace to Adam's
race;
The saints' and angels' song.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Could we with ink the ocean
fill,
And were the skies of
parchment made;
Were every stalk on earth a
quill,
And every man a scribe by
trade;
To write the love of God
above,
Would drain the ocean dry;
Nor could the scroll contain
the whole,
Though stretched from sky to
sky.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
You have heard of little Moses
in the bulrush,
You have heard of fearless
David and his
sling;
You have heard a story told of
dreaming
Joseph,
And of "Jonah and the Whale"
you often
sing.
There are many, many others
through the
Bible,
I should like to meet them all, I
do declare!
By and by the Lord will surely
let us meet
them
At the meeting in the air.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
There is going to be a meeting
in the air,
In the sweet, sweet by and by;
I am going to meet you, meet
you over there
In that home beyond the sky;
Such singing you will hear,
never heard by
mortal ear,
'Twill be glorious, I do declare!
And God's own Son will be the
leading One
At the meeting in the air.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Many things will there be
missing in that
meeting:
For the mourners bench will
have no place at
all;
There will never be a sermon
preached to
sinners,
For the sinners had refused to
heed the call.
There will be no mourning
over wayward
loved ones,
There will be no lonely nights
of pleading
prayer;
All our burdens and our
anguish will be lifted
At the meeting in the air.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
There the doubters will be
missing altogether,
All the sceptics will be absent
on that day;
There will be no grumblers
present to disturb us,
And the 'Achans' will be busy
far away.
There the saints will have His
"seal upon
their foreheads,"
Dressed in raiment none but
ransomed ones
can wear;
All who have the wedding
garments will be
present
At the meeting in the air.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
The first one to die for this
Holy Ghost plan
Was John the Baptist, but he
died like a man;
Then came the Lord Jesus,
they crucified
Him,
He taught that the Spirit would
save men
from sin.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
It's dripping with blood, yes,
it's dripping
with blood,
This Holy Ghost gospel is
dripping with
blood;
The blood of disciples who
died for the
Truth,
This Holy Ghost gospel is
dripping with
blood.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
There was Peter and Paul,
and John the
divine,
They gave up their lives so
this Gospel could
shine;
They mingled their blood, like
the prophets
of old,
So the true Word of God could
honest be
told.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Then they stoned Stephen, he
preached
against sin,
He made them so angry, they
dashed his head
in;
But he died in the Spirit, and
gave up the
ghost,
And went to join others in that
life-giving
host.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Their souls under the altar
crying, "How
long?"
For the Lord to punish those
who've done
wrong;
But there's going to be more
who'll give their
life's blood
For this Holy Ghost gospel
and its crimson
flood.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Holy, Holy, Holy, Lord God of
hosts,
Heaven and earth are full of
Thee;
Heaven and earth are praising
Thee,
O Lord, Most High.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
This old world can never hold
me,
Any moment I'll be gone,
For, I've made my
consecration,
And I have the wedding
garment on.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I am watching for the coming
of the glad
millennial day
When our blessed Lord shall
come and catch
His waiting bride away;
O my heart is filled with
rapture as I labour,
watch and pray,
For our Lord is coming back to
earth again.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
O, our Lord is coming back to
earth again,
Yes, our Lord is coming back
to earth again,
Satan will be bound a
thousand years, we'll
have no tempter then,
After Jesus shall come back to
earth again.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Jesus' coming back will be the
answer to
earth's sorrowing cry,
For the knowledge of the Lord
shall fill the
earth and sea and sky;
God shall take away all
sickness and the
sufferer's tears will dry,
When our Saviour shall come
back to earth
again.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Yes, the ransomed of the Lord
shall come to
Zion then with joy,
And in all His holy mountain
nothing hurts or
shall destroy;
