lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
I will meet you in the morning,
in the sweet
by and by,
And exchange the old cross
for a crown;
There will be no
disappointments and nobody
shall die,
In that land, e'er the sun goeth
down.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
I will meet you in the morning,
at the end of
the way,
On the street of that city of
gold;
Where we all can be together
and be happy
for aye,
While the years and the ages
shall roll.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
All along on the road to the
soul's true abode,
There's an eye watching you;
Every step that you take, this
great eye is awake,
There's an eye watching you.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Watching you, watching you,
Every day mind the course
you pursue;
Watching you, watching you,
There's an all-seeing eye
watching you.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
As you make life's great flight,
keep the
pathway of right,
There's an eye watching you;
God will warn not to go in the
path of the foe,
There's an eye watching you.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Fix your mind on the goal, that
sweet home
of the soul,
There's an eye watching you;
Never turn from the way to the
kingdom of
day,
There's an eye watching you.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
There's a curtain that's drawn
between earth
and Heaven,
And just beyond lies a
beautiful clime
Where the evils of this life no
longer can
touch me;
Lord, let me look past the
curtain of time.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Lord, let me look past the
curtain of sorrows
and fears,
Let me view that sunny bright
clime;
It would strengthen my faith
and would
banish all fear;
Lord, let me look past the
curtain of time.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
I'm helpless, alone, and I want
to see Jesus,
And hear the sweet harbour
bells chime,
Where my friends and dear
loved ones are
waiting for me;
Lord, let me look past the
curtain of time.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
I'm so homesick and blue, and
I want to see
Jesus,
I would like to hear those
sweet harbour bells
chime;
It would brighten my path and
would varnish
all fear;
Lord, let me look past the
curtain of time.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
O my brother, do you know the
Saviour,
Who is wondrous, kind and
true?
He's the "Rock of your
salvation!"
There is honey in the Rock for
you.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
O, there is honey in the Rock,
my brother
There is honey in the Rock for
you;
Leave your sins for the blood
to cover,
There is honey in the Rock for
you.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Have you "tasted that the Lord
is gracious?"
Do you walk in the way that's
new?
Have you drank from the living
fountain?
There is honey in the Rock for
you.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Do you pray unto God the
Father,
"What wilt thou have me to
do?"
Never fear, He will surely
answer;
There is honey in the Rock for
you.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Then go out through the
streets and byways,
Preach the Word to the many
or few;
Say to every fallen brother,
There is honey in the Rock for
you.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Once our blessed Christ of
beauty,
Was veiled off from human
view;
But through suffering, death
and sorrow,
He has rent the veil in two.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
O behold the man of sorrows,
O behold Him in plain view,
Lo! He is the mighty
Conqueror,
Since He rent the veil in two;
Lo! He is the mighty
Conqueror,
Since He rent the veil in two.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Yes, He is with God, the
Father
Interceding there for you;
For He is the mighty
Conqueror,
Since He rent the veil in two.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Holy angels bow before Him,
Men of earth give praises due,
For He is the well beloved,--
Since He rent the veil in two.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Throughout time and endless
ages,
Heights and depths of love so
true,
He alone can be the giver,
Since He rent the veil in two.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I am now on the altar,
I am now on the altar,
I am now on the altar
Which was made for me.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Jesus breaks every fetter
Jesus breaks every fetter
Jesus breaks every fetter
For He sets me free.
(I will ever, ever praise Him...)
(I will give God the glory...)
(I will shout hallelujah...)

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
I will never doubt my Saviour,
I will never doubt my Saviour,
I will never doubt my Saviour,
For He cleanses me.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
I will rest on His promise,
I will rest on His promise,
I will rest on His promise,
Which is given to me.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
On the other side Jordan,
In the sweet fields of Eden,
Where the tree of life is
blooming,
There is rest for me.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
"Christ has redeemed us,"
sing the glad word,
Mercy's sweet message be
telling,
How through the ransom
made by His blood,
Christ now within us is
dwelling.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
"Christ has redeemed us:"
praise to His name,
Praise Him ye angels in Glory!
"Christ has redeemed us,"
bearing our shame,
Tell out the wonderful story!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
"Christ has redeemed us,"
making us free,
Free from the sins that
enslaved us,
Never in bondage more can
we be,
Trusting in Him who has
saved us.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
"Christ has redeemed us," we
are His own:
Purchased by blood, He will
hold us,
Nor will He ever leave us
alone,
Safely His hand shall enfold
us.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
"Christ has redeemed us,"
soon with the throng
Gathered in Glory we'll meet
Him;
O, with what rapture join in the
song,
When face to face we shall
greet Him!

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
When I saw the cleansing
fountain
Open wide for all my sin,
I obeyed the Spirit's wooing
When it said, "Wilt thou be
clean?"

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
I will praise Him, I will praise
Him,
Praise the Lamb for sinners
slain;
Give Him glory all ye people,
For His blood can wash away
each stain.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Though the way is strait and
narrow,
All I claimed was swept away;
My ambitions, plans and
wishes,
At my feet in ashes lay.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Then God's fire upon the altar
Of my heart was set aflame;
I shall never cease to praise
Him,
Glory, glory to His name!

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Blessed be the name of
Jesus!
I'm so glad He took me in;
He's forgiven my
transgressions,
He has cleansed my heart
from sin.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
There's a great day coming, a
great day coming,
There's a great day coming by
and by;
When the saints and the
sinners shall be
parted right and left,
Are you ready for that day to
come?

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Are you ready? Are you
ready?
Are you ready for the
judgment day?
Are you ready? Are you
ready?
For the judgment day?

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
There's a bright day coming, a
bright day coming,
There's a bright day coming by
and by;
But its brightness shall only
come to them
that love the Lord,
Are you ready for that day to
come?

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
There's a sad day coming, a
sad day coming,
There's a sad day coming by
and by;
When the sinner shall hear his
doom,
"Depart, I know ye not,"
Are you ready for that day to
come?

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
In these, the closing days of
time,
What joy the glorious hope
affords,
That soon-O, wondrous truth
sublime!
He shall reign, King of kings
and Lord of lords.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
He's coming soon, He's
coming soon;
With joy we welcome His
returning;
It may be morn, it may be
night or noon,
We know He's coming soon.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
The signs around, in earth and
air,
Or painted on the starlit sky,
God's faithful witnesses
declare
That the coming of the Saviour
draweth nigh.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
The dead in Christ who 'neath
us lie,
In countless numbers, all shall
rise,
When through the portals of
the sky,
He shall come to prepare our
paradise.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
And we who living, yet remain,
Caught up, shall meet our
faithful Lord;
This hope we cherish not in
vain,
But we comfort one another by
this word.

title: WHAT A FRIEND WE HAVE IN JESUS

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
What a Friend we have in
Jesus!
All our sins and griefs to bear,
What a privilege to carry
Everything to God in prayer!
O, what peace we often forfeit,
O, what needless pain we
bear,
All because we do not carry
Everything to God in prayer!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Have we trials and
temptations?
Is there trouble anywhere?
We should never be
discouraged,
Take it to the Lord in prayer.
Can we find a friend so
faithful,
Who will all our sorrows
share?
Jesus knows our every
weakness,
Take it to the Lord in prayer.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Are we weak and heavy
laden?
Cumbered with a load of care?
Precious Saviour, still our
refuge,
Take it to the Lord in prayer.
Do thy friends despise,
forsake thee?
Take it to the Lord in prayer;
In His arms He'll take and
shield thee,
Thou wilt find a solace there.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
On Jordan's stormy banks I
stand,
And cast a wishful eye
Toward Canaan's fair and
happy land,
Where my possessions lie.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
I am bound for the promised
land,
I am bound for the promised
land;
O, who will come and go with
me?
I am bound for the promised
land.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
O'er all those wide extended
plains
Shines one eternal day;
There God's own Son forever
reigns,
And scatters night away.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
No chilling winds, nor
poisonous breath
Can reach that healthful
shore;
Sickness and sorrow, pain and
death,
Are feared and felt no more.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
When shall I reach that happy
place,
And be forever blest?
When shall I see my Saviour's
face,
And in His bosom rest?

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Filled with delight, my raptured
soul
Would here no longer stay;
Though Jordan' waves around
me roll,
Fearless, I'd launch away.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
The great Physician now is
near,
The sympathizing Jesus;
He speaks the drooping heart
to cheer,
O, hear the voice of Jesus.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Sweetest note in Seraph song,
Sweetest name on mortal
tongue,
Sweetest carol ever sung,
Jesus, blessed Jesus.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
"Your many sins are all
forgiven,"
O, hear the voice of Jesus;
Go on your way in peace to
Heaven,
And wear a crown with Jesus.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
All glory to the dying Lamb!
I now believe in Jesus;
I love the blessed Saviour's
name,
I love the name of Jesus.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
His name dispels my guilt and
fear,
No other name but Jesus;
O, how my soul delights to
hear
The charming name of Jesus.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
CHORUS
lyrics.content:
I must tell Jesus! I must tell
Jesus!
I cannot bear my burdens
alone;
I must tell Jesus! I must tell
Jesus!
Jesus can help me, Jesus
alone.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
I must tell Jesus all of my
troubles:
He is a kind, compassionate
Friend;
If I but ask Him, He will deliver,
Make of my troubles quickly
an end.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Tempted and tried I need a
great Saviour,
One who can help my burdens
to bear,
I must tell Jesus, I must tell
Jesus;
He all my cares and sorrows
will share.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
O how the world to evil allures
me!
O how my heart is tempted to
sin!
I must tell Jesus and He will
help me
Over the world the victory to
win.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Nothing between my soul and
the Saviour,
Naught of this world's delusive
dream:
I have renounced all sinful
pleasure,
Jesus is mine, there's nothing
between.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Nothing between my soul and
the Saviour,
So that His blessed face may
be seen;
Nothing preventing the least of
His favour,
Keep the way clear! Let
nothing between.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Nothing between like worldly
pleasure;
Habits of life, though harmless
they seem,
Must not my heart from Him
ever sever;
He is my all, there's nothing
between.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Nothing between like pride or
station;
Self or friends shall not
intervene;
Though it may cost me much
tribulation,
I am resolved, there's nothing
between.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Nothing between, even many
hard trials,
Though the whole world
against me convene;
Watching with prayer and
much self-denial,
I'll triumph at last, with nothing
between.

title: WHAT A DAY THAT WILL BE

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
There is coming a day when
no heartaches
shall come,
No more clouds in the sky, no
more tears to
dim the eye,
All is peace forevermore on
that happy
golden shore,
What a day, glorious day that
will be.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
What a day that will be when
my Jesus I shall
see,
And I look upon His face, the
One who saved
me by His grace;
When He takes me by the
hand, and leads me
through the promised land,
What a day, glorious day that
will be.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
There'll be no sorrow there, no
more burdens
to bear,
No more sickness, no pain, no
more parting
over there;
And forever I will be with the
One who died
for me,
What a day, glorious day that
will be.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Jesus, keep me near the
cross,
There a precious fountain,
Free to all, a healing stream,
Flows from Calvary's
mountain.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
In the cross, in the cross,
Be my glory ever;
Till my raptured soul shall find
Rest beyond the river.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Near the cross, a trembling
soul,
Love and mercy found me;
There the Bright and Morning
Star
Sheds its beams around me.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Near the cross, O Lamb of
God,
Bring its scenes before me;
Help me walk from day to day,
With its shadows o'er me.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Near the cross I'll watch and
wait,
Hoping, trusting, ever,
Till I reach the golden strand,
Just beyond the river.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Pass me not, O gentle
Saviour,
Hear my humble cry;
While on others Thou art
smiling,
Do not pass me by.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Saviour! Saviour!
Hear my humble cry;
While on others Thou art
calling,
Do not pass me by.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Let me at Thy throne of mercy
Find a sweet relief;
Kneeling there in deep
contrition,
Help my unbelief.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Trusting only in Thy merit,
Would I seek Thy face;
Heal my wounded, broken
spirit,
Save me by Thy grace.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Thou the spring of all my
comfort,
More than life to me,
Whom have I on earth beside
Thee?
Whom in Heaven but Thee?

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
On Calvary's hill of sorrow
Where sin's demands were
paid,
And rays of hope for tomorrow
Across our path were laid.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
I see a crimson stream of
blood,
It flows from Calvary,
Its waves, which reach the
throne of God,
Are sweeping over me.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Today no condemnation
Abides to turn away
My soul from His salvation,
He's in my heart to stay.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
When gloom and sadness
whisper:
"You've sinned, no use to
pray."
I look away to Jesus,
And He tells me to say:

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
And when we reach the portal
Where life forever reigns,
The ransomed hosts'
grand-final
Will be this glad refrain:

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
"All things are ready," come to
the feast!
Come, for the table now is
spread;
Ye famishing, ye weary, come,
And thou shalt be richly fed.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Hear the invitation,
Come, "whosoever will."
Praise God for full salvation
For "whosoever will.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
All things are ready," come to
the feast!
Come, for the door is open
wide;
A place of honour is reserved
For you at the Master's side.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
"All things are ready," come to
the feast!
Come, while He waits to
welcome thee;
Delay not while this day is
thine,
Tomorrow may never be.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
"All things are ready," come to
the feast!
Leave every care and worldly
strife;
Come, feast upon the love of
God,
And drink everlasting life.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I've wandered far away from
God,
Now I'm coming home;
The paths of sin too long I've
trod,
Lord, I'm coming home.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Coming home, coming home,
Nevermore to roam;
Open wide Thy arms of love,
Lord, I'm coming home.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
I've wasted many precious
years,
Now I'm coming home;
I now repent with bitter tears,
Lord, I'm coming home.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
I'm tired of sin and straying
Lord,
Now I'm coming home;
I'll trust Thy love, believe Thy
Word,
Lord, I'm coming home.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
My soul is sick, my heart is
sore,
Now I'm coming home;
My strength renew, my hope
restore,
Lord, I'm coming home.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
My only hope, my only plea,
Now I'm coming home;
That Jesus died, and died for
me,
Lord, I'm coming home.

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lyrics.content:
I need His cleansing blood, I
know,
Now I'm coming home;
O, wash me whiter than the
snow,
Lord, I'm coming home.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I will meet you in the morning,
Just inside the Eastern Gate,
Then be ready, faithful pilgrim,
Lest with you it be too late.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
I will meet you, I will meet you
Just inside the Eastern Gate
over there;
I will meet you, I will meet you,
I will meet you in the morning
over there.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
If you hasten off to Glory,
Linger near the Eastern Gate,
For I'm coming in the morning,
So you'll not have long to wait.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Keep your lamps all trimmed
and burning,
For the Bridegroom watch and
wait,
He'll be with us at the meeting,
Just inside the Eastern Gate.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
O the joys of that glad meeting
With the saints who for us
wait;
What a blessed, happy
meeting,
Just inside the Eastern Gate.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I hear the Saviour say,
"Thy strength indeed is small,
Child of weakness, watch and
pray,
Find in Me thine all in all"

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Jesus paid it all,
All to Him I owe;
Sin had left a crimson stain:
He washed it white as snow.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Lord, now indeed I find
Thy power, and Thine alone,
Can change the leper's spots,
And melt the heart of stone.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Since nothing good have I
Whereby Thy grace to claim,
I'll wash my garments white
In the blood of CaIvary's
Lamb.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
And when before the throne
I stand in Him complete,
I'll lay my trophies down,
All down at Jesus' feet.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I believe God! I believe God!
It shall be done, even as He
said;
Trust and obey, look up and
say,
I believe, I believe God.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
O land of rest, for thee I sigh!
When will the moment come
When I shall lay my armour
by,
And dwell in peace at home?

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
We'll work till Jesus comes,
We'll work till Jesus comes,
We'll work till Jesus comes,
And we'll be gathered home!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
lyrics.content:
I sought at once my Saviour's
side,
No more my steps shall roam;
With Him I'll brave death's
chilling tide
And reach my heavenly home.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
The windows of Heaven are
open,
The blessings are falling
tonight;
There's joy, joy, joy in my
heart,
For Jesus makes everything
right;
I gave Him my old tattered
garment,
He gave me a robe of pure
white,
I'm feasting today on the
Manna,
And that's why I'm happy
tonight.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Precious memories, unseen
angels,
Sent from somewhere to my
soul;
How they linger, ever near me,
And the sacred past unfold.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Precious memories, how they
linger,
How they ever flood my soul:
In the stillness of the midnight,
Precious, sacred scenes
unfold.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Precious father, loving mother,
Fly across the lonely years;
And old home scenes of my
childhood,
In fond memory appear.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
In the stillness of the midnight,
Echoes from the past I hear;
Old-time singing,
gladness-bringing,
From that lovely land
somewhere.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
As I travel on life's pathway,
Know not what the years may
hold;
As I ponder, hope grows
fonder,
Precious memories flood my
soul

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Precious memories of the
prophet,
Flood my soul from day to day,
I remember scenes so
precious
That can never pass away.

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lyrics.content:
I've heard the message and
its
signal
That day's end is near at
hand,
But I remember that Christ
promised
He'd return for those who'd
stand.

lyrics.label: Verse 7
lyrics.content:
Precious memories, glorious
meetings
Across this land from sea to
sea,
Where I heard the prophet's
message
That brought life and hope to
me.

lyrics.label: Verse 8
lyrics.content:
Precious memories in this
storehouse
Where the food was laid away,
We've returned to where he
stored it,
Spiritual food against this day.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I look and see earth's
sorrowing picture,
The hoarding mobs for selfish
gain,
Their toil of hand for ease and
comfort,
Can they not see, their doom
is sealed, it's all
in vain?

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
The end is here, it's now at
hand,
The bride is gathering, the
world is failing;
Israel's awakening; nations
are breaking
Our prophet taught us, we
believe the end is
here.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
"Sirs, this is the time!" our
prophet spoke of,
The angel came with a
"shout",
The mountain shook as his
voice cried out,
"Time is no more," loud and
clear, the
"shout" went forth.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Have you considered the
End-Time
Message?
Have you considered Malachi
4?
Revelation 10:7 and St. Luke
17
Proclaims this Message now,
and then
forevermore.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
It is no secret, what God can
do!
What He's done for others,
He'll do for you;
With arms wide open, He'll
pardon you,
It is no secret what God can
do.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
It is no secret, I believe the
Word!
My eyes were opened, my
heart was stirred.
I recognized It, the first I heard
The prophet brought us the
Spoken Word.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
It is no secret, where I am
now!
I heard the gospel and I
believed It.
With my heart wide open, the
light shone in.
It is no secret I follow now.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
It is no secret who the prophet
is!
A major prophet, I'm
convinced of this:
The seventh angel, a son of
man,
The Elijah promised in God's
great plan.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
When I consider the works of
my God,
The moon and the stars, the
path that He trod,
The sheep and the oxen, the
beasts of the
field,
All of these wonders make me
know that
He's real.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
How great is our God! How
great is His
Word!
He's the greatest one that ever
was heard,
He rolled back the waters of
the mighty Red
Sea,
And He said, "I will lead you,
put your trust
in Me."

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
He used our prophet in many
a way
To show forth His greatness in
this our day;
He never changes; He's
always the same,
So worship and praise Him
and love His dear
name.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
In these days of trials so near
the end,
When Christ from Glory doth
now descend,
Men's hearts are failing and
filled with fear,
We know the end-time is
surely here.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
Verse 2
lyrics.content:
In every church-age a star did
shine,
To help God's people the truth
to find;
In this last church-age a star
shines bright,
So friend receive it, walk in the
light.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Do not be fearful or filled with
dread,
Your prophet sleepeth, he is
not dead;
The bride is waiting now for
that "voice,"
And this hope we can now
rejoice.
in
His word of promise he gave
the bride,
From his "white charger" the
prophet cried,
"Yet one more time shall I ride
this trail,"
Thus Saith The Lord can
never fail.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
His word of promise he gave
the bride,
From his "white charger" the
prophet cried,
"Yet one more time shall I ride
this trail,"
Thus Saith The Lord can
never fail.

title: BLEST BE THE TIE THAT BINDS

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Blest be the tie that binds
Our hearts in christian love;
The fellowship of kindred
minds
Is like to that above.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Before our Father's throne,
We pour our ardent prayers,
Our fears, our hopes, our aims
are one,
Our comforts and our cares.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
We share our mutual woes,
Our mutual burdens bear;
And often for each other flows
The sympathizing tear.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
When we asunder part,
It gives us inward pain;
But we shall still be joined in
heart,
And hope to meet again.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
God be with you till we meet
again!
By His counsels guide, uphold
you;
With His sheep securely fold
you;
God be with you till we meet
again!

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Till we meet! Till we meet!
Till we meet at Jesus' feet;
Till we meet! Till we meet!
God be with you till we meet
again!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
God be with you till we meet
again!
'Neath His wings securely hide
you,
Daily manna still provide you;
God be with you till we meet
again!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
God be with you till we meet
again!
When life's perils thick
confound you,
Put His arms unfailing round
you;
God be with you till we meet
again!

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
God be with you till we meet
again!
Keep love's banner floating
o'er you,
Smite death's threatening
wave before you;
God be with you till we meet
again!

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Take the name of Jesus with
you,
Child of sorrow and of woe;
It will joy and comfort give you,
Take it, then, where'er you go.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Precious name, O how sweet!
Hope of earth and joy of
Heaven;
Precious name, O how sweet!
Hope of earth and joy of
Heaven.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Take the name of Jesus ever,
As a shield from every snare;
If temptations round you
gather,
Breathe that holy name in
prayer.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
O the precious name of Jesus!
How it thrills our souls with joy,
When His loving arms receive
us,
And His songs our tongues
employ!

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
At the name of Jesus bowing,
Falling prostrate at His feet,
King of kings in Heaven we'll
crown Him,
When our journey is complete.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Will your anchor hold in the
storms of life,
When the clouds unfold their
wings of strife?
When the strong tides lift, and
the cable
strain,
Will your anchor shift, or firm
remain?

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
We have an anchor that keeps
the soul
Steadfast and sure while the
billows roll,
Fastened to the Rock which
cannot move,
Grounded firm and deep in the
Saviour's
love.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
It is safely moored, 'twill the
storm
withstand,
For 'tis well secured by the
Saviour's hand,
And the cables, passed from
His heart to
mine,
Can defy the blast, through
strength divine.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
It will firmly hold in the straits
of fear,
When the breakers have told
the reef is near;
Though the tempest rave, and
the wild winds
blow,
Not an angry wave shall our
barque o'erflow.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
It will surely hold in the floods
of death,
When the waters cold chill our
latest breath:
On the rising tide it can never
fail,
While our hopes abide within
the veil.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
When our eyes behold,
through the gathering
night,
The city of gold, our harbour
bright,
We shall anchor fast by the
heavenly shore,
With the storms all past for
evermore.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Jesus, my Saviour to
Bethlehem came,
Born in a manger to sorrow
and shame;
O, it was wonderful, -blest be
His name,
Seeking for me, for me.
Seeking for me, for me!
Seeking for me, for me!
O, it was wonderful, -blest be
His name,
Seeking for me, for me!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Jesus, my Saviour, on
Calvary's tree,
Paid the great debt, and my
soul He set free;
O, it was wonderful, -how
could it be?
Dying for me, for me.
Dying for me, for me!
Dying for me, for me!
O, it was wonderful, -how
could it be?
Dying for me, for me!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Jesus, my Saviour, the same
as of old,
While I was wandering afar
from the fold;
Gently and long He did plead
with my soul,
Calling for me, for me.
Calling for me, for me!
Calling for me, for me!
Gently and long He did plead
with my soul,
Calling for me, for me!

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Jesus, my Saviour, shall come
from on high,
Sweet is the promise as weary
years fly:
O, I shall see Him descending
the sky,
Coming for me, for me.
Coming for me, for me!
Coming for me, for me!
O, I shall see Him descending
the sky,
Coming for me, for me!

lyrics.label: Verse 1
CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Only a sinner saved by grace!
Only a sinner saved by grace!
This is my story -to God be the
glory -
I'm only a sinner saved by
grace.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Once I was foolish, and sin
ruled my heart,
Causing my footsteps from
God to depart;
Jesus hath found me, happy
my case -
I, now, am a sinner saved by
grace!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Suffer a sinner whose heart
overflows,
Loving his Saviour, to tell what
he knows;
Once more to tell it, would I
embrace-
"I'm only a sinner saved by
grace!"

title: MY FAITH HAS FOUND A RESTING PLACE

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
My faith has found a resting
place,
Not in device nor creed;
I trust the ever-living One,
His wounds for me shall plead.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
I need no other argument,
I need no other plea;
It is enough that Jesus died,
And that He died for me.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Enough for me that Jesus
saves,
This ends my fear and doubt;
A sinful soul I come to Him,
He'll never cast me out.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
My heart is leaning on the
Word,
The written Word of God;
Salvation by my Saviour's
name,
Salvation through His blood.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
My great Physician heals the
sick,
The lost He came to save;
For me His precious blood He
shed,
For me His life He gave.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Once again the gospel
message
From the Saviour you have
heard;
Will you heed the invitation?
Will you turn and seek the
Lord?

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Come believing... come
believing...
Come to Jesus! Look and
live...
Come believing... come
believing...
Come to Jesus! Look and live!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Many summers you have
wasted,
Ripened harvests you have
seen;
"Winter snows by spring have
melted,"
Yet you linger in your sin.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Jesus for your choice is
waiting;
Tarry not: at once decide!
While the Spirit now is striving,
Yield and seek the Saviour's
side.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Let your will to God be given,
Trust in Christ's atoning blood;
Look to Jesus now in Heaven,
Rest on His unchanging word.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Is there a heart that is waiting,
Longing for pardon to-day?
Hear the glad message
proclaiming,
Jesus is passing this way.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Jesus is passing this way...
This way... to day...
Jesus is passing this way...
Is passing this way to-day.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Is there a heart that has
wandered?
Come with thy burden to-day;
Mercy is tenderly pleading,
Jesus is passing this way.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Is there a heart that is broken?
Weary and sighing for rest?
Come to the arms of thy
Saviour,
Pillow thy head on His breast.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Come to thy only Redeemer,
Come to His infinite love;
Come to the gate that is
leading
Homeward to mansions
above.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Fairest of all the earth beside,
Chiefest of all unto Thy bride,
Fullness divine in Thee I see,
Wonderful Man of Calvary!

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
That Man of Calvary
Has won my heart from me
And died to set me free;
Blest Man of Calvary!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Granting the sinner life and
peace,
Granting the captive sweet
release;
Shedding His blood to make
us free,
Merciful Man of Calvary!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Giving the gifts obtained for
men,
Pouring out love beyond our
ken,
Giving us spotless purity,
Bountiful Man of Calvary!

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Comfort of all my earthly way,
Jesus, I'll meet Thee some
sweet day;
Centre of glory, Thee I'll see,
Wonderful Man of Calvary!

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Joys are flowing like a river
Since the Comforter has
come;
He abides with us forever,
Makes the trusting heart His
home.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Blessed quietness, holy
quietness,
What assurance in my soul!
On the stormy sea, He speaks
peace to me,
How the billows cease to roll!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Bringing life and health and
gladness
All around: This heavenly
Guest!
Banished unbelief and
sadness,
Changed our weariness to
rest.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Like the rain that falls from
heaven.
Like the sunlight from the sky,
So the Holy Ghost is given,
Coming on us from on high.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
See a fruitful field is growing,
Blessed fruits of
righteousness,
And the streams of life are
flowing
In the lonely wilderness.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
What a wonderful salvation,
Where we always see His
face;
What a perfect habitation,
What a quiet resting place!

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
To God be the glory, great
things He hath done,
So loved He the world that He
gave us His Son,
Who yielded His life an
atonement for sin,
And opened the life-gate that
all may go in.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Praise the Lord, praise the
Lord,
Let the earth hear His voice!
Praise the Lord, praise the
Lord,
Let the people rejoice!
O come to the Father, through
Jesus the Son,
And give Him the glory, great
things He hath
done.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
O perfect redemption, the
purchase of blood,
To every believer the promise
of God;
The vilest offender who truly
believes,
That moment from Jesus a
pardon receives.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Great things He hath taught
us, great things
He hath done,
And great our rejoicing
through Jesus the Son;
But purer, and higher, and
greater will be
Our wonder, our transport
when Jesus we see.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
More about Jesus would I
know,
More of His grace to others
show;
More of His saving fulness
see,
More of His love who died for
me.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
More, more about Jesus,
More, more about Jesus;
More of His saving fulness
see,
More of His love who died for
me.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
More about Jesus let me
learn,
More of His holy will discern;
Spirit of God, my teacher be,
Showing the things of Christ to
me.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
More about Jesus; in His
Word,
Holding communion with my
Lord;
Hearing His voice in every
line,
Making each faithful saying
mine.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
More about Jesus; on His
throne,
Riches in glory all His own;
More of His kingdom's sure
increase;
More of His coming, Prince of
Peace.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Have thy affections been
nailed to the cross?
Is thy heart right with God?
Dost thou count all things for
Jesus but loss?
Is thy heart right with God?

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Is thy heart right with God,
Washed in the crimson flood,
Cleansed and made holy,
humble and lowly,
Right in the sight of God?

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Hast thou dominion o'er self
and o'er sin?
Is thy heart right with God?
Over all evil without and
within?
Is thy heart right with God?

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Is there no more
condemnation for sin?
Is thy heart right with God?
Does Jesus rule in the temple
within?
Is thy heart right with God?

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Are all thy powers under
Jesus' control?
Is thy heart right with God?
Does He each moment abide
in thy soul?
Is thy heart right with God?

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Art thou now walking in
Heaven's pure light?
Is thy heart right with God?
Is thy soul wearing the
garment of white?
Is thy heart right with God?

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Burn! Burn! Holy Spirit, burn in
me,
Set my soul on fire;
Fill me with the Holy Ghost,
And God's full desire;
Make me like the Christ of old,
Healing and raising the dead;
Give me the power that Jesus
had,
Through the blood that was
shed.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
From north to south, there is
no other God,
From east to west,(I know), there is no other God.
From north to south,
there is no one like Thee,
From east to west,
(I know) there is no one like
Thee.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
O spread the tidings round
wherever man is
found,
Wherever human hearts and
human woes
abound;
Let every christian tongue
proclaim the joyful
sound:
"The Comforter has come!"

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
The Comforter has come!
The Comforter has come!
The Holy Ghost from Heaven,
The Father's promise given;
O, spread the tidings round
wherever man is
found,
"The Comforter has come!"

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
The long, long night is past,
the morning
breaks at last
And hushed the dreadful wail
and fury of the
blast,
As o'er the golden hills, the
day advances
fast:
"The Comforter has come!"

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
The mighty King of kings with
healing in His
wings,
To every captive soul a full
deliverance
brings;
And through the vacant cells
the song of
triumph rings:
"The Comforter has come!"

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
O boundless love divine! How
shall this
tongue of mine
To wondering mortals tell the
matchless
grace divine -
That I may with Him dwell, and
in His image
shine!-
"The Comforter has come!"

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Sing till the echoes fly above
the vaulted sky,
And all the saints above to all
below reply
In strains of endless love, the
song that ne'er
will die:
"The Comforter has come!"

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
When Jesus comes to reward
His servants,
Whether it be noon or night,
Faithful to Him will He find us
watching,
With our lamps all trimmed
and bright?

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
O, can we say we are ready,
brother,-
Ready for the soul's bright
home?
Say, will He find you and me
still watching,
Waiting, waiting, when the
Lord shall come?

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
If at the dawn of the early
morning,
He shall call us one by one.
When to the Lord we restore
our talents,
Will He answer thee, "well
done?"

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Have we been true to the trust
He left us?
Do we seek to do our best?
If in our hearts there is naught
condemns us,
We shall have a glorious rest.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Blessed are those, whom the
Lord finds
watching,
In His glory they shall share;
If He shall come at the dawn
or midnight,
Will He find us watching
there?

title: HIS BANNER OVER ME IS LOVE

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
He brought us to His
banqueting table,
His banner over us is love;
(repeat 3 times),
His banner over us is love.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
He set straight paths before
our feet,
His banner over us is love;
(repeat 3 times),
His banner over us is love.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
I am my Beloved's and He is
mine,
His banner over me is love;
(repeat 3 times),
His banner over me is love.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Let us sing a song that will
cheer us by the
way-
In a little while we're going
home;
For the night will end in the
everlasting day-
In a little while we're going
home.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
In a little while... in a little
while...
We shall cross the billow's
foam;
We shall meet at last
When the stormy winds are
past...
In a little while we're going
home.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
We will do the work that our
hands may find
to do-
In a little while we're going
home;
And the grace of God will our
daily strength
renew-
In a little while we're going
home.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
We will smooth the path for
some weary,
way-worn feet-
In a little while we're going
home;
O may loving hearts spread
around an
influence sweet!
In a little while we're going
home.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
There's a rest beyond, there's
relief from
every care-
In a little while we're going
home;
And no tears shall fall in that
city bright and
fair-
In a little while we're going
home.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
O Jesus, I have promised
To serve Thee to the end;
Be Thou forever near me,
My Master and my Friend!
I shall not fear the battle
If Thou art by my side,
Nor wander from the pathway
If Thou wilt be my Guide.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
O let me feel Thee near me;
The world is ever near,
I see the sights that dazzle,
The tempting sounds I hear.
My foes are ever near me,
Around me and within;
But Jesus, draw Thou nearer,
And shield my soul from sin.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
O let me hear Thee speaking
In accents clear and still,
Above the storms of passion,
The murmurs of self-will.
O speak to reassure me
To hasten or control;
O speak, and make me listen,
Thou Guardian of my soul!

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
O, let me see Thy footmarks,
And in them plant mine own;
My hope to follow duly
Is in Thy strength alone.
O, guide me, call me, draw
me,
Uphold me to the end;
And then in Heav'n receive
me,
My Saviour and my Friend!

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
O Jesus, Thou hast promised
To all who follow Thee,
That where Thou art in glory,
There shall Thy servants be.
And Jesus, I have promised,
To serve Thee to the end;
O give me grace to follow,
My Master and my Friend!

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I am determined, I've made up
my mind,
I'll serve the Lord,
I've left this world and its
pleasures behind.
I'll serve the Lord.
I'll follow wherever He leadeth,
I'll pasture wherever He
feedeth.
I am determined, I've made up
my mind,
I'll serve the Lord.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
There's a call comes ringing
o'er the restless
wave,
Send the light! Send the light!
There are souls to rescue,
there are souls to
save,
Send the light! Send the light!

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Send the light, the blessed
gospel light,
Let it shine from shore to
shore!
Send the light, and let its
radiant beams
Light the world for evermore.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
We have heard the
Macedonian call to-day,
Send the light! Send the light!
And a golden offering at the
cross we lay,
Send the light! Send the light!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Let us pray that grace may
everywhere
abound,
Send the light! Send the light!
And a Christ-like spirit
everywhere be found,
Send the light! Send the light!

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Let us not grow weary in the
work of love,
Send the light! Send the light!
Let us gather jewels for a
crown above,
Send the light! Send the light!

title: TAKE MY LIFE LET IT BE

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Take my life, and let it be
Consecrated, Lord, to Thee;
Take my moments and my
days,
Let them flow in ceaseless
praise.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Take my hands, and let them
move
At the impulse of Thy love;
Take my feet and let them be
Swift and beautiful for Thee.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Take my voice, and let me
sing
Always, only, for my King;
Take my lips, and let them be
Filled with messages from
Thee.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Take my silver and my gold,
Not a mite would I withhold;
Take my intellect, and use
Every power as Thou shalt
choose.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
Verse 6
lyrics.content:
Take my love; my Lord, I pour
At Thy feet its treasure store;
Take myself, and I will be
Ever, only, all for Thee!

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I've a message from the Lord,
Hallelujah!
The message unto you I'll
give,
'Tis recorded in His Word,
Hallelujah!
It is only that you "look and
live."

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
"Look and live," my brother
live!
Look to Jesus now and live,
'Tis recorded in His Word;
Hallelujah!
It is only that you "look and
live!"

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
I've a message full of love,
Hallelujah!
A message, O my friend, for
you;
'Tis a message from above,
Hallelujah!
Jesus said it, and I know 'tis
true!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Life is offered unto you,
Hallelujah!
Eternal life your soul shall
have,
If you'll only look to Him,
Hallelujah!
Look to Jesus, who alone can
save.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
God is here, and that to bless
us
With the Spirit's quickening
power;
See, the cloud already
bending,
Waits to drop the grateful
shower.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Let it come, O Lord, we pray
Thee!
Let the shower of blessing fall;
We are waiting, we are
waiting,
O, revive the hearts of all!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
God is here! We feel His
presence
In this consecrated place;
But we need the souls'
refreshing
Of His free, unbounded grace.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
God is here! O, then,
believing,
Bring to Him our one desire,
That His love may now be
kindled,
Till its flame each heart
inspire.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Saviour, grant the prayer we
offer,
While in simple faith we bow;
From the windows of Thy
mercy
Pour us out a blessing now.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
When upon life's billows you
are tempest-tossed,
When you are discouraged,
thinking all is lost,
Count your many blessings,
name them one by one,
And it will surprise you what
the Lord hath done.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Count your blessings, name
them one by one,
Count your blessings, see
what God hath done!
Count your blessings, name
them one by one;
And it will surprise you what
the Lord hath done.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Are you ever burdened with a
load of care?
Does the cross seem heavy
you are called to bear?
Count your many blessings,
every doubt will fly,
And you will keep singing as
the days go by.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
When you look at others with
their lands and gold,
Think that Christ has promised
you His wealth untold,
Count your many blessings;
money cannot buy
Your reward in Heaven, nor
your home on high.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
So amid the conflict, whether
great or small,
Do not be disheartened, God
is over all;
Count your many blessings,
angels will attend,
Help and comfort give you to
your journey's end.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
The move is on, my Lord, the
move is on,
The move is on, my Lord, the
move is on;
I can hear the rustle in the
mulberry trees
And I know, I know, I know the
move is on.
Move on brother, move on
sister: this is the
moving day!
Move a little closer, where the
streams are
flowing,
Move on, brother, move on!

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
When the Bridegroom cometh
by and by,
When the Bridegroom cometh
by and by,
Will your lamps be burning
bright,
Will your robes be pure and
white?
When the Bridegroom cometh
by and by?

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
O, be ready! O, be ready!
Ready when the Bridegroom
comes;
O, be ready! O, be ready!
Ready when the Bridegroom
comes.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
When the Bridegroom cometh
by and by,
When the Bridegroom cometh
by and by,
O, be ready for that day,
With your sins all washed
away,
When the Bridegroom cometh
by and by.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
When the Bridegroom cometh
by and by,
When the Bridegroom cometh
by and by,
Will your wearied heart rejoice
At the sound of Jesus' voice,
When the Bridegroom cometh
by and by?

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
When the Bridegroom cometh
by and by,
When the Bridegroom cometh
by and by,
Will the sorrows of the past,
All be changed to joy at last,
When the Bridegroom cometh
by and by?

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
When the Bridegroom cometh
by and by,
When the Bridegroom cometh
by and by,
When the Lord shall call His
own,
Can you stand before the
throne,
When the Bridegroom cometh
by and by?

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lyrics.content:
When the Bridegroom cometh
by and by,
When the Bridegroom cometh
by and by,
Will you join the ransomed
host,
Or be found among the lost,
When the Bridegroom cometh
by and by?

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
It may be at morn, when the
day is awaking,
When sunlight through
darkness and shadow
is breaking,
That Jesus will come in the
fullness of glory,
To receive from the world "His
own."

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
O, Lord Jesus, how long, how
long
Ere we shout the glad song?
"Christ returneth! Hallelujah!
Hallelujah! Amen!
Hallelujah! Amen!"

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
It may be at midday, it may be
at twilight,
It may be, perchance, that the
blackness of
midnight
Will burst into light in the blaze
of His glory,
When Jesus receives "His
own."

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
While hosts cry Hosanna from
Heaven,
descending
With glorified saints, and the
angels
attending,
With grace on His brow, like a
halo of glory,
Will Jesus receive "His own."

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
O joy! O delight! Should we go
without
dying;
No sickness, no sadness, no
dread, and no
crying;
Caught up through the clouds
with our Lord
into glory,
When Jesus receives "His
own."

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Lord I'm coming now to Thee,
Lay Thy nail-scarred hand on
me,
Let Thy healing virtue flow,
And I shall be made whole.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I will sing the wondrous story
Of the Christ who died for me;
How He came from God's own
bosom,
For the cross on Calvary.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Yes, I'll sing the wondrous
story
Of the Christ who died for me;
Sing it with the saints in glory,
Gathered by the crystal sea.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
I was lost but Jesus found me,
Found the sheep that went
astray;
Threw His loving arms around
me,
Drew me back into His way.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
I was bruised but Jesus
healed me,
Faint was I from many a fall;
Sight was gone and fears
possessed me,
But He freed me from them all.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
Verse 5
lyrics.content:
He will keep me till the river
Rolls its waters at my feet;
Then He'll bear me safely
over,
Where the loved ones I shall
meet.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
Verse 1
lyrics.content:
In the upper room with Jesus,
Sitting at His nail-scared feet,
O, what rich and full
communion,
Fellowship divine and sweet.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Principalities and powers
Mustering their unseen array,
Wait for thy unguarded hours;
"Watch and pray!"

lyrics.label: Verse 3
Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Hear the victors who
o'ercame;
Still they mark each warrior's
way;
All with one sweet voice
exclaim,
"Watch and pray!"

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Hear, above all, hear thy Lord,
Him thou lovest to obey;
Hide within thy heart His Word
-
"Watch and pray!"

lyrics.label: Verse 6
Verse 1
lyrics.content:
O God, our help in ages past,
Our hope for years to come,
Our shelter from the stormy
blast,
And our eternal home!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Under the shadow of Thy
throne
Thy saints have dwelt secure;
Sufficient is Thine arm alone,
And our defence is sure.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Before the hills in order stood,
Or earth received her frame,
From everlasting Thou art
God,
To endless years the same.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
A thousand ages in Thy sight
Are like an evening gone
Short as the watch that ends
the night
Before the rising sun.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Time, like an ever rolling
stream,
Bears all its sons away;
They fly forgotten, as a dream
Dies at the opening day.

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lyrics.content:
O God, our help in ages past,
Our hope for years to come,
Be Thou our Guard while
troubles last,
And our eternal home.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
It pays to serve Jesus, -I
speak from my
heart,
He'll always be with us if we
do our part;
There's naught in this wide
world can
pleasure afford,
There's peace and
contentment in serving the
Lord.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
I love Him far better than in
days of yore,
I'll serve Him more truly than
ever before,
I'll do as He bids me whatever
the cost,
I'll be a true soldier, I'll die at
my post.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
And oft when I'm tempted to
turn from the
track,
I think of my Saviour, -my
mind wanders
back
To the place where they nailed
Him on
Calvary's tree,
I hear a voice saying, "I
suffered for thee."

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
A place I remember where I
was set free,
'Twas where I found pardon,
-a haven to me;
There Jesus spoke sweetly to
my weary soul,
My sins were forgiven, He
made my heart
whole.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
How rich is the blessing the
world cannot
give,
I'm satisfied fully for Jesus to
live;
Though friends may forsake
me and trials
arise,
I'm trusting in Jesus, His love
never dies.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
There's no one like Jesus can
cheer me to-
day,
His love and His kindness can
ne'er fade
away;
In winter, in summer, in
sunshine and rain,
His love and affection are
always the same.

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lyrics.content:
Will you have this blessing
that Jesus
bestows?-
A free, full salvation from sin's
bitter throes;
O come to the Saviour, -to
Calvary flee.
The fountain is open, is
flowing for thee.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
When a sinner comes, as a
sinner may,
There is joy... there is joy...
When he turns to God in the
gospel way,
There is joy... there is joy.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
There is joy among the
angels,
And their hearts with music
ring...
When a sinner comes
repenting,
Bending low before our King.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
When a soul is born in this
kingdom bright,
There is joy... there is joy ...
When he walks by faith in the
gospel light,
There is joy... there is joy.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
When a pilgrim comes to the
river wide,
There is joy... there is joy...
When he dwells secure on the
other side,
There is joy... there is joy.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Peace, perfect peace, in this
dark world of sin?
The blood of Jesus whispers
peace within.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Peace, perfect peace, by
thronging duties
pressed?
To do the will of Jesus, this is
rest.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Peace, perfect peace, with
sorrows surging
round?
On Jesus' bosom naught but
calm is found.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Peace, perfect peace, with
loved ones far away?
In Jesus' keeping we are safe,
and they.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Peace, perfect peace, our
future all unknown?
Jesus we know, and He is on
the throne.

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lyrics.content:
Peace, perfect, peace, death
shadowing us and
ours?
Jesus has vanquished death
and all its powers.

lyrics.label: Verse 7
lyrics.content:
It is enough: earth's struggles
soon shall cease,
And Jesus calls to Heaven's
perfect peace.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Is your life a channel of
blessing?
Is the love of God flowing
through you?
Are you telling the lost of the
Saviour?
Are you ready His service to
do?

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Make me a channel of
blessing to-day,
Make me a channel of
blessing, I pray;
My life possessing, my service
blessing;
Make me a channel of
blessing to-day.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Is your life a channel of
blessing?
Are you burdened for those
that are lost?
Have you urged upon those
who are straying
The Saviour who died on the
cross?

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Is your life a channel of
blessing?
Is it daily telling for Him?
Have you spoken the word of
salvation
To those who are dying in sin?

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
We cannot be channels of
blessing
If our lives are not free from all
sin;
We will barriers be and a
hindrance
To those we are trying to win.

title: I WILL SING OF MY REDEEMER

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I will sing of my Redeemer,
And His wondrous love to me;
On the cruel cross He
suffered,
From the curse to set me free.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Sing, O sing... of my
Redeemer...
With His blood... He
purchased me...
On the cross... He sealed my
pardon...
Paid the debt... and made me
free...

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
I will tell the wondrous story,
How my lost estate to save,
In His boundless love and
mercy
He the ransom freely gave.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
I will praise my dear
Redeemer,
His triumphant power I'll tell;
How the victory He giveth,
Over sin, and death, and Hell.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
I will sing of my Redeemer
And His heavenly love to me;
He from death to life hath
brought me,
Son of God, with Him to be.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Tell it! Let the people hear it.
"Jesus saves from sin!"
Let the breezes bear the
message,
"Jesus makes men clean;
That He shed His blood to
save us!"
Tell it far and wide,
"In no other is redemption
Save the Crucified!"

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Tell it far and wide,
Tell it far and wide:
"In no other is redemption,
Save the Crucified!"

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Tell it to the lone and weary,
To the blithe and gay;
To the aged with their
burdens,
To the child at play.
"There is full and free
salvation!"
Hear the blessed word,
"There is mercy and true
healing
In the Saviour's blood!"

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Free the mercy, full the
pardon,
Jesus died to give!
Sweet the welcome that the
sinner
Surely will receive.
Weary, weak, and
heavy-laden,
Come to Him to-day:
Let the cleansing blood of
Jesus
Wash your sins away.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
There's not a friend like the
lowly Jesus:
No, not one! No, not one!
None else can heal all our
souls' diseases;
No, not one! No, not one!

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Jesus knows all about our
struggle,
He will guide till the day is
done;
There's not a friend like the
lowly Jesus,
No, not one! No, not one!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
No friend like Him is so high
and holy:
No, not one! No not one!
And yet no friend is so meek
and lowly;
No, not one! No, not one!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
There's not an hour that He is
not near us:
No, not one! No not one!
No night so dark but His love
can cheer us;
No, not one! No, not one!

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Did ever saint find this Friend
forsake him?
No, not one! No not one!
Or sinner find that He would
not take him?
No, not one! No, not one!

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Was e'er a gift like the Saviour
given?
No, not one! No, not one!
Will He refuse us a home in
Heaven?
No, not one! No, not one!

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
In the warfare that is raging
For the truth and for the right,
When the conflict fierce is
raging
With the powers of the night;
God needs workers brave and
true;
May He, then, depend on you.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
May the Lord... depend on
you!
Loyalty... is but His due,
Say, O spirit, brave and true...
That He may depend on you.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
See, they come on sable
pinions,
Come in strong satanic might.
Powers come and dark
dominions
From the regions of the night,
God requires the brave and
true;
May He, then, depend on you.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Tell me the old, old story
Of unseen things above,
Of Jesus and His glory,
Of Jesus and His love.
Tell me the story simply,
As to a little child;
For I am weak and weary,
And helpless and defiled.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Tell me the old, old story
Tell me the old, old story
Tell me the old, old story,
Of Jesus and His love.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Tell me the story slowly,
That I may take it in;
That wonderful redemption,
God's remedy for sin.
Tell me the story often,
For I forget so soon;
The "early dew" of morning
Has passed away at noon.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Tell me the story softly,
With earnest tones, and grave;
Remember, I'm the sinner
Whom Jesus came to save.
Tell me that story always,
If you would really be
In any time of trouble
A comforter to me.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Tell me the same old story,
When you have cause to fear
That this world's empty glory
Is costing me too dear:
Yes, and when the world's
glory
Is dawning on my soul,
Tell me the old, old story:
"Christ Jesus makes thee
whole."

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
When we walk with the Lord,
In the light of His Word,
What a glory He sheds on our
way!
While we do His good will,
He abides with us still,
And with all who will trust and
obey.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Trust and obey;
For there's no other way
To be happy in Jesus,
But to trust and obey.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Not a shadow can rise,
Not a cloud in the skies,
But His smile quickly drives it
away;
Not a doubt nor a fear,
Not a sigh nor a tear,
Can abide while we trust and
obey.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Not a burden we bear,
Not a sorrow we share,
But our toil He doth richly
repay;
Not a grief nor a loss,
Not a frown nor a cross,
But is blest if we trust and
obey.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
But we never can prove
The delights of His love,
Until all on the altar we lay;
For the favour He shows,
And the joy He bestows,
Are for them who will trust and
obey.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Then in fellowship sweet,
We will sit at His feet,
Or we'll walk by His side in the
way;
What He says we will do,
Where He sends we will go,
Never fear, only trust and
obey.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Jesus is alive, Jesus is alive,
Sin and death must go,
They are conquered foes,
For Jesus is alive.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Make me more like Thee,
Jesus,
Make me more like Thee;
Give me a heart that's filled
with love,
And make me more like Thee.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I have a Friend so precious,-
So very dear to me,
He loves me with such tender
love,
He loves so faithfully;
I could not live apart from Him,
I love to feel Him nigh,
And so we dwell together,
My Lord and I.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
He knows how much I love
Him,
He knows I love Him well;
But with what love He loveth
me
My tongue can never tell;
It is an everlasting love
In ever rich supply,
And so we love each other,
My Lord and I.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
He knows how I am longing
Some weary soul to win,
And so He bids me go and
speak
The loving Word for Him;
He bids me tell His wondrous
love,
And why He came to die,
And so we work together,
My Lord and I.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
So up into the mountains
Of heaven's cloudless light,
Or away into the valleys
Of darkness of the night,
Though round us tempests
gather,
And storms are raging high,
We'll travel on together,
My Lord and I.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
And when the journey's ended
In rest and peace at last,
When every thought of danger
And weariness is past,
In the kingdom of the future,
In the Glory by and by,
We'll live and reign together,
My Lord and I.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
There's a Friend for little
children
Above the bright blue sky,
A Friend that never changes
Whose love will never die;
Unlike our friends by nature,
Who change with changing
years;
This Friend is always worthy
The precious name He bears.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
There's a rest for little children
Above the bright blue sky,
Who love the blessed Saviour,
And to His Father cry;
A rest from every trouble,
From sin and danger free;
There every little pilgrim
Shall rest eternally.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
There's a home for little
children
Above the bright blue sky,
Where Jesus reigns in glory,
A home of peace and joy;
No home on earth is like it,
Nor can with it compare;
For everyone is happy,
Nor can be happier there.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
There's a crown for little
children
Above the bright blue sky,
And all who look to Jesus
Shall wear it by and by;
A crown of brightest glory,
Which He shall sure bestow
On all who love the Saviour,
And walk with Him below.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
There's a song for little
children
Above the bright blue sky,
And a harp of sweetest music
For their hymn of victory;
And all above is pleasure,
And found in Christ alone;
O come, dear little children,
That all may be your own!

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Have you ever heard the story
Of the Babe of Bethlehem,
Who was worshipped by the
angels
And the wise and holy men?
How He taught the learned
doctors
In the temple far away?
O, I'm glad, so glad to tell you,
He is just the same to-day.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
He is just... the same to-day...
He is just... the same to-day...
Seeking those who are astray,
Saving souls along the way;
Thank God, He is just the
same to-day.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Have you ever heard the story
How He walked upon the sea
To His dear disciples tossing
On the waves of Galilee?
How the waves in angry
motion
Quickly would His will obey?
O, I'm glad, so glad to tell you
He is just the same to-day.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Have you ever heard of Jesus
Praying in Gethsemane,
And the ever-thrilling story
How He died upon the tree?
Cruel thorns His forehead
piercing
As His Spirit passed away?
This He did for you, my
brother,
He's just the same to-day.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Courage brother! Do not
stumble,
Though thy path be dark as
night;
There's a star to guide the
humble,
Trust in God, and do the right.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Perish policy and cunning!
Perish all that fear the light.
Whether losing, whether
winning,
Trust in God, and do the right.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Trust no lovely forms of
passion,
Friends may look like angels
bright;
Trust no custom, school, or
fashion,
Trust in God, and do the right.

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lyrics.content:
Simple rule, and safest
guiding,
Inward peace and inward
might;
Star upon our path abiding,
Trust in God, and do the right.

lyrics.label: Verse 7
lyrics.content:
Some will hate thee, some will
love thee,
Some will flatter some will
slight;
Cease from man, and look
above thee,
Trust in God, and do the right.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
God moves in a mysterious
way
His wonders to perform;
He plants His footsteps in the
sea
And rides upon the storm.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Deep in unfathomable mines
Of never-failing skill,
He treasures up His bright
designs
And works His sovereign will.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Ye fearful saints, fresh
courage take!
The clouds ye so much dread
Are big with mercy, and shall
break
In blessings on your head.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Judge not the Lord by feeble
sense
But trust Him for His grace;
Behind a frowning providence
He hides a smiling face.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
His purposes will ripen fast,
Unfolding every hour;
The bud may have a bitter
taste,
But sweet will be the flower.

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lyrics.content:
Blind unbelief is sure to err,
And scan His work in vain;
God is His own interpreter,
And He will make it plain.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Have you any room for Jesus,
He who bore your load of sin?
As He knocks and asks
admission,
Sinner, will you let Him in?

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Room for Jesus, King of Glory!
Hasten now, His word obey!
Swing the heart's door widely
open!
Bid Him enter while you may!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Room for pleasure, room for
business;
But for Christ the Crucified-,
Not a place that He can enter
In your heart for which He
died?

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Have you any time for Jesus,
As in grace He calls again?
O, "to-day is time accepted,"
To-morrow you may call in
vain!

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Room and time now give to
Jesus:
Soon will pass God's day of
grace;
Soon thy heart left cold and
silent,
And thy Saviour's pleading
cease.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Whosoever heareth! Shout,
shout the sound;
Send the blessed tidings all
the world around!
Spread the joyful news
wherever man is
found;
Whosoever will may come.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Whosoever will! Whosoever
will!
Send the proclamation over
vale and hill.
'Tis the loving Father calls the
wanderer
home;
Whosoever will may come.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
lyrics.content:
"Whosoever will!"-The promise
is secure;
"Whosoever will!"-Forever
shall endure:
"Whosoever wil!l" -'Tis life for
evermore:
Whosoever will may come.

title: THOUGH YOUR SINS BE AS SCARLET

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Though your sins be as
scarlet,
They shall be as white as
snow,
Though they be red like
crimson,
They shall be as wool:
Though your sins be as
scarlet,
They shall be as white as
snow.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Hear the voice that entreats
you,
O, return ye unto God!
He is of great compassion,
And of wondrous love;
Hear the voice that entreats
you,
O, return ye unto God!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
He'll forgive your
transgressions,
And remember them no more;
"Look unto Me, ye people,"
Saith the Lord your God;
He'll forgive your
transgressions,
And remember them no more.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
He is Lord; He is Lord;
He has risen from the dead!
He is Lord.
Every knee shall bow, every
tongue confess
That Jesus Christ is Lord.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Longing, longing for Jesus,
I have a longing in my heart
for Him;
Just to be near Him, to feel His
presence,
I have a longing in my heart
for Him.

title: LET THE WORD LIVE IN ME

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Let the Word live in me, dear
Lord,
Show me myself within Thy
Word,
Show me myself, and show
me my Saviour,
And let the Word live, and let
the Word live,
And let the Word live in me.

title: IT IS WELL WITH MY SOUL

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
When peace, like a river,
attendeth my way
When sorrows, like
sea-billows, roll;
Whatever my lot, Thou has
taught me to know,
"It is well, it is well with my
soul."

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
It is well... with my soul...
It is well, it is well with my soul.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Though Satan should buffet,
though trials should
come,
Let this blest assurance
control,
That Christ hath regarded my
helpless estate,
And hath shed His own blood
for my soul.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
My sin,-O the bliss of this
glorious thought-
My sin, -not in part, but the
whole,
Is nailed to His cross, and I
bear it no more;
Praise the Lord, praise the
Lord, O my soul!

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
For me, be it Christ, be it
Christ hence to live!
If Jordan above me shall roll,
No pang shall be mine, for in
death as in life
Thou wilt whisper Thy peace
to my soul.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
But, Lord, 'tis for Thee, for Thy
coming we wait,
The sky, not the grave, is our
goal;
O, trump of the Angel! O,
voice of the Lord!
Blessed hope! Blessed rest of
my soul!

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Life at best is very brief,
Like the falling of a leaf,
Like the binding of a sheaf,
Be in time;
Fleeting days are telling fast
That the die will soon be cast,
And the fatal line be passed,
Be in time.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Be in time... Be in time...
While the voice of Jesus calls
you,
Be in time...
If in sin you longer wait
You may find no open gate,
And your cry be just too late
Be in time.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Fairest flowers soon decay,
Youth and beauty pass away,
O, you have not long to stay,
Be in time;
While God's Spirit bids you
come,
Sinner, do no longer roam,
Lest you seal your hopeless
doom,
Be in time.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Time is gliding swiftly by,
Death and judgment draweth
nigh,
To the arms of Jesus fly,
Be in time;
O, I pray you count the cost,
Ere the fatal line be crossed,
And your soul in Hell be lost,
Be in time.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Sinner, heed the warning
voice,
Make the Lord your final
choice,
Then all Heaven will rejoice,
Be in time;
Come from darkness into light,
Come, let Jesus make you
right,
Come, and start for Heaven
to-night,
Be in time.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
One there is above all others,
O, how He loves!
His is love beyond a brother's,
O, how He loves!
Earthly friends may fail or
leave us,
One day soothe, the next day
grieve us,
But this Friend will ne'er
deceive us,
O, how He loves!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
'Tis eternal life to know Him,
O, how He loves!
Think, O think, how much we
owe Him,
O, how He loves!
With His precious blood He
bought us,
In the wilderness He sought
us,
To His fold He safely brought
us,
O, how He loves!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
We have found a Friend in
Jesus,
O, how He loves!
'Tis His great delight to bless
us,
O, how He loves!
How our hearts delight to hear
Him,
Bid us dwell in safety near
Him!
Why should we distrust or fear
Him?
O, how He loves!

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Through His name we are
forgiven,
O, how He loves!
Backward shall our foes be
driven,
O, how He loves!
Best of blessings He'll provide
us,
Naught but good shall e'er
betide us,
Safe to glory He will guide us,
O, how He loves!

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
There's a Stranger at the door:
Let Him in;
He has been there oft before:
Let Him in;
Let Him in, ere He is gone,
Let Him in, the Holy One,
Jesus Christ, the Father's Son:
Let him in.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Open now to Him your heart:
Let Him in;
If you wait He will depart: Let
Him in;
Let Him in, He is your Friend,
He your soul will sure defend,
He will keep you to the end:
Let Him in.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Hear you now His loving
voice! Let Him in;
Now, O now, make Him your
choice: Let
Him in;
He is standing at the door,
Joy to you He will restore,
And His name you will adore:
Let Him in.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Now admit the heavenly
Guest: Let Him in;
He will make for you a feast:
Let Him in;
He will speak your sins
forgiven,
And when earth-ties all are
riven
He will take you home to
Heaven: Let Him
in.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Behold Me standing at the
door
And hear Me pleading
evermore,
With gentle voice, O, heart of
sin,
May I come in? May I come
in?

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Behold Me standing at the
door
And hear Me pleading
evermore:
Say, weary heart, opprest with
sin,
May I come in? May I come
in?

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
I bore the cruel thorns for thee,
I waited long and patiently;
Say, weary heart, opprest with
sin,
May I come in? May I come
in?

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
I would not plead with thee in
vain:
Remember all My grief and
pain!
I died to ransom thee from sin,
May I come in? May I come
in?

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
I bring thee joy from Heaven
above,
I bring thee pardon, peace,
and love:
Say weary heart, opprest with
sin,
May I come in? May I come
in?

title: WHO IS ON THE LORD'S SIDE?

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Who is on the Lord's side?
Who will serve the King?
Who will be His helpers,
Other lives to bring?
Who will leave the world's
side?
Who will face the foe?
Who is on the Lord's side?
Who for Him will go?
By Thy call of mercy,
By Thy grace divine,
We are on the Lord's side,
Saviour, we are Thine!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Not for weight of glory,
Nor for crown and palm,
Enter we the army,
Raise the warrior psalm:
But for love that claimeth
Lives for whom He died:
He whom Jesus nameth
Must be on His side!
By Thy love constraining
By Thy grace divine,
We are on the Lord's side,
Saviour, we are Thine!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Jesus, Thou hast bought us,
Not with gold or gem,
But with Thine own life-blood
For Thy diadem;
With Thy blessing filling
All who come to Thee,
Thou hast made us willing,
Thou hast made us free.
By Thy grand redemption,
By Thy grace divine,
We are on the Lord's side,
Saviour, we are Thine!

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Fierce may be the conflict,
Strong may be the foe;
But the King's own army
None can overthrow:
Round His standard ranging,
Victory is secure,
For His truth unchanging
Makes the triumph sure,
Joyfully enlisting,
By Thy grace divine,
We are on the Lord's side
Saviour, we are Thine!

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I shall wear a golden crown
when I get home,
I shall lay my burdens down
when I get
home;
Clad in robes of glory, I shall
sing the story
Of the Lord who brought me
when I get
home.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
When I get home, when I get
home,
All sorrow will be over when I
get home;
When I get home, when I get
home,
All sorrow will be over when I
get home.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
All the darkness will be past
when I get
home,
I shall see the light at last
when I get home;
Light from Heaven streaming,
o'er my
pathway beaming,
Ever guides me onward till I
get home.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
I shall see my Saviour's face
when I get
home,
Sing again of saving grace
when I get home;
I shall stand before Him,
gladly I'll adore
Him,
Ever to be with Him when I get
home.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Come to the Saviour, make no
delay;
Here in His word He has
shown us the way;
Here in our midst He's
standing to-day,
Tenderly saying, "Come!"

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Joyful, joyful will the meeting
be,
When from sin our hearts are
pure and free,
And we shall gather, Saviour,
with Thee,
In our eternal home.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
"Suffer the children!" O, hear
His voice!
Let every heart leap forth and
rejoice;
And let us freely make Him our
choice,
Do not delay, but come.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Think once again, He's with us
to-day;
Heed now His blest command
and obey;
Hear now His accents tenderly
say,
"Will you, My children, come?"

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Where will you spend eternity?
This question comes to you
and me!
Tell me, what shall your
answer be?
Where will you spend eternity?

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Eternity! Eternity!
Where will you spend eternity?

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Many are choosing Christ
to-day,
Turning from all their sins
away;
Heaven shall their happy
