portion be,
Where will you spend eternity?

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Leaving the strait and narrow
way,
Going the downward road
to-day,
Sad will their final ending be -
Lost through a long eternity!

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Repent; believe this very hour,
Trust in the Saviour's grace
and power,
Then will your joyous answer
be:
"Saved through a long
eternity!"

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Years I spent in vanity and
pride,
Caring not my Lord was
crucified,
Knowing not it was for me He
died
On Calvary.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Mercy there was great, and
grace was free,
Pardon there was multiplied to
me,
There my burdened soul found
liberty,
At Calvary.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
By God's word at last my sin I
learned,
Then I trembled at the law I'd
spurned
Till my guilty soul, imploring,
turned
To Calvary.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Now I've given Jesus
everything,
Now I gladly own Him as my
King,
Now my raptured soul can
only sing
Of Calvary.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
O! The love that drew
salvation's plan,
O! The grace that brought it
down to man,
O! The mighty gulf that God
did span
At Calvary.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Wither pilgrims are you going,
Going each with staff in hand?
We are going on a journey,
Going at our King's command.
Over hills, and plains, and
valleys,
We are going to His palace,
We are going to His palace,
Going to the better land.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Tell us, pilgrims, what you
hope for
In that far-off, better land?
Spotless robes and crowns of
glory
From a Saviour's loving hand.
We shall drink of life's clear
river,
We shall dwell with God
forever,
We shall dwell with God
forever,
In the bright, that better land.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Pilgrims, may we travel with
you
To that bright, and better
land?
Come and welcome, come
and welcome,
Welcome to our pilgrim band.
Come, O, Come, and do not
leave us;
Christ is waiting to receive us,
Christ is waiting to receive us,
In that bright, that better land.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Peace, like a river, is flooding
my soul,
Since Christ my Saviour
maketh me whole;
Sweet peace abiding, my
portion shall be,
Jesus, my Saviour, is precious
to me.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Precious to me... precious is
He...
Jesus shall ever be precious
to me;
Precious to me... precious is
He...
Jesus shall ever be precious
to me.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Joy is abounding, -my heart
gaily sings,
Cleave I the heavens, mount
up on wings,
Christ hath exalted, my soul
He set free,
Jesus, my Saviour, is precious
to me.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
O, precious Jesus, how lovely
Thou art!
Come, and abiding, rule in my

Worship and adore Him
Worship and adore Him;
Making melody in our hearts,
Unto the King of kings.

title: I WILL SING OF THE MERCIES

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I will sing of the mercies of the
Lord forever,
I will sing, I will sing;
I will sing of the mercies of the
Lord forever,
I will sing of the mercies of the
Lord.
With my mouth shall I make
known
Thy faithfulness, Thy
faithfulness;
With my mouth shall I make
known
Thy faithfulness to all
generations;
I will sing of the mercies of the
Lord forever,
I will sing of the mercies of the
Lord.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
He paid a debt He did not
owe,
I owed a debt I could not pay,
I needed someone to wash my
sins away;
And now I sing a brand new
song,
Amazing grace all day long,
Christ Jesus paid a debt that I
could never pay.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
He paid a debt at Calvary,
He cleansed my soul and set
me free,
I'm glad that Jesus did all my
sins erase;
I now can sing a brand new
song,
Amazing grace all day tong,
Christ Jesus paid a debt that I
could never pay.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
One day He's coming back for
me
To live with Him eternally,
Won't it be glorious to see Him
on that day?
I then will sing a brand new
song,
Amazing grace all day long,
Christ Jesus paid a debt that I
could never pay.

title: A MIGHTY FORTRESS IS OUR GOD

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
A mighty fortress is our God, a
bulwark
never failing;
Our Helper He amid the flood
of mortal ills
prevailing:
For still our ancient foe doth
seek to work us woe;
His craft and power are great,
and, armed
with cruel hate,
On earth is not his equal.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Did we in our own strength
confide, our
striving would be losing;
Were not the right Man on our
side, the Man
of God's own choosing:
Dost ask who that may be?
-Christ Jesus, it is He!
Lord Sabaoth is His name,
from age to age
the same,
And He must win the battle.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
And though this world, with
devils filled,
should threaten to undo us,
We will not fear, for God hath
willed His
truth to triumph through us:
The prince of darkness grim,
we tremble not
for him;
His rage we can endure, for lo,
his doom is sure,
One little word shall fell him.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
That word above all earthly
powers, -no
thanks to them abideth;
The Spirit and the gifts are
ours through Him
who with us sideth:
Let goods and kindred go, this
mortal life also;
The body they may kill: God's
truth abideth still;
His kingdom is forever.

title: THROUGH THE LOVE OF GOD OUR SAVIOUR

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Through the love of God our
Saviour
All will be well;
Free and changeless is His
favour,
All, all is well.
Precious is the blood that
healed us,
Perfect is the grace that
sealed us,
Strong the hand stretched
forth to shield us,
All will be well.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Though we pass through
tribulation,
All must be well.
Ours is such a free salvation,
All, all is well,
Happy, still in God confiding,
Fruitful, if in Christ abiding,
Holy through the Spirit's
guiding
All must be well.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
We expect a bright tomorrow
All will be well;
Faith can sing through days of
sorrow
All, all is well.
On our Father's love relying
Jesus every need supplying,
Or in living, or in dying,
All must be well.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Lord, Lord, Lord,
You've surely been good to
me;
Lord, Lord, Lord,
You've surely been good to
me;
Lord, Lord, Lord,
You've surely been good to
me;
You have done what this world
could not do.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
You saved my soul when I
was lost,
You've surely been good to
me;
You saved my soul when I
was lost,
You've surely been good to
me;
You saved my soul when I
was lost,
You've surely been good to
me;
You have done what this world
could not do.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
You filled me with the Holy
Ghost,
You've surely been good to
me;
You filled me with the Holy
Ghost,
You've surely been good to
me;
You filled me with the Holy
Ghost,
You've surely been good to
me;
You have done what this world
could not do.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
You healed my body when I
was sick,
You've surely been good to
me;
You healed my body when I
was sick,
You've surely been good to
me;
You healed my body when I
was sick,
You've surely been good to
me;
You have done what this world
could not do.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
What a wonderful thing,
A wonderful thing
To be saved from sin
And have peace within;
To be made a joint heir
With Jesus my King,
What a wonderful, wonderful
thing.

title: I GET SO THRILLED WITH JESUS

lyrics.label: Verse 1
Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Surely goodness and mercy
Shall follow me,
All the days, all the days of my
life;
Surely goodness and mercy
Shall follow me,
All the days, all the days of my
life.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
And I shall dwell in the house
of the Lord
forever;
And shall feast at the table
spread for me.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Surely goodness and mercy
Shall follow me
All the days, all the days of my
life.

title: GIVE ME OIL IN MY LAMP

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Give me oil in my lamp, keep
me burning,
Give me oil in my lamp I pray,
Give me oil in my lamp, keep
me burning;
Keep me burning 'til the break
of day.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Sing Hosanna! Sing Hosanna!
Sing Hosanna to the King of
kings!
Sing Hosanna! Sing Hosanna!
Sing Hosanna to the King of
kings.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I've got the joy-bells in my
heart,
I've got the joy-bells in my
heart,
I'll sing His praises
Through all ages,
I've got the joy-bells in my
heart.

title: WE HAVE COME INTO HIS HOUSE

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
We have come into His house
To magnify His name and
worship Him,
We have come into His house
To magnify His name and
worship Him,
We have come into His house
To magnify His name and
worship Christ the
Lord;
Worship Him, Christ the Lord.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
So forget about yourself,
Concentrate on Him and
worship Him;
So forget about yourself,
Concentrate on Him and
worship Him;
So forget about yourself,
Concentrate on Him and
worship Christ the
Lord;
Worship Him, Christ the Lord.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
Verse 1
lyrics.content: If you could own all the world and it's money, You could put up enough to reach the skies above, If you could know everything you want to know about my faith, Friend, you've known nothing until you've known the love of God.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Until you know the loving hand
That reaches down to fallen
man
And picks him up above the
plane
Where he has trod;
Until you know just how it feels
To know that God is really
real,
You know nothing
Until you know the love of
God.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
If in your lifetime you could
meet everybody,
And you could call every name
from here to
yonder,
If you've not come face to face
with Jesus
and His saving grace,
Friend, you've known nothing
until you've
known the love of God.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I have decided to follow Jesus,
(repeat 3 times)
No turning back, no turning
back.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
The cross before me the world
behind me,
(repeat 3 times)
No turning back, no turning
back.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Take this whole world but give
me Jesus,
(repeat 3 times)
No turning back, no turning
back.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Though none go with me, still I
will follow,
(repeat 3 times)
No turning back, no turning
back.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
My heart can sing when I
pause to remember,
A heart-ache here is but a
stepping-stone
Along the trail that's winding
always upward;
This troubled world is not my
final home.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
But until then, my heart will go
on singing,
Until then, with joy I'll carry on,
Until the day mine eyes
behold the city
Until the day God calls me
home.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
The things of earth will dim
and lose their
value,
If we recall, they're borrowed
for awhile;
And things of earth that cause
the heart to
tremble,
Remember there, will only
bring a smile.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
This weary world with all its toil
and struggle
May take its toll of misery and
strife;
The soul of man is like a
waiting falcon,
When it's released, it's
destined for the sky.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Joy to the world, the Lord is
come!
Let earth receive her King;
Let every heart prepare Him
room,
And heaven and nature sing,
And heaven and nature sing,
And heaven, and heaven, and
nature sing.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Joy to the world, the Saviour
reigns!
Let men their songs employ;
While fields and floods, rocks,
hills and
plains
Repeat the sounding joy,
Repeat the sounding joy,
Repeat, repeat, the sounding
joy.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
No more let sins and sorrows
grow,
Nor thorns infest the ground;
He comes to make His
Far as the curse is found,
blessings flow
Far as the curse is found,
Far as, far as, the curse is
found.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
He rules the world with truth
and grace,
And makes the nations prove
The glories of His
righteousness,
And wonders of His love,
And wonders of His love,
And wonders, and wonders, of
His love.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Wonderful! Wonderful!
Wonderful!
Wonderful story of love!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Wonderful story of love,
Though you are far away;
Wonderful story of love,
Still He doth call today;
Calling from Calvary's
mountain,
Down from the crystal bright
fountain,
E'en from the dawn of
creation,

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Wonderful story of love.
Wonderful story of love,
Jesus provides the rest;
Wonderful story of love,
For all the pure and blest;
Rest in those mansions above
us,
With those who've gone on
before us,
Singing the rapturous chorus:
Wonderful story of love.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Hallelujah joy (3ce)
We shall sing on that day,
Joy, joy, joy,
Hallelujah joy, hallelujah joy,
We shall sing on that day.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Will you be among? (3ce)
When we sing on that day,
Joy, joy, joy,
Hallelujah joy, hallelujah joy
We shall sing on that day.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
I will be among (3ce)
When we sing on that day,
Joy, joy, joy,
Hallelujah joy, hallelujah joy
We shall sing on that day.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Be gone unbelief my Saviour
is near
And for my relief will surely
appear;
By prayer let me wrestle, and
He will
perform,
With Christ in the vessel, I
smile at the storm.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Though, dark be my way!
Since He is my
Guide:
'Tis mine to obey, 'tis His to
provide;
Though cisterns be broken
and creatures all
fail,
The word He hath spoken
shall surely
prevail.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
His love in time past forbids
me to think
He'll leave me at last in trouble
to sink;
While each Ebenezer I have in
review
Confirms His good pleasure to
help me quite
through.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Why should I complain of
wants and distress,
Temptation or pain? He told
me no less;
The heirs of salvation, I know
from His word,
Through much tribulation,
must follow the
Lord.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Since all that I meet shall work
for my good,
The bitter is sweet, the
medicine food;
Though painful at present,
'twill cease before
long,
And then O how pleasant the
conqueror's
song.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Jesus, lover of my soul, let me
to Thy bosom
fly,
While the billows near me roll,
while the
tempest still is high.
Hide me, O my Saviour, hide,
till the storm
of life is past;
Safe into the haven guide; O
receive my soul
at last!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Other refuge have I none,
hangs my helpless
soul on Thee;
Leave, O, leave me not alone!
Still support
and comfort me;
All my trust on Thee is stayed,
all my help
from Thee I bring;
Cover my defenceless head
with the shadow
of Thy wing.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Wilt Thou not regard my call?
Wilt Thou not
accept my prayer?
Lo! I sink, I faint, I fall-Lo! On
Thee I cast
my care;
Reach me out Thy gracious
hand! While I of
Thy strength receive,
Hoping against hope I stand,
dying, and
behold, I live.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Thou, O Christ, art all I want,
more than all
in Thee I find;
Raise the fallen, cheer the
faint, heal the sick,
and lead the blind.
Just and holy is Thy name, I
am all
unrighteousness;
Vile and full of sin I am; Thou
art full of
truth and grace.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Plenteous grace with Thee is
found, -grace to
pardon all my sin;
Let the healing streams
abound, make and
keep me pure within.
Thou of life the Fountain art,
freely let me
take of Thee;
Spring Thou up within my
heart; rise to all
eternity.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Nearer, my God, to Thee,
nearer to Thee!
Even though it be a cross that
raiseth me;
Still all my song shall be,
Nearer, my God, to Thee,
Nearer, my God, to Thee,
Nearer to Thee!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Though like the wanderer, the
sun gone
down,
Darkness be over me, my rest
a stone;
Yet in my dreams I'd be,
Nearer, my God, to Thee,
Nearer, my God, to Thee,
Nearer to Thee!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
There let the way appear,
steps unto Heaven:
All that Thou sendest me, in
mercy giv'n:
Angels to beckon me,
Nearer, my God, to Thee,
Nearer, my God, to Thee,
Nearer to Thee!

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Then, with my waking
thoughts, bright with
Thy praise,
Out of my stony grief, Bethel
I'll raise;
So by my woes to be,
Nearer, my God, to Thee,
Nearer, my God, to Thee,
Nearer to Thee!

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Or if on joyful wing, cleaving
the sky,
Sun, moon and stars forgot,
upward I fly;
Still all my song shall be,
Nearer, my God, to Thee,
Nearer, my God, to Thee,
Nearer to Thee!

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
When I think of the goodness
of Jesus
And all He has done for me
Then my soul cries out
"Hallelujah!
Praise God for saving me!"

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
O the judgment day is coming,
What an awful day it will be!
Christ forever is my refuge,
Rock of Ages cleft for me.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
O, my loving brother,
When the world's on fire
Don't you want God's bosom
To be your pillow?
Hide me over in the Rock of
Ages;
Rock of Ages cleft for me.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
At the sounding of the
trumpet,
At the dawning of the day,
Worldly pleasures with its
treasures,
Shall forever pass away.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Poor lost sinners will be crying
For the home they'll never
see;
But the ransomed will be
singing:
"Rock of Ages cleft for me."

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I've been to the water and I've
been baptized;
I've been washed in the blood
of the Lamb;
I've been changed from the
creature
That I once was,
And "Redeemed" is now my
name.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
I've been changed; I've been
reborn,
All my life has been
rearranged;
What a difference it makes
When the Lord has His way
All my life, praise God, has
been changed.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
lyrics.content:
When at last in His presence I
stand above,
He will wipe every tear from
my eyes;
And I'll thank Him for giving
A wretch like me,
A new home beyond the sky

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
We are together again:
We are together again,
Just praising the Lord:
Just praising the Lord,
We are together again:
We are together again,
In one accord:
In one accord.
Something good is already
happening,
Something better is in store.
We are together again:
We are together again,
Just praising the Lord:
Just praising the Lord.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Jerusalem on high
My song and city is,
My home whene'er I die
The center of my bliss.

lyrics.label: Chorus
lyrics.content:
O happy place!
When shall I be, my God with
Thee,
To see Thy face?

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Earth's but a sorry tent,
Pitched but a few frail days,
A short leased tenement;
Heaven's still my song, my
praise.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
There should temptations
cease,
My frailities there should end.
There should I rest in peace
In the arms of my best friend.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
There dwells my Lord, my
King,
Judged here unfit to live;
There angels to Him sing,
And lowly homage give.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
The patriarchs of old
There from their travels cease:
The prophets there behold:
Their longed for Prince of
peace.

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lyrics.content:
The Lamb's apostles there
I might with joy behold:
The harpers I might hear:
Harping on harps of
gold.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Some glad morning when this
life is o'er
I'll fly away,
To a home on God's celestial
shore,
I'll fly away.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
I'll fly away, O glory, I'll fly
away;
When I die, hallelujah, by and
by
I'll fly away.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
When the shadow, of this life
has grown,
I'll fly away;
Like a bird from prison bars
has flown,
I'll fly away.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Just a few more weary days
and then,
I'll fly away;
To a land where joys shall
never end,
I'll fly away.

title: 'TIS SO SWEET TO TRUST IN JESUS

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
'Tis so sweet to trust in Jesus,
Just to take Him at His word;
Just to rest upon His promise,
Just to know, "Thus saith the
Lord."

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Jesus, Jesus, how I trust Him!
How I've proved Him o'er and
o'er!
Jesus, Jesus, precious Jesus!
O, for grace to trust Him more!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
O, how sweet to trust in Jesus,
Just to trust His cleansing
blood;
Just in simple faith to plunge
me
'Neath the healing, cleansing
flood!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Yes, 'tis sweet to trust in
Jesus,
Just from sin and self to
cease;
Just from Jesus simply taking
Life and rest, and joy, and
peace.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
I'm so glad I learned to trust
Thee,
Precious Jesus, Saviour,
Friend;
And I know that Thou art with
me,
Wilt be with me to the end.

title: O, FOR A THOUSAND TONGUES TO SING

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
O, for a thousand tongues to
sing
My great Redeemer's praise,
The glories of my God and
King,
The triumphs of His grace.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
My gracious Master and my
God,
Assist me to proclaim
To spread through all the
earth abroad,
The honours of Thy name.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Jesus! The name that charms
our fears,
That bids our sorrows cease;
'Tis music in the sinner's ears,
'Tis life, and health and peace.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
He breaks the powers of
cancelled sin,
He sets the prisoner free,
His blood can make the
foulest clean,
His blood avails for me.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Hear Him, ye deaf; His praise,
ye dumb,
Your loosened tongues
employ;
Ye blind, behold your Saviour
come;
And leap, ye lame, for joy.

title: BE GLAD IN THE LORD AND REJOICE

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Be glad in the Lord and
rejoice,
All ye that are upright in heart;
And ye that have made Him
your choice,
Bid sadness and sorrow
depart.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Rejoice!... Rejoice!...
Be glad in the Lord and
rejoice!
Rejoice!... Rejoice!...
Be glad in the Lord and
rejoice.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Be joyful, for He is the Lord
On earth and in Heaven,
Supreme;
He fashions and rules by His
word;
The "Mighty" and "Strong" to
redeem.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
What though in the conflict for
right
Your enemies almost prevail!
God's armies, just hid from
your sight
Are more than the foes which
assail.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Though darkness surround
you by day,
Your sky by the night be
overcast;
Let nothing your spirit dismay,
But trust till the danger is past.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Be glad in the Lord and
rejoice,
His praises proclaiming in
songs;
With harp, and with organ, and
voice,
The loud hallelujahs prolong!

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Ye thirsty for God, to Jesus
give ear,
And take, through His blood, a
power to draw near;
His kind invitation ye sinners
embrace,
Accepting salvation, salvation
by grace.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Sent down from above, Who
governs the skies,
In vehement love to sinners
He cries,
Drink into my Spirit, who
happy would be,
And all things inherit by
coming to Me.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
O Saviour of all, Thy Word we
believe!
And come at Thy call, Thy
grace to receive;
The blessing is given
wherever Thou art.
The earnest of heaven is love
in the heart.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
To us at Thy feet the
Comforter give,
Who gasp to admit Thy Spirit,
and live;
The weakest believers
acknowledge for Thine,
And fill us with rivers of water
divine.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
When the host of Israel, led by
God,
Round the walls of Jericho
softly trod,
Trusting in the Lord, they felt
the conqueror's
tread
By faith they saw the victory
ahead.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Victory ahead! Victory ahead!
Through the blood of Jesus,
victory ahead,
Trusting in the Lord, I hear the
conqueror's
tread;
By faith I see the victory
ahead.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
David with a shepherd's sling
and five
stones,
Met the giant on the field all
alone;
Trusting in the Lord, he knew
what God had
said;
By faith he saw the victory
ahead.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Daniel prayed unto the Lord
thrice each day,
Then unto the lion's den led
the way;
Trusting in the Lord, he did not
fear or dread;
By faith he saw the victory
ahead.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Often with the carnal mind I
was tried,
Asking for deliverance, oft I
cried;
Trusting in the Lord, I
reckoned I was dead;
By faith I see the victory
ahead.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
When, like those who've gone
before to that
land,
By death's river cold and dark
I shall stand;
Trusting in the Lord, I will not
fear or dread,
By faith I see the victory
ahead.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
He is Lord; He is Lord.
He has risen from the dead
and He is Lord.
Every knee shall bow, every
tongue confess
That Jesus Christ is Lord.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
CHORUS
Verse 2
lyrics.content:
I come to Thee.
I need Thee every hour;
Stay Thou near by
Temptations lose their power
When Thou art near.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
Verse 4

title: HAPPINESS IS TO KNOW THE SAVIOUR

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Happiness is to know the
Saviour,
Living a life within His favour,
Having a change in my
behaviour.
Happiness is the Lord.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Happiness is the creation,
Jesus and me in close
relation;
Having a part in His salvation,
Happiness is the Lord.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Happiness is to be forgiven,
Living a life that's worth living,
Taking a trip that leads to
Heaven;
Happiness is the Lord. (3ce)

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Redemption! O, wonderful
story,
Glad message for you and for
me;
That Jesus has purchased our
pardon,
And paid all the debt on the
tree.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
Verse 2
lyrics.content:
From death into life He hath
brought us,
And made us by grace sons of
God;
A fountain is opened for all
sinners;
O, wash and be cleansed in
the blood!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
No longer shall sin have
dominion,
Though present to tempt and
annoy;
For Christ, in His blessed
redemption,
The power of sin shall destroy.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Along life's way, I stumble in
the darkness,
My blinded eyes had caused
my feet to roam;
I met the Lord who spoke to
me so sweetly,
"I'll walk with you, and I will
see you
through."

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Come walk with me, the way is
strait and
narrow,
Come walk with me, I cannot
walk alone;
For the road is rough and
there are many dangers,
Come walk with me, come and
see me
through.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
So now I walk with Christ my
blessed
Saviour,
I do not fear, for I am not
alone;
He guides me through all life
with all its sorrows,
And someday soon, He'll see
me safely home.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Faith of our fathers living still,
Inspite of dungeon, fire, and
sword:
O how our hearts beat high
with joy
When e'er we hear that
glorious word:
"Faith of our fathers," holy
faith!
We will be true to thee till
death.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Our fathers chained in prisons
dark,
Were still in heart and
conscience free;
How sweet will be their
children's fate!
If they, like them, could die for
thee:
Faith of our fathers, holy faith!
We will be true to thee till
death.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Faith of our fathers! We will
strive
To win all nations unto thee,
And through the truth that
comes from God
Mankind shall then be truly
free:
Faith of our fathers, holy faith!
We will be true to thee till
death.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Faith of our fathers! We will
love,
Both friends and foes in all our
strife;
And preach thee, too, as love
knows how,
By kindly word and virtuous
life:
Faith of our fathers, holy faith!
We will be true to thee till
death.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
All is well, all is well;
We have heard the message:
"Shalom"
All is well;
There is a place of perfect rest
Behind the inner veil,
So rest, little bride rest,
All is well.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Be like Jesus,' tis my song,
In the home and in the throng;
Be like Jesus, all day long!
I would be like Jesus.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
He has broken every fetter,
I would be like Jesus;
That my soul may serve Him
better,
I would be like Jesus.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
All the way from earth to glory,
I would be like Jesus;
Telling o'er and o'er the story,
I would be like Jesus.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
That in Heaven He may meet
me,
I would be like Jesus;
That His words, "well done",
may greet me,
I would be like Jesus.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Holy! Holy! Holy! Lord God
Almighty!
Early in the morning our song
shall rise to
Thee;
Holy! Holy! Holy! Merciful and
mighty!
God in Christ Jesus, blessed
unity!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Holy! Holy! Holy! All the saints
adore Thee,
Casting down their golden
crowns around the
glassy sea;
Cherubim and Seraphim
falling down before
Thee,
Which wert, and art, and
evermore shall be.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Holy! Holy! Holy! Though the
darkness hide
Thee,
Though the eye of sinful man
Thy glory may
not see,
Only Thou art holy; there is
none beside Thee
Perfect in power, in love, and
purity.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Holy! Holy! Holy! Lord God
Almighty!
All Thy works shall praise Thy
name in
earth, and sky, and sea;
Holy! Holy! Holy! Merciful and
mighty!
God in Christ Jesus, blessed
unity.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Anywhere with Jesus I can
safely go!
Anywhere He leads me in this
world below!
Anywhere without Him dearest
joys would
fade;
Anywhere with Jesus I am not
afraid.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Anywhere! Anywhere!
Fear I cannot know;
Anywhere with Jesus I can
safely go!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Anywhere with Jesus I am not
alone!
Other friends may fail me, He
is still my
own!
Though His hand may lead me
over dreary
ways,
Anywhere with Jesus is a
house of praise.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Anywhere with Jesus over
land and sea,
Telling soul in darkness of
salvation free;
Ready as He summons me to
go or stay,
Anywhere with Jesus when He
points the
way!

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Anywhere with Jesus I can go
to sleep,
When the gloomy shadows
round about me
creep!
Knowing I shall waken never
more to roam;
Anywhere with Jesus will be
"home, sweet
home."

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
From glory to glory He's
changing me,
Changing me! Changing me!
His likeness and image to
perfect in me,
The love of God shown to the
world;
For He's changing, changing
me,
From earthly things to the
heavenly,
His likeness and image to
perfect in me,
The love of God shown to the
world.

title: CREATE IN ME A CLEAN HEART

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Create in me a clean heart, O
God,
And renew a right spirit within
me;
Create in me a clean heart, O
God,
And renew a right spirit within
me.
Cast me not away from Thy
presence O Lord,
And take not Thy Holy Spirit
from me,
Restore unto me the joy of
salvation,
And renew a right spirit within
me.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I like the old-time way
I like the old-time way
I like the old-time preaching,
singing, shouting, praying
I like the old time way.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
I like the old time living,
dancing, singing, praying,
I like the old time way.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
I sing about my Saviour
everywhere I go,
Everywhere I go, everywhere I
go;
I sing about my Saviour
everywhere I go
For there's joy, joy in my soul.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Lord speak to me that I may
speak
In living echoes of Thy tone,
As Thou hast sought, so let
me seek
Thy erring children lost and
lone.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
O, use me Lord, use even me
Just as Thou wilt, and when,
and where.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
O, lead me, Lord, that I may
lead
The wandering and the
wavering feet
O, feed me, Lord, that I may
feed
Thy hungering ones with
manna sweet.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
O, strengthen me, that while I
stand
Firm on the rock and strong in
Thee,
I may stretch out a loving hand
To wrestlers with the troubled
sea.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
O, fill me with Thy fullness
Lord
Until my very heart o'erflow
In kindly thought and glowing
word
Thy love to tell, Thy praise to
show.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
O, give Thine sweet rest to me
That I may speak with
soothing power
A word in season, as from
Thee
To weary ones in needful
hour.

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lyrics.content:
Lord, bend my will and make it
Thine
My inner man broken and
meek
Living my all only for Thee
Until Thy blessed face I see.

title: I'LL SEE YOU IN THE RAPTURE

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
I'll see you in the rapture,
I'll see you in the rapture,
I'll see you at that meeting in
the air;
There with our blessed
Saviour
We'll live and reign forever
I'll see you in the rapture some
sweet day.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
If we never meet again on this
earth my
precious friend,
If to God you have been true
and lived above
all sin;
Then for us there'll be a
greeting, for there's
going to be a meeting
I'll see you in the rapture some
sweet day.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
To my loved ones let me say,
there will
surely come a day,
When the Lord will come
again and catch His
bride away;
So get ready now to meet Him
and with
hallelujah greet Him!
I'll see you in the rapture some
sweet day.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Immortal, invisible, God only
wise,
In light inaccessible hid from
our eyes,
Most blessed most glorious,
the Ancient of
Days,
Almighty, victorious, Thy great
name we praise.
Unresting, unhasting, and
silent as light,
Nor wanting, nor wasting,
Thou rulest in
might;
Thy Justice like mountains
high soaring above
Thy clouds, which are
fountains of goodness
and love.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
To all life Thou givest to both
great and
small;
In all life Thou livest, the true
life of all;
We blossom and flourish, as
leaves on the
tree,
Then wither and perish,-but
nought changeth
Thee

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Great Father of Glory, pure
Father of Light,
Thine angels adore Thee, all
veiling their sight:
All laud we would render: O
help us to see
'Tis only the splendour of light
hideth Thee.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Lord Jesus, receive me,
No more would I grieve Thee;
Now, blessed Redeemer,
O, save me at the cross

lyrics.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Wash me in Thy cleansing
blood,
Cleansing blood, cleansing
blood,
Plunge me now beneath the
flood;
O, save me at the cross!
Only faith will pardon bring,
Pardon bring, pardon bring,
To that faith to Thee I cling;
O, save me at the cross!

title: CAST THY BURDEN ON THE LORD

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Cast thy burden on the Lord,
Only lean upon His Word;
Thou wilt soon have cause to
bless
His eternal faithfulness.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
He sustains thee by His hand,
He enables thee to stand;
Those whom Jesus once hath
loved
From His grace are never
moved.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Human counsels come to
naught;
That shall stand which God
hath wrought;
His compassion, love, and
power
Are the same forevermore.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Heav'n and earth may pass
away,
God's free grace shall not
decay;
He hath promised to fulfil
All the pleasure of His will.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Jesus, Guardian of Thy flock,
Be Thyself our constant Rock;
Make us, by Thy powerful
hand
Strong as Zion's mountain
stand

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Be still, my soul: the Lord is on
thy side.
Bear patiently the cross of
grief or pain.
Leave to thy God to order and
provide;
In every change, He faithful
will remain.
Be still, my soul: thy best, thy
heavenly
Friend
Through thorny ways leads to
a joyful end.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Be still, my soul: thy God doth
undertake
To guide the future, as He has
the past.
Thy hope, thy confidence let
nothing shake;
All now mysterious shall be
bright at last.
Be still, my soul: the waves
and winds still
know
His voice Who ruled them
while He dwelt
below.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Be still, my soul: when dearest
friends depart,
And all is darkened in the vale
of tears,
Then shalt thou better know
His love, His
heart;
Who comes to soothe thy
sorrow and thy
fears.
Be still, my soul: thy Jesus can
repay
From His own fullness all He
takes away.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Be still, my soul: the hour is
hastening on
When we shall be forever with
the Lord.
When disappointment, grief
and fear are
gone,
Sorrow forgot, love's purest
joys restored.
Be still, my soul: when change
and tears are
past
All safe and blessed we shall
meet at last.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Be still, my soul: begin the
song of praise
On earth, be living to Thy Lord
on high;
Acknowledge Him in all thy
words and ways,
So shall He view thee with a
well pleased
eye.
Be still, my soul: the sun of life
divine
Through passing clouds shall
but more
brightly shine.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
All glory, laud and honour,
To Thee, Redeemer, King,
To whom the lips of children
Made sweet hosannas ring.
Thou art the King of Israel,
Thou David's royal Son,
Who in the Lord's name
comest,
The King and Blessed One.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
The company of angels
Are praising Thee on high,
And mortal men and all things
Created make reply.
The people of the Hebrews
With palms before Thee went;
Our praise and prayer and
anthems
Before Thee we present.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
To Thee, before Thy passion,
They sang their hymns of
praise;
To Thee, now high exalted,
Our melody we raise.
Thou didst accept their
praises;
Accept the praise we bring,
Who in all good delightest,
Thou good and gracious King.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
There is only one God,
There is only one King
There is only one Body
That is why we sing:

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Bind us together, Lord
Bind us together
With cord that cannot be
broken;
Bind us together, Lord
Bind us together, Lord
Bind us together in love.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Made for the glory of God,
Purchased by His precious
Son.
Born with the right to be clean,
For Jesus the victory has won.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
We are the family of God,
We are the promise divine,
We are God's chosen desire,
We are the glorious new race.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
There's a line that's drawn by
rejecting our
Lord,
Where the call of His Spirit is
lost
And you hurry along with the
pleasure-mad
throng
Have you counted, have you
counted the cost?

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Have you counted the cost, if
your soul
should be lost,
Though you gain the whole
world for your own?
Even now it may be that the
line you have
crossed,
Have you counted, have you
counted the cost?

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
You may barter your hope of
eternity's morn,
For a moment of joy at the
most,
For the glitter of sin and the
things it will
win-
Have you counted, have you
counted the cost?

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
While the door of His mercy is
open to you,
Ere the depth of your folly you
come
Won't you come and be
healed, won't you
whisper, I yield?
I have counted, I have
counted the cost.

title: GUIDE ME, O THOU GREAT JEHOVAH

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Guide me, O Thou great
Jehovah,
Pilgrim through this barren
land.
I am weak, but Thou art
mighty;
Hold me with Thy powerful
hand.
Bread of Heaven
Feed me till I want no more;
Bread of Heaven
Feed me till I want no more.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Open now the crystal fountain,
Whence the healing stream
doth flow;
Let the fiery, cloudy pillar
Lead me all my journey
through.
Strong Deliverer
Be Thou still my strength and
shield;
Strong Deliverer
Be Thou still my strength and
shield.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Lord, I trust Thy mighty power,
Wondrous are Thy works of
old;
Thou deliver'st Thine from
thralldom,
Who for naught themselves
had sold:
Thou didst conquer
Sin, and Satan and the grave,
Thou didst conquer
Sin, and Satan and the grave.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
When I tread the verge of
Jordan,
Bid my anxious fears subside;
Bear me through the swelling
torrent,
Land me safe on Canaan's
side.
Songs of praises,
I will ever give to Thee;
Songs of praises,
I will ever give to Thee.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Savior come we long to see
Thee,
Long to dwell with Thee
above;
And to know in full communion
All the sweetness of Thy love.
Come Lord Jesus,
Take Thy waiting people
home;
Come Lord Jesus,
Take Thy waiting people
home.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Praise Him! Praise Him!
Jesus, our blessed
Redeemer!
Sing, O earth, His wonderful
love proclaim!
Hail Him! Hail Him! Highest
archangels in
glory;
Strength and honour give to
His holy name!
Like a shepherd, Jesus will
guard His
children,
In His arms He carries them all
day long;

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Praise Him! Praise Him!
Tell of His excellent greatness;
Praise Him! Praise Him ever in
joyful song!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Praise Him! Praise Him!
Jesus, our blessed
Redeemer!
For our sins He suffered, and
bled and died;
He, -our Rock, our hope of
eternal salvation,
Hail Him! Hail Him! Jesus the
Crucified;
Sound His praises! Jesus who
bore our
sorrows,
Love unbounded, wonderful,
deep and
strong;

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Praise Him! Praise Him!
Jesus, our blessed
Redeemer!
Heavenly portals, loud with
hosannas ring!
Jesus, Saviour, reigneth
forever and ever;
Crown Him! Crown Him!
Prophet, and
Priest, and King!
Christ is coming over the
world victorious,
Power and glory unto the Lord
belong;

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Come, ye sinners, poor and
needy,
Weak and wounded, sick and
sore;
Jesus ready stands to save
you,
Full of pity, love and power.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
I will arise and go to Jesus,
He will embrace me in His
arms;
In the arms of my dear
Saviour,
O there are ten thousand
charms.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Come, ye thirsty, come, and
welcome,
God's free bounty glorify;
True belief and true
repentance,
Every grace that brings you
nigh.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Come, ye weary, heavy laden,
Lost and ruined by the fall;
If you tarry till you're better,
You will never come at all.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
View Him prostrate in the
garden;
On the ground your Saviour
lies.
On the bloody tree behold
Him;
Sinner, will this not suffice?

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Lo, the incarnate God
ascended,
Pleads the merit of His blood:
Venture on Him, venture
wholly,
Let no other trust intrude.

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lyrics.content:
Let not conscience make you
linger,
Not of fitness fondly dream;
All the fitness He requireth
Is to feel your need of Him.

title: PRAISE TO THE LORD, THE ALMIGHTY

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Praise to the Lord, the
Almighty, the King of
creation!
O my soul, praise Him, for He
is thy health
and salvation!
All ye who hear, now to His
temple draw
near;
Praise Him in glad adoration.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Praise to the Lord, who o'er all
things so
wondrously reigneth,
Shelters thee under His wings,
yea, so gently
sustaineth!
Hast thou not seen how thy
desires e'er have
been
Granted in what He ordaineth?

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Praise to the Lord, who hath
fearfully,
wondrously, made thee;
Health hath vouchsafed and,
when heedlessly
falling, hath stayed thee.
What need or grief ever hath
failed of relief?
Wings of His mercy did shade
thee.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Praise to the Lord, who doth
prosper thy
work and defend thee;
Surely His goodness and
mercy here daily
attend thee.
Ponder anew what the
Almighty can do,
If with His love He befriend
thee.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Praise to the Lord, who, when
tempests their
warfare are waging,
Who, when the elements
madly around thee
are raging,
Biddeth them cease, turneth
their fury to
peace,
Whirlwinds and waters
assuaging.

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lyrics.content:
Praise to the Lord, who, when
darkness of sin
is abounding,
Who, when the godless do
triumph, all virtue
confounding,
Sheddeth His light, chaseth
the horrors of
night,
Saints with His mercy
surrounding.

lyrics.label: Verse 7
lyrics.content:
Praise to the Lord, O let all
that is in me
adore Him!
All that hath life and breath,
come now with
praises before Him.
Let the "AMEN!" sound from
His people
again,
Gladly for all we adore Him.

title: BREATHE ON ME, BREATH OF GOD

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Breathe on me, breath of God,
Fill me with life anew,
That I may love what Thou
dost love,
And do what Thou wouldst do.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Breathe on me, breath of God,
Until my heart is pure,
Until with Thee I will one will,
To do and to endure.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Breathe on me, breath of God,
Till I am wholly Thine
Until this earthly part of me
Glows with Thy fire divine.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Breathe on me, breath of God,
So shall I constant be,
But live with Thee the perfect
life
Of Thine eternity.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Jesus, Friend of little children,
Be a Friend to me;
Take my hand and ever keep
me
Close to Thee.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Teach me how to grow in
goodness,
Daily as I grow;
Thou hast been a Child and
surely
Thou dost know.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Step by step, O, lead me
onward,
Upward into youth;
Wiser, stronger, still becoming
In Thy truth.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Never leave me nor forsake
me,
Ever be my Friend;
For I need Thee from life's
dawning
To its end.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Abide with me; fast falls the
eventide;
The darkness deepens; Lord
with me abide!
When other helpers fail, and
comforts flee,
Help of the helpless, O, abide
with me!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Swift to its close ebbs out life's
little day;
Earth's joys grow dim, its
glories pass away;
Change and decay in all
around I see!
O Thou who changest not,
abide with me!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
I need Thy presence every
passing hour;
What but Thy grace can foil
the tempter's
power?
Who like Thyself my guide and
stay can be?
Through cloud and sunshine,
O, abide with
me!

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
I fear no foe, with Thee at
hand to bless;
Ills have no weight, and tears
no bitterness;
Where is death's sting?
Where, grave, thy
victory?
I'll triumph still if Thou abide
with me!

title: LET US WITH A GLADSOME MIND

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Let us with a gladsome mind
Praise the Lord for He is kind;
For His mercies shall endure,
Ever faithful, ever sure.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
He, with all-commanding
might
Filled the new-made world
with light;
For His mercies shall endure,
Ever faithful, ever sure.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
All things living He doth feed,
His full hand supplies their
need;
For His mercies shall endure,
Ever faithful, ever sure.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Let us, then, with gladsome
mind
Praise the Lord for He is kind;
For His mercies shall endure,
Ever faithful, ever sure.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
There is a balm in Gilead to
make the
wounded whole;
There is a balm in Gilead to
heal the sin-sick
soul.
Some times I feel
discouraged,
And think my work's in vain,
But then the Holy Spirit
Revives my soul again.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
There is a balm in Gilead to
make the
wounded whole;
There is a balm in Gilead to
heal the sin-sick
soul.
If you cannot preach like
Peter,
If you cannot pray like Paul,
Just tell the love of Jesus,
And say He died for all.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
As water to the thirsty,
As beauty to the eyes,
As strength that follows
weakness,
As Truth instead of lies,
As songtime and springtime
and summertime
to be,
So is my Lord, my living Lord,
So is my Lord to me.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Like calm in place of clamour,
Like peace that follows pain,
Like meeting after parting,
Like sunshine after rain,
Like moonlight and starlight
and sunlight on
the sea,
So is my Lord, my living Lord,
So is my Lord to me.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
As sleep that follows fever,
As gold instead of grey,
As freedom after bondage,
As sunrise to the day,
As home to the traveller and
all he longs to
see,
So is my Lord, my living Lord,
So is my Lord to me.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Worthy, worthy is the Lamb
Worthy, worthy is the Lamb
Worthy, worthy is the Lamb
That was slain.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Glory, Hallelujah!
Praise Him Hallelujah!
Glory Hallelujah!
To the Lamb!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Saviour let Thy kingdom
come!
Now the power of sin
consume;
Bring Thy blest millennium,
Holy Lamb.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Thus may we each moment
feel,
Love Him, serve Him, praise
Him still,
Till we all on Zion's hill
See the Lamb.

title: LORD JESUS ONCE YOU SPOKE TO MEN

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Lord Jesus once You spoke to
men
Upon the mountain and the
plain,
O help us listen now as then
And wonder at Your words
again.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
We all have secret fears to
face,
Our minds and motives to
amend.
We seek Your truth, we need
Your grace,
Our living Lord and precious
Friend.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
The gospel speaks and we
receive
Your light, Your love, Your
own command.
O, help us live what we
believe,
In daily word of heart and
hand.

title: GOD OF GRACE AND GOD OF GLORY

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
God of grace and God of
glory,
On Thy people pour Thy
power;
Crown Thine ancient church's
story,
Bring her bud to glorious
flower.
Grant us wisdom, grant us
courage,
For the facing of this hour,
For the facing of this hour.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Lo, the hosts of evil 'round us
Scorn Thy Christ, assail His
ways;
From the fears that long have
bound us
Free our hearts to faith and
praise.
Grant us wisdom, grant us
courage,
For the living of these days,
For the living of these days.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Cure Thy children's warring
madness,
Bend our pride to Thy control;
Shame our wanton, selfish
gladness,
Rich in things and poor in soul.
Grant us wisdom, grant us
courage,
Lest we miss Thy kingdom's
goal,
Lest we miss Thy kingdom's
goal.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Set our feet on lofty places,
Gird our lives that they may be
Armoured with all Christ-like
graces
In the fight to set men free.
Grant us wisdom, grant us
courage,
That we fail not man nor Thee,
That we fail not man nor Thee.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Save us from weak
resignation
To the evils we deplore;
Let the search for Thy
salvation
Be our glory evermore.
Grant us wisdom, grant us
courage,
Serving Thee Whom we
adore,
Serving Thee Whom we
adore.

title: GOD WILL TAKE CARE OF YOU

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Be not dismayed whatever
betide,
God will take care of you;
Beneath His wings of love
abide,
God will take care of you.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
God will take care of you,
Through everyday, o'er all the
way;
He will take care of you,
God will take care of you.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Through days of trial when
your heart doth fail,
God will take care of you;
When dangers fierce your
path assail,
God will take care of you.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
All you may need He will
provide,
God will take care of you;
Nothing you ask will be
denied,
God will take care of you.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
No matter what may be the
test,
God will take care of you;
Lean, weary one, upon His
breast,
God will take care of you.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
How firm a foundation, ye
saints of the Lord,
Is laid for your faith in His
excellent Word!
What more can He say than to
you He hath said,
You, who unto Jesus for
refuge have fled?

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
In every condition, in sickness,
in health;
In poverty's vale, or abounding
in wealth;
At home and abroad, on the
land, on the sea,
As thy days may demand,
shall thy strength
ever be.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
"Fear not, I am with thee, O be
not dismayed!
For I am thy God, I will still
give thee aid;
I'll strengthen and help thee,
and cause thee
to stand
Upheld by My gracious,
omnipotent hand."

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
"When through the deep
waters I call thee to go,
The rivers of woe shall not
thee overflow;
For I will be with thee, thy
troubles to bless,
And sanctify to thee thy
deepest distress."
"When through fiery trials thy
pathways shall lie,
My grace, all sufficient, shall
be thy supply;
The flame shall not hurt thee; I
only design
Thy dross to consume, and
thy gold to
refine."

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
When through fiery trials thy
pathways shall lie,
My grace, all sufficient, shall
be thy supply;
The flame shall not hurt thee; I
only design
Thy dross to consume, and
thy gold to
refine.

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lyrics.content:
"Even down to old age all My
people shall prove
My sovereign, eternal,
unchangeable love;
And when hoary hairs shall
their temples adorn
Like lambs, they shall still in
My bosom be borne.

lyrics.label: Verse 7
lyrics.content:
The soul that on Jesus has
leaned for repose,
I will not, I will not desert to its
foes;
That soul, though all hell
should endeavour to shake,
I'll never, no never, no never
forsake!"

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Everybody ought to know
(Everybody ought to know),
Everybody ought to know
(Everybody ought to know),
Everybody ought to know
(Everybody ought to know),
Who Jesus is (Who Jesus is)
Everybody ought to know
(Everybody ought to know),
Everybody ought to know
(Everybody ought to know),
Everybody ought to know
(Everybody ought to know),
Who Jesus is (Who Jesus is)

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
He's the Lily Of The Valley,
He's the Bright And Morning
Star,
He's the Fairest of Ten
Thousand,
Everybody ought to know.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Everybody ought to love
(Everybody ought to love),
Everybody ought to love
(Everybody ought to love),
Everybody ought to love
(Everybody ought to love),
Who Jesus is (Who Jesus is)
Everybody ought to love
(Everybody ought to love),
Everybody ought to love
(Everybody ought to love),
Everybody ought to love
(Everybody ought to love),
Who Jesus is (Who Jesus is)

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Everybody ought to tell
(Everybody ought to tell),
Everybody ought to tell
(Everybody ought to tell),
Everybody ought to tell
(Everybody ought to tell),
Who Jesus is (Who Jesus is)
Everybody ought to tell
(Everybody ought to tell),
Everybody ought to tell
(Everybody ought to tell),
Everybody ought to tell
(Everybody ought to tell),
Who Jesus is (Who Jesus is)

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Everybody ought to sing
(Everybody ought to sing),
Everybody ought to sing
(Everybody ought to sing),
Everybody ought to sing
(Everybody ought to sing),
Glad praise to Him (Glad
praise to Him)
Everybody ought to sing
(Everybody ought to sing),
Everybody ought to sing
(Everybody ought to sing),
Everybody ought to sing
(Everybody ought to sing),
Glad praise to Him (Glad
praise to Him)

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
On Zion's summit stood
glorious
A host by blood,
numerous redeemed
They hymned their King in
strains divine:
I heard the song and strove to
join;
I heard the song and strove to
join.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Here all who suffered sword or
flame
For Jesus' truth or lovely
name,
Shout victory now and hail the
Lamb:
And bow before the great I
AM;
And bow before the great I
AM.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
While everlasting ages roll
Eternal love shall fest their
soul,
And scenes of bliss, forever
new
Rise in succession to their
view;
Rise in succession to their
view.

title: I'VE FOUND THE PEARL OF GREATEST PRICE

lyrics.label: CHORUS
Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Christ is my Prophet, Priest
and King;
A Prophet full of light,
My great High Priest before
the throne,
My King of heavenly might.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
For He indeed is Lord of lords,
And He the King of kings;
He is the Sun of
Righteousness,
With healing in His wings.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Christ is my peace; He died for
me,
For me He gave His blood;
And as my wondrous
Sacrifice,
Offered Himself to God.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Christ Jesus is my All-in-All,
My Comfort and my Love,
My Life below, and He shall be
My Joy and Crown above.

title: I'VE GOT PEACE LIKE A RIVER

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I have peace like a river,
peace like a river,
I have peace like a river in my
soul;
I have peace like a river,
peace like a river,
I have peace like a river in my
soul.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
I have love like an ocean, love
like an ocean,
I have love like an ocean in my
soul;
I have love like an ocean, love
like an ocean,
I have love like an ocean in my
soul.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
I have joy like a fountain, joy
like a fountain,
I have joy like a fountain in my
soul;
I have joy like a fountain, joy
like a fountain,
I have joy like a fountain in my
soul.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Joyful, joyful, we adore Thee,
God of glory, Lord of love;
Hearts unfold like flowers
before Thee,
Opening to the sun above.
Melt the clouds of sin and
sadness,
Drive the dark of doubt away;
Giver of immortal gladness,
Fill us with the light of day!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
All Thy works with joy
surround Thee,
Earth and heaven reflect Thy
rays,
Stars and angels sing around
Thee,
Centre of unbroken praise;
Field and forest, vale and
mountain,
Flowery meadow, flashing
sea,
Singing bird and flowing
fountain
Call us to rejoice in Thee.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Thou art giving and forgiving,
Ever blessing, ever blessed,
Wellspring of the joy of living,
Ocean-depth of happy rest!
Thou our Father, Christ our
Brother-
All who live in love are Thine:
Teach us how to love each
other,
Lift us to the joy divine.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Mortals, join the happy chorus
Which the morning stars
began;
Father love is reigning o'er us,
Brother love binds man to
man;
Ever singing, march we
onward,
Victors in the midst of strife,
Joyful music leads us sunward
In the triumph song of life.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Kumba yah, my Lord, kumba
yah!
Kumba yah, my Lord, kumba
yah!
Kumba yah, my Lord, kumba
yah!
O Lord, kumba yah!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Someone's laughing, Lord,
kumba yah!
Someone's laughing, Lord,
kumba yah!
Someone's laughing, Lord,
kumba yah!
O Lord, kumba yah!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Someone's crying, Lord,
kumba yah!
Someone's crying, Lord,
kumba yah!
Someone's crying, Lord,
kumba yah!
O Lord, kumba yah!

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Someone's praying, Lord,
kumba yah!
Someone's praying, Lord,
kumba yah!
Someone's praying, Lord,
kumba yah!
O Lord, kumba yah!

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Someone's singing, Lord,
kumba yah!
Someone's singing, Lord,
kumba yah!
Someone's singing, Lord,
kumba yah!
O Lord, kumba yah!

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lyrics.content:
Kumba yah, my Lord, kumba
yah!
Kumba yah, my Lord, kumba
yah!
Kumba yah, my Lord, kumba
yah!
O Lord, kumba yah!

title: I'M FEASTING AT HIS BANQUETING TABLE

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I'm feasting at His banqueting
table,
His banner over me is love!
I'm feasting at His banqueting
table,
His banner over me is love!
I'm feasting at His banqueting
table,
His banner over me is love!
His banner over me is love!
I am my Beloved's and He is
mine,
His banner over me is love!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
I am my Beloved's and He is
mine,
His banner over me is love!
I am my Beloved's and He is
mine,
His banner over me is love!
His banner over me is love!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
He is the Vine, and we're the
branches,
His banner over me is love!
He is the Vine, and we're the
branches,
His banner over me is love!
He is the Vine, and we're the
branches,
His banner over me is love!
His banner over me is love!

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
There is only one way to
peace:
Through the power of the
cross;
There is only one way to
peace:
Through the power of the
cross;
There is only one way to
peace:
Through the power of the
cross.
His banner over me is love!

title: O SPIRIT OF THE LIVING GOD

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
O Spirit of the living God, Thou
light and fire
divine,
Descend upon Thy church
once more, and
make it truly Thine.
Fill it with love and joy and
power, with
righteousness and peace;
Till Christ shall dwell in human
hearts, and
sin and sorrow cease.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Blow, Wind of God! With
wisdom blow until
our minds are free
From mists of errors, clouds of
doubt, which
blind our eyes to Thee.
Burn, winged fire! Inspire our
lips with
flaming love and zeal,
To preach to all Thy great
good news, God's
glorious common weal.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Teach us to utter living words
of truth which
all may hear,
The language all may
understand when love
speaks loud and clear;
Till every age and race and
clime shall blend
their creeds in one,
And earth shall form one
family by whom
Thy will is done.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
So shall we know the power of
Christ who
came this world to save;
So shall we rise with Him to
life which soars
beyond the grave;
And earth shall win true
holiness, which
makes Thy children whole;
Still, perfected by Thee, we
reach creation's
glorious goal!

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I stand amazed in the
presence
Of Jesus the Nazarene,
And wonder how He could
love me,
A sinner, condemned,
unclean.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
How marvellous, how
wonderful,
And my song shall ever be:
How marvellous, how
wonderful
Is my Saviour's love for me!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
For me it was in the garden
He prayed, "Not my will but
Thine."
He had no tears for His own
griefs,
But sweat of blood supplied
for mine.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
In pity, angels beheld Him,
And came from the world of
light,
To comfort Him in the
sorrowsHe bore for my soul
that night.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
He took my sins and my
sorrows,
He made them His very own;
He bore the burden to Calv'ry,
And suffered and died alone.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
When with the ransomed in
glory,
His face I at last shall see,
'Twillbe my joy through the
ages
To sing of His love for me.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
We praise Thee, O God
For the Son of Thy Love,
For Jesus who died and He's
now gone above.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Hallelujah, Thine the glory
Hallelujah, Amen,
Hallelujah, Thine the glory
Revive us again.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
We praise Thee O God
For the Spirit of light,
Who has shown us our
Saviour and scattered
all night.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
All glory and praise
To the Lamb that was slain,
Who has borne all our sin and
has cleansed
every stain.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Revive us again
Fill each heart with Thy love,
May each soul be rekindled
with fire from above.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
We praise Thee, O God
For the Son of Thy love
For Jesus who died and He's
now gone above.

title: MY SONG SHALL BE OF JESUS

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
My song shall be of Jesus,
His mercy crowns my days;
He fills my cup with blessings
And tunes my heart to praise;
My song shall be of Jesus,
The precious Lamb of God,
Who gave Himself my ransom
And bought me with His blood.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
My song shall be of Jesus,
When sitting at His feet,
I call to mind His goodness
And know my joy's complete;
My song shall be of Jesus,
Whatever ills befall;
I'll sing the grace that saves
me,
And triumphs over all.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
My song shall be of Jesus,
While pressing on my way
To where my home shines
glorious
In pure and perfect day.
And when my soul shall enter
The many mansions fair,
A song of praise to Jesus
I'll sing forever there.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I'd rather have Jesus than
silver or gold,
I'd rather be His than have
riches untold;
I'd rather have Jesus than
houses or lands,
I'd rather be led by His
nail-pierced hand.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Than to be a king of a vast
domain,
Or be held in sin's dread sway;
I'd rather have Jesus than
anything
This world affords today.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
I'd rather have Jesus than
men's applause,
I'd rather be faithful to His dear
cause;
I'd rather have Jesus than
world-wide fame,
I'd rather be true to His holy
name.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
He's fairer than lilies of rarest
bloom,
He's sweeter than honey from
out the comb;
He's all that my hungering
spirit needs,
I'd rather have Jesus and let
Him lead.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Watchman, blow the gospel
trumpet,
Every soul a warning give;
Whosoever hears the
message
May repent, and turn and live.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Blow the trumpet trusty
watchman,
Blow it loud o'er land and sea;
God commissions, sound the
message!
Every captive may be free.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Sound it loud o'er every hilltop,
Gloomy shade and sunny
plain;
Ocean depths repeat the
message,
Full salvation's glad chorus.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Sound it in the hedge and
highway,
Earth's dark spot where exiles
roam;
Let it tell all things are ready,
Father waits to welcome
home.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Sound it for the heavy-laden,
Weary, longing to be free;
Sound the Saviour's invitation,
Sweetly saying, "Come to
me."

title: HOW SWEET THE NAME OF JESUS SOUNDS

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
How sweet the name of Jesus
sounds,
In a believer's ear!
It soothes his sorrows, heals
his wounds,
And drives away his fear.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
It makes the wounded spirit
whole,
And calms the troubled breast;
'Tis manna to the hungry soul,
And to the weary, rest.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Dear name, the Rock on
which I stand,
My shield and hiding place,
My never-failing treasure, filled
With boundless stores of
grace.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Jesus, my Shepherd, Saviour,
Friend,
My Prophet, Priest and King!
My Lord, my Life, my Way, my
End!
Accept the praise I bring.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Weak is the effort of my heart,
And cold my warmest
thoughts;
But when I see Thee as Thou
hath,
I'll praise Thee as I ought.

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lyrics.content:
I would Thy boundless love
proclaim
With every fleeting breath;
So shall the music of Thy
name
Refresh my soul in death
.

title: TELL ME THE STORY OF JESUS

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Tell me the story of Jesus:
Write on my heart every word,
Tell me the story most
precious,
Sweetest that ever was heard;
Tell how the angels, in chorus,
Sang as they welcomed His
birth:
"Glory to God in the highest,
Peace and good tidings to
earth!"

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Tell me the story of Jesus:
Write on my heart every word,
Tell me the story most
precious,
Sweetest that ever was heard.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Tell of the cross where they
nailed Him,
Writhing in anguish and pain;
Tell of the grave where they
laid Him,
Tell how He liveth again;
Love in that story so tender,
Clearer than ever I see;
Stay, let me weep while you
whisper,
"Love paid the ransom for
me."

title: AWAKE, MY SOUL, STRETCH EVERY NERVE

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Awake, my soul, stretch every
nerve,
And press with vigour on;
A heavenly race demands thy
zeal,
And an immortal crown,
And an immortal crown.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
'Tis God's animating voice
That calls thee from on high;
'Tis He whose hand presents
the prize
To thine aspiring eye,
To thine aspiring eye.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
A cloud of witnesses around
Hold thee in full survey;
Forget the steps already trod,
And onward urge thy way,
And onward urge thy way.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Blest Saviour, introduced by
Thee,
Our race have we begun;
And, crowned with victory, at
Thy feet
We'll lay our trophies down,
We'll lay our trophies down.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Then wake, my soul, stretch
every nerve,
And press with vigour on,
A heavenly race demands thy
zeal,
And an immortal crown,
And an immortal crown.

title: BE THOU MY VISION, O LORD OF MY HEART

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Be Thou my vision,
O Lord of my heart;
Naught be all else to me
Save that Thou art,
Thou my best Thought, by day
or by night,
Waking or sleeping, Thy
presence my light.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Be Thou my battle-shield,
Sword for the fight;
Be Thou my dignity,
Thou my delight;
Thou my soul's shelter, Thou
my high tower:
Raise Thou me heavenward,
O power of my
power.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Riches I heed not,
Nor man's empty praise,
Thou mine inheritance,
Now and always:
Thou and Thou only, first in
my heart,
High King of Heaven, my
Treasure Thou art.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
High King of Heaven,
When victory is won,
May I reach Heaven's joys,
O bright heaven's Sun!
Heart of my own heart,
whatever befall,
Still be my vision, O Ruler of
all.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Zion's King shall reign
victorious,
All the earth shall own His
sway;
He will make His kingdom
glorious,
He will reign through endless
day.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Mighty King, Thine arm
revealing,
Now Thy glorious cause
maintain,
Bring the nations help and
healing,
Make them subject to Thy
reign.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Nations now from God
estranged
Then shall see a glorious
Light,
Night to day shall then be
changed,
Heaven shall triumph in the
sight.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Then shall Israel, long
dispersed,
Mourning, seek the Lord their
God;
"Look on Him whom once they
pierced,"
Own and kiss the chastening
rod.

title: THERE IS NO NAME SO SWEET

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
There is no name so sweet,
(There is no name so sweet)
Like Jesus' name, (Like Jesus'
name)
The Son of God, (The Son of
God)
Who died on the cross.
(Who died on the cross)

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
There is no name I know,
(There is no name I know)
Like Jesus' name, (Like Jesus'
name)
The Son of God, (The Son of
God)
Who died on the cross.
(Who died on the cross)

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
There is no name I love,
(There is no name I love)
Like Jesus' name, (Like Jesus'
name)
The Son of God, (The Son of
God)
Who died on the cross.
(Who died on the cross)

title: A SHELTER IN THE TIME OF STORM

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
The Lord's our Rock in Him we
hide,
A shelter in the time of storm;
Secure whatever may betide,
A Shelter in the time of storm.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Mighty Rock in a weary land,
Cooling Shade on the burning
sand,
Faithful Guide for the pilgrim
band,
A Shelter in the time of storm.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
A shade by day, defence by
night,
A Shelter in the time of storm;
No fears alarm, no foes
affright,
A Shelter in the time of storm.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
The raging floods may round
us beat,
A Shelter in the time of storm;
We find in God a safe retreat,
A shelter in the time of storm.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
O Rock divine, O Refuge dear,
A Shelter in the time of storm;
Be Thou our Helper, ever
near,
A Shelter in the time of storm.

title: DEEPER, DEEPER IN THE LOVE OF JESUS

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Deeper, deeper in the love of
Jesus,
Daily let me go;
Higher, higher in the school of
wisdom,
More of grace to know.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
O deeper yet I pray,
And higher everyday
And wiser, blessed Lord,
In Thy precious, holy word.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Deeper, deeper! Blessed Holy
Spirit,
Take me deeper still,
Till my life is wholly lost in
Jesus
And His perfect will.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Deeper, deeper! Though it
costs hard trials,
Deeper let me go!
Rooted in the holy love of
Jesus,
Let me fruitful grow.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Deeper, higher everyday in
Jesus
Till all conflict past,
Finds me conqueror, and in
His own image
Perfected at last.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
O, my comrades! See the
signal
Waving in the sky;
Reinforcements now
appearing,
Victory is nigh.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
"Hold the fort, for I am
coming",
Jesus signals still;
Wave the answer back to
Heaven,
"By Thy grace, we will".

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
See the mighty host
advancing,
Satan leading on:
Mighty men around us falling,
Courage almost gone!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
See the glorious banner
waving!
Hear the trumpet blow!
In our Leader's name we'll
triumph
Over every foe!

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Fierce and long the battle
rages,
But our help is near:
Onward comes our great
Commander,
Cheer, my comrades, cheer!

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Listen to the Master's
pleadings,
There's urgent work for all,
Heed the Spirit's interceding,
Give this answer to the call:

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
I am ready for service for
Thee, dear Lord,
Here am I, send me,
I am willing to be what You'd
have me be,
I will go to where You want me
to go.
I am ready for service for
Thee, dear Lord,
Here am I, send me,
Though the pathway seems
dark
For Thee I'll do or die, I am
ready for
service, Lord.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
There's a voice to you now
calling,
Will you heed earnest word
On the ear it's gently calling
Give this answer to your Lord:

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Many souls in sins are dying,
Haste to help them while you
may,
For the time is swiftly flying,
Will you now to Jesus say:

title: LET THE LORD HAVE HIS WAY

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Let the Lord have His way
In your heart everyday!
There's no rest, there's no
peace,
Until the Lord have His way.
Place your life in His hands,
Rest secure in His plan;
Let the Lord, let the Lord have
His way.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Whisper a prayer in the
morning,
Whisper a prayer at noon,
Whisper a prayer in the
evening,
To keep your heart in tune.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
God answers prayer in the
morning,
God answers prayer at noon,
God answers prayer in the
evening,
So keep your heart in tune.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Jesus may come in the
morning,
Jesus may come at noon,
Jesus may come in the
evening,
So keep your heart in tune.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
'Tis not an easy road
We are travelling to Heaven
For many are the thorns on
the way;
'Tis not an easy road
But the Saviour is with us
His presence gives us joy
everyday.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
No, no! 'Tis not an easy road,
No, no! 'Tis not an easy road;
But Jesus walks beside me
And brightens the journey
And lightens the heavy load.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
'Tis not an easy road,
There are trials and troubles
And many are the dangers we
meet;
But Jesus guards and keeps
so that nothing can harm us
And smoothens rough paths
for our feet.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Though I am often footsore
and weary from travel,
Though I am often bowed
down with care;
A better day is coming, when
home in the glory
We'll rest in perfect peace
over there.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Once I was bound by sin's
galling fetters,
Chained like a slave, I
struggled in vain;
But I received a glorious
freedom,
When Jesus broke my fetters
in twain.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Glorious freedom, wonderful
freedom,
No more in chains of sin I
repine!
Jesus the glorious
Emancipator!
Now and forever He shall be
mine.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Freedom from all the carnal
affections,
Freedom from envy, hatred
and strife;
Freedom from vain and
worldly ambitions,
Freedom from all that
saddened my life.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Freedom from pride and all
sinful follies,
Freedom from love and glitter
of gold;
Freedom from evil, temper,
and anger,
Glorious freedom, rapture
untold!

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Freedom from fear with all of
its torments,
Freedom from care with all of
its pain;
Freedom in Christ, my blessed
Redeemer,
He who has rent my fetters in
twain.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Nobody but You, Lord, nobody
but You
Can keep me happy, can keep
me true;
All through life's journey
You'll carry me through,
Nobody but You, Lord, nobody
but You.

title: I SHALL BE NO STRANGER THERE

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
When the pearly gates are
opened
To a sinner saved by grace,
When thro' everlasting mercy,
I behold my Saviour's face,
When I enter in the mansions
Of the city bright and fair,
I shall have a royal welcome,
For I'll be no stranger there.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Thro' time's ever changing
seasons,
I am pressing t'ward the goal;
'Tis my heart's sweet native
country,
'Tis the homeland of my soul;
Many loved ones, clothed with
beauty,
In those wondrous glories
share;
When I rise, redeemed,
forgiven,
I shall be no stranger there.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
There my dear Redeemer
liveth,
Blessed Lamb upon the
throne;
By the crimson marks upon
them,
He will surely claim His own.
So, whenever sad or lonely,
Look beyond the earthly care;
Weary child of God,
remember,
You will no stranger there.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I was sinking deep in
darkness, I was drifting
far from the shore
And I felt, down in my heart,
that the Lord
loved me no more
I was like a little beast upon
the raging seas
When God, rich in mercy,
made a way for
me.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Mercy re-wrote my life, God's
mercy re-
wrote my life
I should have fallen, and my
soul cast down
But God's mercy re-wrote my
life.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
I was blue and I was lonely,
my heart was
sinking deep
Satan, he told me that no one
really cared
I was like a broken vessel, as
broken as one
could be
When God, rich in mercy,
made a way for
me.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Things are different now,
Something happened to me
When I gave my heart to
Jesus;
Things are different now,
I was changed it must be
When I gave my heart to Him;
Things I loved before have
passed away,
Things I love far more have
come to stay;
Things are different now,
Something happened that day
When I gave my heart to Him.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Give me your hand let's agree
together,
That all our enemies crumble
at our feet;
For whatever we bind on earth
shall be bound
in Heaven
At the name of Jesus Satan
has to flee.
