lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
We've got the power in the
name of Jesus
We've got the power, in the
name of the Lord;
Though Satan rages, we shall
not be defeated,
We've got the power, in the
name of the Lord.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
For many years now Satan
tried to stop us,
But the bride of Jesus is still
alive,
Like a mighty army she keeps
moving onward
Winning every battle, for the
Lord's on her side.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Lead us, Heavenly Father,
lead us
O'er the world's tempestuous
sea;
Guide us, guard us, keep us,
feed us,
For we have no help but Thee;
Yet possessing every
blessing,
If our God our Father be.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Saviour breathe forgiveness
o'er us,
All our weakness Thou dost
know;
Thou didst tread the earth
before us,
Thou didst feel its keenest
woe;
Lone and dreary, faint and
weary,
Through the desert Thou didst
go.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Spirit of our God descending,
Fill our hearts with heavenly
joy;
Love with every feeling
blending,
Pleasures that can never cloy:
Thus provided, pardoned,
guided,
Nothing can our peace
destroy.

title: HE TOOK MY PLACE, AND DIED FOR ME

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
A trembling soul, I sought the
Lord,
My sin confessed, my guilt
deplored;
How soft and sweet His word
to me:
"I took thy place and died for
thee."

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
No other hope, no other plea:
He took my place and died for
me.
O precious Lamb of Calvary!
He took my place and died for
me.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Here rests my heart;
assurance sweet:
His blessed work He will
complete,
Since in His love so great and
free
He took my place and died for
me.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
When sorrow veils the smiling
day,
When evil foes beset my way,
Abundant grace in Him I see;
He took my place and died for
me.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
No room for doubt, no room
for fears,
When to my view the cross
appears;
My joyful song shall ever be:
"He took my place and died for
me."

title: I WOULD HAVE THE SAVIOUR WITH ME

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I would have the Saviour with
me,
For I dare not walk alone;
I would feel His presence near
me,
And His arm around me
thrown.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Then my soul... shall fear no
ill,...
While He leads...me where He
will,...
I will go... without a murmur,
And His footsteps follow still.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
I would have the Saviour with
me,
For my faith, at best, is weak;
He can whisper words of
comfort
That no other voice can
speak.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
I would have the Saviour with
me
In the onward march of life,
Through the tempest and the
sunshine,
Through the battle and the
strife.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
I would have the Saviour with
me,
That His eye the way may
guide,
Till I reach the vale of Jordan,
Till I cross the rolling tide.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I'm in the way, the bright and
shining way;
I'm in the gloryland way,
Telling the world that Jesus
saves today...
Yes, I'm in the gloryland way.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
I'm in the gloryland way,
I'm in the gloryland way;
Heaven's beautiful and the
way's equally
beautiful,
I'm in the gloryland way.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
List'n to the call, the gospel
call today,
Get in the gloryland way;
Wanderers,come home, O
hasten to obey,
For, I'm in the gloryland way.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Onward I go rejoicing in His
love,
I'm in the gloryland way.
Soon I shall see Him in the
home above
O, I'm in the gloryland way.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
At a time like this when we
gather together
From the East to the West,
from North and
South;
When we gather together in
the name of
Jesus Christ,
O Lord, arise and shine....
O Lord, arise and shine.

title: JESUS CHRIST IS THE SON OF GOD

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Jesus Christ is the Son of
God,
O yes, O yes!
Hallelujah He arose,
O yes, O yes!
Hallelujah He arose, the Son
of God arose;
Hallelujah He arose!
O yes, O yes!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Jesus Christ is the Prince of
Peace
O yes, O yes!
Hallelujah He arose,
O yes, O yes!
Hallelujah He arose, the
Prince of Peace
arose;
Hallelujah He arose!
O yes, O yes!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Jesus Christ is the King of
kings
O yes, O yes!
Hallelujah He arose,
O yes, O yes!
Hallelujah He arose, the King
of kings arose;
Hallelujah He arose!
O yes, O yes!

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Jesus never fails,
Jesus never fails,
Heaven and earth will pass
away,
But Jesus never fails.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Your father may let you down
Your brother may let you down
The men of this world may let
you down,
But Jesus never fails.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
O what precious love the
Father
Hath for Adam's fallen race;
Gave His only Son to suffer,
And redeem us by His grace.

title: I HAVE THE LIFE OF GOD IN ME

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I have the life of God in me
I have the life of God in me
I have the Spirit of the Son of
God
I have the life of God in me.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I am a blessed child
I am a blessed child
Jesus makes me a blessed
child
I am a blessed child.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
There is power in the spoken
word
As the Lord told the prophet
There is power in the spoken
word
By the spoken word, the
squirrels were
created
By the spoken word, the
storms rolled away.

title: DO YOU BELIEVE THE SPOKEN WORD?

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Do you believe the spoken
word? I believe!
Do you believe the spoken
word? I believe!
Do you believe the spoken
word? I believe!
That's why I'm singing and
praising the Lord
That's why I'm singing and
praising the Lord.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Evening light is shining:
Zachariah 14
We are walking in the light:
Malachi 4
Evening is shining: revelation
10
Is the promise of the bride for
today.

title: I WILL NEVER LET THE DEVIL WIN

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I will never let the Devil win the
battle
I will never compromise with
him
Though he may try within
Though he may try without
I will never let the Devil win the
battle.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I'm satisfied with just a cottage
below,
A little silver,-and a little gold;
But in that city where the
ransomed will shine,
I want a gold, -one that's
silver-lined.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
I've got a mansion just over
the hill-top,
In that bright land where we'll
never grow old,
And someday yonder, we will
never more
wander,
But walk on streets that are
purest gold.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Though often tempted,
tormented and tested,
And like a prophet, my pillow a
stone;
And though I find here no
permanent
dwelling,
I know He'll give me a
mansion my own.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Don't think me poor or
deserted or lonely,
I'm not discouraged, I'm
Heaven-bound,
I'm but a pilgrim, in search of
that city,
I want a mansion, a harp and
a crown.

title: O, I OFTEN SIT AND PONDER

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
O, I often sit and ponder,
When the sun is sinking low,
Where shall yonder future find
me:
Does but God in Heaven
know?
Shall I be among the living?
Shall I mingle with the free?
Wheresoe'er my path be
leading,
Saviour, keep my heart with
Thee.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
O, the fu...ture lies before me
And I know... not where I'll be
But where're... my path be
leading
Saviour, keep... my heart with
Thee.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Shall I be at work for Jesus,
Whilst He leads me by the
hand,
And those around be saying,
"Come and join His happy
band?
Come for all things now are
ready,
Come His faithful follow'r be,"
O, where're my path be
leading,
Saviour, keep my heart with
Thee.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
But perhaps my work for
Jesus
Soon in future may be done,
All my earthly trials ended,
And my crown in Heaven be
won;
Then forever with the
ransomed
Through eternity I'd be
Chanting hymns to Him who
bought me
With His blood shed on the
tree.

title: NO ONE EVER CARED FOR ME LIKE JESUS

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I would love to tell you what I
think of Jesus
Since I found in Him a Friend
so strong and true;
I would tell you how He
changed my life
completely
He did something that no
other friend could do.

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
No one ever cared for me like
Jesus,
There's no other friend so kind
as He;
No one else could take the sin
and darkness
from me,
O, how much He cared for me!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
All my life was full of sin when
Jesus found me,
All my heart was full of misery
and woe;
Jesus placed His strong and
loving arms
around me,
And He led me in the way I
ought to go.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Every day He comes to me
with new
assurance,
More and more I understand
His words of love;
But I'll never know just why He
came to
save me,
Till some day I see His
blessed face above.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Keep me Jesus as the apple
of Thy eye
Hide me under the shadow of
Thy wing
Thou alone can save me lest I
die
Keep me Jesus as the apple
of Thy eye.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
The law of the Lord is perfect,
Converting the soul:
The testimony of the Lord is
sure,
Making wise the simple.
More to be desired are they
than gold,
Yea, than much fine gold:
Sweeter also than the honey,
and the
honeycomb.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
The statutes of the Lord are
right,
Rejoicing the heart:
The commandment of the
Lord is pure,
Enlightening the eyes.
More to be desired are they
than gold,
Yea, than much fine gold:
Sweeter also than the honey,
and the
honeycomb.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
The fear of the Lord is clean,
Enduring for ever:
The judgments of the Lord are
true,
And righteous altogether.
More to be desired are they
than gold,
Yea, than much fine gold:
Sweeter also than the honey,
and the
honeycomb.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
And in the keeping of them
There is great reward,
There is great reward.
In the keeping of them
There is great reward.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
My Lord knows the way
through the
wilderness;
All I have to do is follow.
My Lord knows the way
through the
wilderness;
All I have to do is follow.
Strength for today is mine
always,
And all that I need for
tomorrow;
My Lord knows the way
through the
wilderness;
All I have to do is follow.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Burdens are lifted at Calvary,
Calvary, Calvary
Burdens are lifted at Calvary,
Jesus will meet you there.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Thy loving kindness is better
than life;
They loving kindness is better
than life.
My lips shall praise Thee
Thus will I bless Thee;
I will lift up my hands in Thy
name.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
I lift my hands Lord, unto Thy
name;
I lift my hands Lord, unto Thy
name.
My lips shall praise Thee
Thus will I bless Thee
I will lift up my hands in Thy
name.

title: REDEEMED OF THE LORD SHALL RETURN (ISAIAH 51:11)

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Therefore the redeemed of the
Lord shall return,
And come with singing unto
Zion;
And everlasting joy shall be
upon their head.
Therefore the redeemed of the
Lord shall return,
And come with singing unto
Zion;
And everlasting joy shall be
upon their head

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
They shall obtain gladness
and joy;
And sorrow and mourning
shall flee away.
Therefore the redeemed of the
Lord shall return,
And come with singing unto
Zion;
And everlasting joy shall be
upon their head.

title: BE IT UNTO ME ACCORDING TO THY WORD

lyrics.label: CHORUS
lyrics.content:
Be it unto me according to Thy
Word,
According to Your promises, I
can stand secure.
Carve upon my heart the truth
that sets me free,
According to Your Word, O
Lord, be it unto me.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
You promised Your blood
would deliver,
Lord, we believe it's true.
You promised us joy like a
river.
Lord, we receive it from You.
These things You have
spoken,
You're bringing to pass.
This world's disappearing,
But Your Word will last.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
He promised to carry our
sorrow,
Lord, we believe it's true.
You promised unending
tomorrows,
Lord, we receive it from You.
You will be our provider,
In Your Word it's revealed,
And by the stripes that You
bore,
We have been healed.

title: MAN OF SORROW, WHAT A NAME

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Man of Sorrow, -what a name!
For the Son of God who came
For ruined sinners to reclaim.
Hallelujah, what a Saviour!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Bearing shame and scoffing
rude,
In my place condemned He
stood;
Sealed my pardon with His
blood.
Hallelujah, what a Saviour!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
Verse 4
Verse 5
lyrics.content:
When He comes our glorious
King,
All His ransomed home to
bring,
Then anew His song we'll
sing:
Hallelujah, what a Saviour!

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Up Calvary's mountain, one
dreadful morn,
Walked Christ my Savior,
weary and worn;
Facing for sinners death on
the cross,
That He might save them from
endless loss.

lyrics.label: Chorus
lyrics.content:
Blessed Redeemer! Precious
Redeemer!
Seems I now see Him on
Calvary's tree;
Wounded and bleeding, for
sinners pleading,
Blind and unheeding-dying for
me!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
"Father forgive them!" thus did
He pray,
E'en while His lifeblood flowed
fast away;
Praying for sinners while in
such woe
No one but Jesus ever loved
so.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
O how I love Him, Savior and
Friend,
How can my praises ever find
end!
Through years unnumbered
on heaven's
shore,
My tongue shall praise Him
forevermore.

title: AS THE DEER PANTETH FOR THE WATER

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
As the deer panteth for the
waters
So my soul longeth after Thee
You alone are my heart's
desire
And long to worship Thee.

lyrics.label: Chorus
lyrics.content:
You alone are my strength, my
shield
To you alone may my spirit
yields
You alone are my heart's
desire
And long to worship thee

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
You're my friend
And you are my brother
Even though you are a King.
I love you more than anything.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
I want You more than gold or
silver
Only You can satisfy
You alone are the real joy
giver
And the apple of my eye

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Oh! to be like Thee, blessed
Redeemer,
This is my constant longing
and prayer;
Gladly I'll forfeit all of earth's
treasures,
Jesus, thy perfect likeness to
wear.

lyrics.label: Refrain
lyrics.content:
Oh! To be like Thee, Oh! to
be like Thee,
Blessed Redeemer, pure as
Thou art,
Come in Thy sweetness,
come in Thy
Fullness,
Stamp Thine own image
deep on my heart.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Oh! to be like Thee, full of
compassion,
Loving, forgiving, tender and
kind,
Helping the helpless, cheering
the
Fainting,
Seeking the wand'ring sinner
to find.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Oh! to be like Thee, lowly in
Spirit.
Holy and harmless, patient
and brave ;
Meekly enduring cruel
reproaches
Willing to suffer others to
save.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Oh! to be like Thee, Lord I am
coming,
Now to receive th' anointing
divine,
All that I am and have, I am
bringing
Lord from this moment all shall
be Thine.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Oh! to be like Thee, while I am
pleading,
Pour out Thy Spirit, fill with
Thy love,
Make me a temple meet for
Thy dwelling,
Fit me for life and Heaven
above.

title: I WOULD NOT ASK FOR EARTHLY STORE

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I would not ask for earthly
store
Thou wilt my need supply;
But I would covet, more and
more,
The clear and single eye,
To see my duty face to face,
And trust Thee, Lord, for daily
grace.

lyrics.label: Chorus
lyrics.content:
Then shall my heart keep
singing
While to the cross I cling;
For rest is sweet at Jesus'
feet,
While homeward faith keeps
winging,
While homeward faith keeps
winging.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
I care not for the empty show
That thoughtless worldlings
see;
But gladly do the best I know
And leave the rest with Thee.
Well satisfied that sweet
reward
Is sure to those who trust the
Lord.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Whate'er the crosses mine
shall be,
I would not dare to shun;
But only ask to live for Thee,
And that Thy will be done;
Thy will, O Lord, be mine each
day,
While pressing on my
homeward way.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
And when at last, my labour
o'er,
I cross the narrow sea,
Grant, Lord, that on the other
shore,
My soul may dwell with Thee;
And learn what here I cannot
know,
Why Thou hast ever loved me
so.

title: JESUS! WHAT A FRIEND FOR SINNERS!

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Jesus! what a Friend for
sinners!
Jesus! Lover of my soul;
Friends may fail me, foes
assail me,
He, my Savior, makes me
whole.

lyrics.label: Refrain
lyrics.content:
Hallelujah! what a Savior!
Hallelujah! what a Friend!
Saving, helping, keeping,
loving,
He is with me to the end.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Jesus! what a Strength in
weakness!
Let me hide myself in Him.
Tempted, tried, and
sometimes failing,
He, my Strength, my victory
wins.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Jesus! what a Help in sorrow!
While the billows over me roll,
Even when my heart is
breaking,
He, my Comfort, helps my
soul.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Jesus! what a Guide and
Keeper!
While the tempest still is high,
Storms about me, night
o'ertakes me,
He, my Pilot, hears my cry.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Jesus! I do now receive Him,
More than all in Him I find.
He hath granted me
forgiveness,
I am His, and He is mine.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
He giveth more grace when
the burdens grow greater,
He sendeth more strength
when the labors increase;
To added afflictions He addeth
His mercy,
To multiplied trials, His
multiplied peace.

lyrics.label: Chorus
lyrics.content:
His love has no limits, His
grace has no measure,
His power has no boundary
known unto men;
For out of His infinite riches in
Jesus
He giveth, and giveth, and
giveth again.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
When we have exhausted our
store of endurance,
When our strength has failed
ere the day is half done,
When we reach the end of our
hoarded resources
Our Father's full giving is only
begun.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Fear not that thy need shall
exceed His provision,
Our God ever yearns His
resources to share;
Lean hard on the arm
everlasting, availing;
The Father both thee and thy
load will upbear.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Simply trusting every day
Trusting through a stormy way
Even when my faith is small
Trusting Jesus, that is all
Trusting as the moments fly
Trusting as the days go by
Trusting Him whate'er befall
Trusting Jesus, that is all

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Brightly doth His Spirit shine
Into this poor heart of mine
While He leads I cannot fall
Trusting Jesus, that is all
Trusting as the moments fly
Trusting as the days go by
Trusting Him whate'er befall
Trusting Jesus, that is all

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Singing if my way is clear
Praying if the path be drear
If in danger for Him call
Trusting Jesus, that is all
Trusting as the moments fly
Trusting as the days go by
Trusting Him whate'er befall
Trusting Jesus, that is all

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Trusting Him while life shall
last
Trusting Him till earth be past
Till within the jasper wall
Trusting Jesus, that is all
Trusting as the moments fly
Trusting as the days go by
Trusting Him whate'er befall
Trusting Jesus, that is all

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Conquerors and overcomers
now are we,
Thro' the precious blood of
Christ we've victory
If the Lord be for us we can
never fail,
Nothing 'gainst His mighty
power can e'er prevail.

lyrics.label: Chorus
lyrics.content:
Conquerors are we, thro' the
blood of Jesus
God will give us victory, thro'
the blood of Jesus
Through the Lamb for sinners
slain,
Yet who lives and reigns
again,
More than conquerors are we,
More than conquerors are we.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
In the name of Israel's God
we'll onward press,
Overcoming sin and all
unrighteousness;
Not to us but unto Him the
praise shall be,
For salvation and for blood
bought victory.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Conquerors are we, thr'o the
blood of Jesus
God will give us victory, thro'
the blood of Jesus
Through the Lamb for sinners
slain,
Yet who lives and reigns
again,
More than conquerors are we,
More than conquerors are we.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Unto Him that overcometh
shall be given,
Here to eat of hidden manna
sent from Heaven,
Over yonder He the victor's
palm shall bear,
And a robe of white, and
golden crown shall wear.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Conquerors are we, thr'o the
blood of Jesus
God will give us victory, thro'
the blood of Jesus
Through the Lamb for sinners
slain,
Yet who lives and reigns
again,
More than conquerors are we,
More than conquerors are we.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Tenderly guide us,
O Shepherd of love,
To the green pastures
and waters above,
Guarding us ever by
night and by day,
Never from Thee would I
stray.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Never! Never!
Never! Oh, never!
For Thou art the way;
Never! Never!
Never from Thee would we
stray!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
What though the heavens
with clouds be o'ercast!--
Fearful the tempest,
and bitter the blast!
Still with the light
of Thy Word on the way,
Never from Thee would I
stray.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Over our weakness
Thy strength has been cast:
Keep us in meekness,
Thine own till the last;
Then, safely folded,
with joy we shall say,
Never from Thee would I
stray.

title: O PRAISE HIM! O PRAISE HIM!

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
All creatures of our God and
King,
Lift up your voices with us
sing,
Alleluia! Alleluia!
Thou burning sun with golden
beam
Thou silver moon with softer
gleam!

lyrics.label: Refrain
lyrics.content:
O praise Him! O praise Him!
Alleluia! Alleluia! Alleluia!.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Thou rushing wind that art sos
strong,
Ye clouds that sail in heav'n
along,
Thou rising moon, in praise
rejoice,
Ye lights of evening, find a
voice!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Thou flowing water, pure and
clear,
Make music for thy Lord to
hear,
O praise Him Alleluia!
Thou fire so masterful and
bright,
That gives man both warmth
and light.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
And all ye men of tender heart,
Forgiving others, take your
partzl,
O praise Him! Alleluia!
Ye who long pain and sorrow
bear,
Praise God and on Him cast
your care!

title: COME THOU FOUNT OF EVERY BLESSING

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Come Thou fount of every
blessing
Tune my heart to sing Thy
grace
Streams of mercy never
ceasing
Call for songs of loudest
praise
Teach me some melodious
sonnet
Sung by flaming tongues
above.
Praise His Name I'm fixed
upon it
Name of God's redeeming
love.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Hither to thy love has blessed
me
Thou has brought me to this
place
And I know Thy hand will bring
me
Safely home by Thy good
grace
Jesus sought me when a
stranger,
Wandering from the fold of
God;
He, to rescue me from danger,
Bought me with His precious
blood

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
O to grace how great a debtor
Daily I'm constrained to be!
Let Thy goodness, like a
fetter,
Bind my wandering heart to
Thee:
Prone to wander, Lord, I feel it,
Prone to leave the God I love;
Here's my heart, O take and
seal it;
Seal it for Thy courts above.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
Verse 1
lyrics.content:
We thank Thee each morning
for a newborn day
where we may work the fields
of new mown hay
We thank Thee for the
sunshine
and the air that we breathe
Oh Lord we thank Thee

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
We thank Thee for the rivers
that run all day
we thank Thee for the little
birds that sing away
we thank Thee for the trees
and the deep blue sea
Oh Lord we thank Thee

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Oh yes we thank Thee Lord
for every flower that blooms
birds that sing, fish that swim
and the light of the moon.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
We thank Thee every day
as we kneel and pray
that we were born with eyes
to see these things.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
We thank Thee for the fields
where the clovers grow
we thank Thee for the
pastures
where the cattle may roam
We thank Thee for Thy love so
pure and free
Oh Lord we thank Thee.

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lyrics.content:
Oh yes we thank Thee Lord
for every flower that blooms
birds that sing, fish that swim
and the light of the moon.

lyrics.label: Verse 7
lyrics.content:
We thank Thee every day
as we kneel and pray
that we were born with eyes
to see these things.

lyrics.label: Verse 8
lyrics.content:
We thank Thee for the fields
where the clovers grow
we thank Thee for the
pastures
where the cattle may roam
We thank Thee for Thy love so
pure and so free
Oh Lord we thank Thee.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
I have lived a life of sin in this
world were living in
I have done forbidden things I
shouldn't do
I ask a beggar along the way if
he could tell
me where to stay
Where I could find real
happiness and love
that's true

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Across the bridge, there's no
more sorrow
Across the bridge, theres' no
more pain
The Sun will shine across the
river
And you'll never be unhappy
again

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Follow footsteps of the King till
you hear
the voices ring
They'll be singing out the glory
of the Lamb
The river of Jordan will be
near, the sound of
trumpet you will hear
And you'll behold the special
place
ever known to man

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
My cathedral has a ceiling of
blue
My cathedral neath the sky
Where I may lift up my eyes
unto the hills
And hear music from a stream
rippling by

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
My cathedral has an alter of
flowers
Their fragrant incense fills the
air
In my cathedral I am closer to
him
Than I could be anywhere

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
For here I pray
In a place so grand
The carpet I kneel on
Was made by his own hand

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
My cathedral has candles
lighted by the stars
And mighty pillars of trees
No other cathedral is so
beautiful
For God made my cathedral
for me....

title: BRIGHT STARS ARE WATCHING THE WORLD

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Bright stars are watching the
world as it
sleeps
Shepherds watch over the
little white
sheep
The lighthouse is shining for
ships far at
sea
As God keeps the night watch
for you
and for me

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
So sleep, sleep in peace and
rest
Don't be afraid of the darkness
All's well for over the land and
the sea
God's keeping the night watch
for you
and for me

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
(God is keeping the night
watch for you
and for me)
So sleep, sleep in peace and
rest
Don't be afraid of the darkness
All's well for over the land and
the sea
God's keeping the night watch
for you
and for me...

title: MY SOUL IS LOST, SO LONELY AND SO COLD

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
My soul is lost, so lonely and
so cold
Just like a lamb that has
strayed from the fold
Across the barren waste of sin
I roam
Oh, gentle shepherd hear my
cry and lead me home

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
The hours go by on frightened
wings of flight
While wolves of hell are
waiting for the night
To claim the soul that
wandered from the fold
Oh, gentle shepherd hear my
cry and save my soul

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Oh, gentle shepherd hear my
lonely cry
And in Thy cool green
pastures let me lie
Beside the still clear waters
lead Thou me
Oh, gentle shepherd safe
forevermore with
Thee...

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Precious Lord, take my hand
Lead me on, let me stand
I'm tired, I'm weak, I'm lone
Through the storm, through
the night
Lead me on to the light
Take my hand precious Lord,
lead me home

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
When my way grows drear,
precious Lord linger near
When my light is almost gone
Hear my cry, hear my call
Hold my hand lest I fall
Take my hand precious Lord,
lead me home

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
When the darkness appears
and the night draws near
And the day is past and gone
At the river I stand
Guide my feet, hold my hand
Take my hand precious Lord,
lead me home

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Precious Lord, take my hand
Lead me on, let me stand
I'm tired, I'm weak, I'm lone
Through the storm, through
the night
Lead me on to the light
Take my hand precious Lord,
lead me home (lead me home)

title: IF I HAVE WOUNDED SOME POOR SOUL

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
If I have wounded some poor
soul today
If I have caused one foot to go
astray
If I have walked in my own
willful way
Dear Lord, forgive

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
If I have uttered idle words in
vain
If I have turned aside from
want or pain
Lest I offend some other
through the strain
Dear Lord, forgive

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Forgive these sins I have
confessed to Thee
Forgive the secret sins I do not
see
Guide me, love me and my
keeper be
Dear Lord, forgive...

title: WHERE DO I GO FROM HERE?

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Where do I go from here?
What fate is drawing near?
Touch my heart
And guide my lips in prayer.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Through the grace of God
alone
I'll cast aside these fears I've
known
And lift myself from
The depths of deep dispair.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Lead me through the darkness
And through each gloomy day.
Take my hand, oh, precious
Lord
And help me on my way.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Give me strength that I might
find
Abiding faith and peace of
mind
And I won't ask
Where do I go from here?.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Please, Lead me through the
darkness
And through each gloomy day.
Take my hand, oh, precious
Lord
And help me on my way.

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lyrics.content:
Give me strength that I might
find
Abiding faith and peace of
mind
And I won't ask
Where do I go from here?

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Simply trusting every day;
Trusting through a stormy
way;
Even when my faith is small,
Trusting Jesus, that is all.
Trusting as the moments fly,
Trusting as the days go by,
Trusting Him, whate'er befall,
Trusting Jesus, that is all.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Brightly doth His Spirit shine
Into this poor heart of mine;
While He leads I cannot fall,
Trusting Jesus, that is All.
Trusting as the moments fly,
Trusting as the days go by,
Trusting Him, whate'er befall,
Trusting Jesus, that is all.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Singing if my way be clear,
Praying if the path be drear;
If in danger, for Him call,
Trusting Jesus, that is all.
Trusting as the moments fly,
Trusting as the days go by,
Trusting Him, whate'er befall,
Trusting Jesus, that is all.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Trusting Him while life shall
last,
Trusting Him till earth is past,
Till His gracious advent call,
Trusting Jesus, that is all.
Trusting as the moments fly,
Trusting as the days go by,
Trusting Him, whate'er befall,
Trusting Jesus, that is all.

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
ALLELUIA! ALLELUIA!
ALLELUIA!
The strife is o'er, the battle
done;
The victory of life is won;
The song of triumph has
begun, Alleluia!

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
The powers of death have
done their worst,
But Christ their legions has
despersed;
Let shouts of holy joy outburst,
Alleluia!

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
The three sad days are quickly
sped;
He rises glorious from the
dead.
All glory to our risen Head,
Alleluia!

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
He breaks the age-bound
chains of hell;
The bars from heaven's high
portals fell.
Let hymns of praise His
triumph tell, Alleluia!

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Lord, by the stripes which
wounded Thee,
From death's dread sting thy
servants free,
That we may live and sing to
thee, Alleluia

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Christ is our cornerstone,
On him alone we build;
With his true saints alone The
courts of heaven are filled.
On his great love
Our hopes we place Of
present grace And joys above.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Oh, then, with hymns of praise
These hallowed courts shall
ring;
Our voices we will raise The
Three in One to sing
And thus proclaim
In joyful song, Both loud and
long, That glorious name.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Here, gracious God, do now
And evermore draw near;
Accept each faithful vow, And
every suppliant hear.
In copious shower
On all who pray Each holy day
Your blessing pour.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Here May We Gain From
Heaven
The Grace Which We Implore,
And May That Grace, Once
Given, Be With Us Evermore
Until That Day
When All The Blest To
Endless Rest Are Called Away

title: DEEPER, DEEPER, IN THE CROSS OF JESUS

lyrics.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
lyrics.content:
Higher, higher, in the life of
Jesus;
Lord, we are so low.
By Thy life we all can go much
higher--
Higher let us go.
Oh, higher yet we pray--
Transform us every day--
And richer in the flow;
May Thy life be all we know.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Growing, growing, in us He is
growing,
More and more each day.
Into all our living He is
flowing--
This is now His way.
For growth, O Lord, we pray;
Increase in us each day.
It's not enough to know;
Now Thy life in us must grow.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Living, living, Christ is all our
living,
He's so practical:
Small things, big things,
anything and all things--
He's involved in all.
Live Christ in every way;
Oh, live Him out today.
His name you now must call,
And give Him your all for all.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Person, Person, Jesus is our
Person,
Living now in us.
He's our tastes, our attitudes
and actions;
Oh, how glorious!
Our Person, Lord, Thou art
Make home in all our heart.
As life in every way
Be our Person, Lord, each
day.

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lyrics.content:
Churches, churches, in the
local churches
We all find the flow:
Deeper, higher, Christ as all
our living,
For the church we grow.
The churches are today
Just Christ in every way.
For this, from self we cease,
For Thy Body, Thine increase.

lyrics.label: Verse 7
lyrics.content:
Building, building, we will see
the building
Of the church this way:
Christ experienced will
produce the building--
He's the only way.
Oh, build us, Lord, we pray,
By growth of life each day.
Oh, make us now such men
For the new Jerusalem.

lyrics.label: Verse 8
lyrics.content:
Coming, coming, Jesus soon
is coming
For His chosen Bride.
In the churches we are all
preparing
To be glorified.
Lord Jesus, come again
This cry is deep within
We'll praise Thee to the end,
Oh, come back! Come back!
Amen!

title: FORTH IN THY NAME, O LORD, I GO

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Forth in thy name, O Lord, I
go,
my daily labor to pursue;
thee, only thee, resolved to
know
in all I think or speak or do.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
The task thy wisdom hath
assigned,
O let me cheerfully fulfill;
in all my works thy presence
find,
and prove thy good and
perfect will.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Thee may I set at my right
hand,
whose eyes mine in-most
substance see,
and labor on at thy command,
and offer all my works to thee.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
For thee delightfully employ
what e'er thy bounteous grace
hath given;
and run my course with even
joy,
and closely walk with thee to
heaven

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lyrics.content:
Grace! 'tis a charming sound,
Harmonious to the ear;
Heav'n with the echo shall
resound,
And all the earth shall hear.

lyrics.label: Chorus
lyrics.content:
Saved by grace alone!
This is all my plea:
Jesus died for all mankind,
And Jesus died for me.

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lyrics.content:
'Twas grace that wrote my
name
In Thy eternal book;
'Twas grace that gave me to
the Lamb,
Who all my sorrows took.

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lyrics.content:
Grace taught my wand'ring
feet
To tread the heav'nly road;
And new supplies each hour I
meet,
While pressing on to God.

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lyrics.content:
Grace taught my soul to pray
And made mine eyes o'erflow;
'Twas grace which kept me to
this day,
And will not let me go.

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lyrics.content:
Oh, let Thy grace inspire
My soul with strength Divine!
My all my powers to Thee
aspire,
And all my days be Thine
